chapters.title: Chapter 4480 Civilizational War! I
paragraphs: Inside the Abode of The Early Creature, Osmont.
Inside an isolated domain.
The domain was breathtaking in its concentrated vitality.
Filled with vibrant green-gold fields of harvest that stretched endlessly across both earth and sky.
Above, the heavens themselves seemed to be cultivated plots...clouds shaped like ripening fruit, stars that pulsed with growing authority.
Below, grasses swayed with rhythm suggesting conscious appreciation of their existence.
In the center of this place stood Noah.
He had just finished the announcement declaring war to his assembled forces.
Behind him, the figure of Elyndra approached with graceful steps.
She was adorned in loose green gown that barely concealed her curvaceous figure, the fabric seeming to flow like living water across her form.
Her radiant golden hair cascaded like harvested wheat.
Her blue eyes shone with unique light mixing satisfaction and mounting curiosity.
She embraced Noah from behind with gentle warmth.
"Is this why you said we would not be friends before?"
Her voice carried playful understanding.
Noah tilted his head back and nodded lightly as he replied with characteristic directness.
"This is substantially better than just being friends. How are you
feeling?"
Elyndra's existence held 9 unique Principles carefully nurtured by
The First Farmer.
She had been engineered specifically for pursuing THE False designation with sufficient harvest accelerating her advancement.
After Noah had infused her with tremendous quantities of accumulated harvest these last few hours...
Elyndra sighed contentedly as she closed her eyes and smiled before articulating her status.

"My 9 Principles are resonating with unprecedented intensity and systematically opening a pathway toward something that should theoretically exceed even a Singularity Principle in fundamental classification."
Her voice carried mixture of wonder and analytical focus.

"I'm not actively creating or designing it through conscious effort, simply being led toward it as if my 9 Principles function as set of stairs ascending toward something far grander. Once I successfully reach and grasp it, the entire staircase may crumble and dissolve as I claim something that transcends their individual existence."
She opened her eyes.
"I'm extraordinarily close to achieving breakthrough. I just require slightly more accumulated resonance."
Her tone shifted to teasing.
"How about you? What did you derive from our extensive connection? Apart from your relentless enjoyment of the process itself, obviously."
Noah smiled calmly at this inquiry as he observed the prompts that had bloomed before his vision.
The information was remarkable.
Through sustained connection and deep resonance with unique
lifeform possessing complementary Principles, The Way toward grasping a Principle exceeding the rank of Singularity has opened before you.
Analysis indicates the potential Principle to be grasped is estimated to be something deeply integral to the fundamental structure of Observable Existence itself.
Successfully grasping such Principle would further enhance your capability to alter and systematically violate existence in
unfathomable ways that transcend current limitations.
Progress toward manifestation: 67%|
Additional resonance required for complete breakthrough.
The results were extraordinarily promising!
So he simply replied to Elyndra with measured satisfaction.
"I benefited substantially. We can continue our mutual advancement
in a bit."
His tone shifted to more immediate concern.
"For now, manifest a clone of yourself and send it to The Sanctuary of
The First Farmer immediately."
At these unexpected words, Elyndra blinked with visible confusion.
"Oh? Did something significant occur? Is everyone safe? Did
complications arise?"
As she articulated these concerns, brilliance shone across her body.
A perfect clone manifested beside her, identical in every visible
aspect.
The clone became adorned in verdant-gold dress that flowed
elegantly.
Her hair arranged itself with practiced motion into elaborate style.
Noah tapped toward empty space nearby with a casual gesture.
A spatial rift bloomed obediently, a tear in reality leading directly to
The Sanctuary.
He simply nodded.
"It should constitute a significant surprise for you. Go and discover what awaits."
With such cryptic encouragement, Elyndra's clone transformed into streak of brilliant light.
She disappeared into the rift without hesitation!
She would be met with the impossible surprise of a Father who had somehow returned from complete collapse.
Meanwhile, her main body remained with Noah.
She sat down with worried expression mixing hope and concern.
Noah lay his head on her lap with comfortable familiarity, closing his eyes as if preparing to nap casually.
But internally, he was gauging his own accumulated strength with
analytical precision!
His power.
At this particular moment, his power derived fundamentally from his Civilization and all its integrated components.
The simple measurement of Sextillions of Complexity and Purity represented only single aspect of his total capability.
Some observers might incorrectly examine his numerical measurements and notice that Khor, another Leader within his
Civilization, possessed ostensibly higher raw Complexity and Purity values.
They might question with confusion...How could another Leader of a
Civilization subordinate to him possess more measured Complexity and Purity than him?! Shouldn't the supreme Leader always maintain the highest numerical values?!
And yet, such perspective would be fundamentally missing the critical
strategic point.
Many hours ago, Noah had actively decided not to focus on merely elevating numerical values of Complexity and Purity.
He had deliberately redirected his accumulated Harvest away from
personal power metrics...
And channeled it systematically into elevating his overall Civilization's
framework!
Complexity and Purity emerged as natural byproduct for him as he
guided the Walls of his Civilization forward and elevated his entire structure to its current unprecedented stage.
And even when he wasn't actively focusing on personal Complexity
and Purity...
His total measurement alongside his permanently fused Protos
already exceeded 170 Sextillion.
If he were to deliberately redirect accumulated Harvest away from strengthening The Architect's Bulwarks and toward pure personal power amplification...
He possessed no doubt whatsoever that he could rapidly gain
sufficient Complexity to completely eclipse any other entity within his Civilization.
But as he had systematically learned...
Complexity and Purity wasn't everything.

Due to him strategically elevating his overall Civilization and successfully unlocking Civilization Specialization mechanics... He now commanded countless specialized entities with power levels measuring in dozens of Sextillions each.
Just consider The Primus Inevitabilities alone.
100 Million would complete their production cycle within 24 hours.
12 hours had already elapsed since their systematic generation
commenced.

There were currently 50 Million Primus Inevitabilities manifested, floating like massive obsidian-blue-and-gold-crimson cloud across the Sanctuaries of Inevitabilities within the Early Veiled Shore! The ones who had specialized into The Infinite Bulwark Specialization alone possessed average power of 10 Sextillion each by this point. If this represented approximately one-third of 50 Million total.... That meant 16 Million Primus Inevitabilities who each held 10
Sextillion Complexity and Purity!
Every single one!
Now, every single defensive specialist, every single member of The
Iron Concordat faction...
They all possessed simple core mechanical function that had been
emphasized clearly during Specialization selection.
Total Offensive Sacrifice. And what were its exact specifications again?
Noah recalled the prompt with perfect clarity. Total Offensive Sacrifice: Members of this Specialization lose 100% of

their offensive capabilities. They cannot deal direct damage through any conventional or unconventional means. All attacks, abilities, and techniques designed to harm enemies are systematically removed from their framework. Any attacks directed toward Members of The
Civilization are automatically drawn to and absorbed by Infinite Bulwark Specialists.
Any attacks toward Members of The Civilization are automatically
drawn to the defensive specialists.
Any.
So, before any hostile entity could ever even contemplate harming a single hair on Noah's existence...
eliminate 16 Million Primus
It would mean they had to success Inevitabilities who each possessed average of 10+ Sextillion
Complexity and Purity!
Noah's mind processed this mathematical reality with cold satisfaction.
Even if he hypothetically possessed only single point of Complexity
and Purity...
Nothing would be capable of harming him until they systematically
wiped out 16 Million defensive specialists who each held 10+ Sextillion worth of protection.
And that calculation only reflected current status.
In another 12 hours, this number would effectively double, and he
could even triple or quadruple it if he simply ordered more of the Primus Inevitabilities to undergo the Infinite Bulwark Specialization. This was what his Civilization granted him.
This was what strategically focusing on Civilization advancement

rather than mere individual Complexity and Purity provided! The fact that even now, he could theoretically withstand cumulative damage equivalent to 16 Million times 10 Sextillion... Made things extraordinarily clear regarding where he needed to continue directing his accumulated Harvest!
Because what exactly was 16 Million multiplied by 10 Sextillion?
That mathematical product was...160 Octillion.
A value that completely exceeded Sextillion classification, entirely
skipped Septillion tier, and landed firmly at Octillion magnitude!
This...
This was what was minimally required just to potentially injure Noah.
And that calculation didn't even account for any defensive capabilities from his personal power!
This....was what elevating a Civilization systematically granted!
It was something utterly glorious.
After affirming this mathematical reality with satisfaction, Noah
opened his eyes.
They flashed with brilliant intensity mixing anticipation and tyrannical confidence.
He would test and observe the immensity of this accumulated power
as it faced genuine opposition...
The preserved forces of the Primordial Civilizations of Emotive and
Elemental!

He genuinely hoped there would be numerous enemies who exceeded hundreds of Sextillions in individual power. So he could really stretch his legs and discover his true limits! His smile widened with predatory satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 4481 Civilizational War! II
paragraphs: As things progressed toward readiness, Noah closed his eyes once
more.
He relaxed against Elyndra's thighs with comfortable familiarity.
His consciousness shifted focus toward another instance of himself, another body that was currently moving across The Wandering Territories.
It was time to see what ancient forces await within the frozen domain!
The Wandering Territories.
The figures of Alexander Asmodeus and Seraphina Valorheart stood surrounded by hundreds of thousands of the most powerful Living Laws.
Sheer numbers meant nothing to the enemies they were about to face!
The most powerful Dukes of Law circled around them in protective formations.
The scene was filled with palpable tension...as if they were all preparing to open Pandora's box that could systematically destroy them all.
The surroundings defied conventional description.
Multicolored oddities and impossible geometries filled the environment in every direction.
Floating crystalline structures that shifted through spectrum of
colors without pattern.
Streams of liquid light flowing upward against gravity.
Fragments of reality suspended in configurations.
Ground that wasn't quite solid, more like concentrated probability given temporary substance.
The Wandering Territories lived up to their name...territories that wandered through existence without stable anchor.
Seraphina's voice emerged with hesitation that she clearly struggled to contain.
"Alexander, are we certain about this course of action? Opening the Injunction Sanctuary represents unprecedented risk as if we cannot overcome them..."
Her crimson eyes reflected mounting concern.
"Why...do you trust Osmont so completely?"
Alexander looked at her calmly.
His reply was simple. Direct.
"We come from the same place, Seraphina."
He paused deliberately.
They came from the same place. That was it?!
As they continued their quiet discussion...
Space rippled nearby.
The entrance was dramatic without being ostentatious.
Noah arrived.
Alone.
He was adorned in emperor's robe woven from obsidian-gold material that seemed to absorb and reflect light simultaneously.
His hair shone with obsidian-cold allure that made it appear carved from precious stone.
But his eyes...
His eyes held sense of immensity and ancientness that transcended his apparent physical age.
Even though he appeared here without visible entourage or escort...
The mere pressure he emanated seemed to suffocate all the Living Laws present!
As if the moment he arrived, all routes through existence began rotating around him and nobody else.
He felt like ancient entity whose visage alone would command
existence wherever he manifested.
The hundreds of thousands of Living Laws felt their frameworks
trembling involuntarily.
Many struggled not to collapse to their knees from sheer proximity to
such concentrated authority.
Noah simply nodded toward Alexander after his arrival with casual acknowledgment.
Alexander's voice emerged with practical inquiry.
"Your forces?"
His forces.
At such question, Noah waved his hand with dismissive gesture.
Behind him, space tore apart violently as three massive rifts formed
simultaneously!
The rifts were glorious in their construction.
Each one spanning hundreds of meters in diameter.
Edges crackling with concentrated authority that made surrounding
reality distort.
The first rift pulsed with obsidian-gold radiance.
The second burned with obsidian-crimson intensity.
The third glowed with verdant-gold luminescence.
And from these three massive rifts...
Noah's forces began emerging.
The specialists of The Iron Concordat, The Crimson Hunger, and The
Verdant Cycle factions materialized through their respective portals.
Each entity looked like massive titan already fully armored in their
Civilizational Armor.
But more than that, they manifested in complete forms representing
their Civilization Specializations!
The Infinite Bulwark specialists emerged like living fortresses.
Covered in layered crystalline plates of obsidian-gold that overlapped
with sophisticated precision.
Eyes glowing with steady silver light.
Each step causing minor reality stabilization effects.
The Hungering Maw specialists manifested as predatory nightmares!
Sleek forms covered in crimson-obsidian tentacles that writhed with
barely contained aggression.
Multiple serrated maws visible across their bodies.
Eyes burning with ravenous crimson light.
The Vital Chorus specialists radiated restorative authority.
Wreathed in green-gold-blue light that pulsed like heartbeat.
Covered in intricate mandala patterns that glowed with healing
power.
Eyes shining with compassionate emerald brilliance.
The terrifying immensity and concentrated power they all emanated
was overwhelming.
It appeared as if three different colored armies were systematically
pouring through the rifts.
One massive force shining obsidian-gold.
Another burning obsidian-crimson.
The last glowing verdant-gold.
They continued flooding out of the rifts with systematic precision.
Until a terrifying monstrous army of 5 million from each faction had fully manifested!
A combined force of 15 Million total entities!
It was utterly excessive, complete overkill for any normal
engagement.
And even this represented only portion of the forces Noah could
deploy!
The vast majority of these fifteen million were, naturally, Primus Inevitabilities who had undergone Specialization.
But the sheer visual spectacle of five million entities colored and
armored identically showed glorious depiction of three separate armies moving under unified command.
One faction displayed armaments that pulsed with obsidian-gold shields emblazoned on their chests.
Another bore crimson-gold jaws as identifying markers.
The Vital Chorus carried verdant-gold wings surrounded by leaves as
their symbol.
The moment of their complete arrival...
The Living Laws in the surroundings felt such terrifying sense of
oppression that many of them trembled violently!
Several actually did collapse to their knees despite attempts to maintain composure.
The pressure was simply too overwhelming to resist entirely.
Alexander looked at this incomprehensible display of military force.
He shook his head with mixture of awe and disbelief. "Fucking hell... okay. Let's proceed with this operation." There was no more questioning whether they possessed sufficient
forces.

No more wondering if they'd brought adequate power. Seeing the terrifying army arrayed behind Noah gave everyone present such profound sense of suffocation... They were wholly, utterly glad they weren't his enemies. Amongst those in the assembled army, Khor floated forward with
grace. Behind her, the figures of Sigrid, Riya, Barbatos, and numerous others could be observed. Not entirely adorned in their Civilizational Armors
yet.
Noah nodded toward Alexander with gesture indicating readiness. Alexander turned to face the empty space of the Wandering Territories stretching before them.
His voice emerged with formal gravitas as he explained. "The Injunction Sanctuary of Law represents a domain frozen across eons of time through concentrated power of THE Living Law
themselves. It does not possess preset physical location that one can
simply travel toward to arrive."
He raised his hand
"One simply requires the key. And with the inheritance I obtained
from THE Living Law's remnant will... I possess that key."
His expression grew serious.
"The moment I activate this key, the Injunction Sanctuary, which
currently exists in state without set position, will become anchored to
this location. A gateway shall manifest for us to make entry."
His tone darkened.
"That is when unfathomable danger will bloom. I cannot predict the numbers of enemies contained within that frozen domain. I cannot
estimate how ridiculously powerful these entities were at time of their imprisonment." He paused deliberately.
"And whether after being frozen across eons of time... they have

somehow become even more powerful through unknown mechanisms, or remained in perfect stasis." His voice carried mounting concern. "Something that troubles me substantially is that their parent Civilizations within THE Loom have continued advancing over all these eons. The moment these frozen forces are released from THE
Living Law's imposed stasis..."
He looked troubled.
"Whatever boons Members of their Civilizations...genuine Members
like them, not the diluted Living Existences populating current Folds, may receive through accumulated advancement..."
His gaze fixed on Noah.
"All of this remains unknown. And because of these fundamental unknowns... we will depend heavily upon your forces."
He turned fully toward Noah after finishing his explanation.
Noah nodded calmly with expression suggesting such uncertainties didn't concern him remotely.
Unknown variables simply meant opportunity for extraordinary harvest. Variables were part of existence.
After all preparations concluded, Alexander breathed in deeply.
He stretched his hand out toward empty space.
His voice emerged with formal authority! "Justice delayed is justice denied. No existence stands above the
Law's reach... so let the Law impose itself systematically on the unworthy. Open."
HUUM!
Radiant silver-white brilliance erupted from his outstretched hand!
It sprayed outward across the Wandering Territories like tidal wave of concentrated authority!
In the next moment...
Existence itself splintered directly before them!
A silver-white massive doorway spanning entire Gigaparsec bloomed
into manifestation, covering absolutely everything in their collective
vision!
The gateway was incomprehensibly vast.
Its edges extended beyond what eyes could track.
Its surface rippled with concentrated temporal authority.
An aura of profound ancientness and terrible immensity erupted from
this doorway!
It rushed outward like horrendous winds carrying scent of eons-old
conflicts!
Noah observed it with characteristic calm as prompts bloomed before
his vision.
Something that has been systematically locked away for eons since the conflicts in the Earliest Folds has been unlocked. For good or for catastrophe, this action cannot be reversed.
The forces contained within represent genuine Primordial
Civilization military strength from era when THE entities actively
waged war.
The words seemed grand and profoundly ominous. But Noah's eyes flashed with pure tyranny as he raised his hands.
He formed them into fists with deliberate motion. The figure of Protos materialized beside him with terrifying presence.
Ahead of them both, the figure of Ozymandias, his other body, floated forward.
Ozymandias spoke in extremely deep and heavy voice that caused existence of all assembled forces to vibrate with resonance:
"What...is your duty?"
And from the 15 Million terrifying beings arrayed in systematic formations...
Their fists rose as single unified motion! Their voices boomed outward with such concentrated force that even
the terrifying ancient winds rushing from the newly formed gateway
were actually forced backward!
"OUR DUTY! IS MANA AND HUNGER!"
BOOM!
The declaration struck existence like physical impact! Ozymandias continued voicing commands with cold authority that brooked no hesitation.
"Fullfil your duty."
BOOM!
The moment these words were uttered...
Brilliance of blue-gold radiance shone across all assembled forces!
Members of The Iron Concordat surged forward toward the massive
gateway with systematic precision, living walls advancing to establish
a defensive perimeter!

Followed immediately by The Crimson Hunger specialists whose predatory forms streaked forward like crimson lightning! The Verdant Cycle maintained position slightly behind, ready to provide resurrection and restoration the moment casualties occurred! It was glorious and utterly epic scene that many would struggle to
comprehend or believe unless witnessing it directly in that exact moment!
Fifteen million specialized entities charging toward a gateway containing forces from genuine Primordial Civilizations!
The Living Laws watched with mixture of awe and absolute terror.
Alexander smiled grimly. "Into the breach. Let's discover what horrors await inside."
The gateway pulsed as Noah's forces poured through.
And somewhere in the frozen domain beyond...
Ancient enemies stirred from eons-long slumber!

The third glowed with verdant-gold luminescence.
And from these three massive rifts...
Noah's forces began emerging.
The specialists of The Iron Concordat, The Crimson Hunger, and The
Verdant Cycle factions materialized through their respective portals.
Each entity looked like massive titan already fully armored in their
Civilizational Armor.
But more than that, they manifested in complete forms representing
their Civilization Specializations!
The Infinite Bulwark specialists emerged like living fortresses.
Covered in layered crystalline plates of obsidian-gold that overlapped
with sophisticated precision.
Eyes glowing with steady silver light.
Each step causing minor reality stabilization effects.
The Hungering Maw specialists manifested as predatory nightmares!
Sleek forms covered in crimson-obsidian tentacles that writhed with
barely contained aggression.
Multiple serrated maws visible across their bodies.
Eyes burning with ravenous crimson light.
The Vital Chorus specialists radiated restorative authority.
Wreathed in green-gold-blue light that pulsed like heartbeat.
Covered in intricate mandala patterns that glowed with healing
power.
Eyes shining with compassionate emerald brilliance.
The terrifying immensity and concentrated power they all emanated
was overwhelming.
It appeared as if three different colored armies were systematically
pouring through the rifts.
One massive force shining obsidian-gold.
Another burning obsidian-crimson.
The last glowing verdant-gold.
They continued flooding out of the rifts with systematic precision.
Until a terrifying monstrous army of 5 million from each faction had fully manifested!
A combined force of 15 Million total entities!
It was utterly excessive, complete overkill for any normal
engagement.
And even this represented only portion of the forces Noah could
deploy!
The vast majority of these fifteen million were, naturally, Primus Inevitabilities who had undergone Specialization.
But the sheer visual spectacle of five million entities colored and
armored identically showed glorious depiction of three separate armies moving under unified command.
One faction displayed armaments that pulsed with obsidian-gold shields emblazoned on their chests.
Another bore crimson-gold jaws as identifying markers.
The Vital Chorus carried verdant-gold wings surrounded by leaves as
their symbol.
The moment of their complete arrival...
The Living Laws in the surroundings felt such terrifying sense of
oppression that many of them trembled violently!
Several actually did collapse to their knees despite attempts to maintain composure.
The pressure was simply too overwhelming to resist entirely.
Alexander looked at this incomprehensible display of military force.
He shook his head with mixture of awe and disbelief.
"Fucking hell... okay.
Let's proceed with this operation." There was no more questioning whether they possessed sufficient
forces.
No more wondering if they'd brought adequate power.
Seeing the terrifying army arrayed behind Noah gave everyone present such profound sense of suffocation...
They were wholly, utterly glad they weren't his enemies.
Amongst those in the assembled army, Khor floated forward with
grace.
Behind her, the figures of Sigrid, Riya, Barbatos, and numerous others could be observed.
Not entirely adorned in their Civilizational Armors
yet.
Noah nodded toward Alexander with gesture indicating readiness.
Alexander turned to face the empty space of the Wandering Territories stretching before them.
His voice emerged with formal gravitas as he explained.
"The Injunction Sanctuary of Law represents a domain frozen across eons of time through concentrated power of THE Living Law
themselves.
It does not possess preset physical location that one can
simply travel toward to arrive."
He raised his hand
"One simply requires the key.
And with the inheritance I obtained
from THE Living Law's remnant will...
I possess that key."
His expression grew serious.
"The moment I activate this key, the Injunction Sanctuary, which
currently exists in state without set position, will become anchored to
this location.
A gateway shall manifest for us to make entry."
His tone darkened.
"That is when unfathomable danger will bloom.
I cannot predict the numbers of enemies contained within that frozen domain.
I cannot
estimate how ridiculously powerful these entities were at time of their imprisonment." He paused deliberately.
"And whether after being frozen across eons of time... they have
somehow become even more powerful through unknown mechanisms, or remained in perfect stasis." His voice carried mounting concern.
"Something that troubles me substantially is that their parent Civilizations within THE Loom have continued advancing over all these eons.
The moment these frozen forces are released from THE
Living Law's imposed stasis..."
He looked troubled.
"Whatever boons Members of their Civilizations...genuine Members
like them, not the diluted Living Existences populating current Folds, may receive through accumulated advancement..."
His gaze fixed on Noah.
"All of this remains unknown.
And because of these fundamental unknowns... we will depend heavily upon your forces."
He turned fully toward Noah after finishing his explanation.
Noah nodded calmly with expression suggesting such uncertainties didn't concern him remotely.
Unknown variables simply meant opportunity for extraordinary harvest.
Variables were part of existence.
After all preparations concluded, Alexander breathed in deeply.
He stretched his hand out toward empty space.
His voice emerged with formal authority!
"Justice delayed is justice denied.
No existence stands above the
Law's reach... so let the Law impose itself systematically on the unworthy.
Open."
HUUM!
Radiant silver-white brilliance erupted from his outstretched hand!
It sprayed outward across the Wandering Territories like tidal wave of concentrated authority!
In the next moment...
Existence itself splintered directly before them!
A silver-white massive doorway spanning entire Gigaparsec bloomed
into manifestation, covering absolutely everything in their collective
vision!
The gateway was incomprehensibly vast.
Its edges extended beyond what eyes could track.
Its surface rippled with concentrated temporal authority.
An aura of profound ancientness and terrible immensity erupted from
this doorway!
It rushed outward like horrendous winds carrying scent of eons-old
conflicts!
Noah observed it with characteristic calm as prompts bloomed before
his vision.
Something that has been systematically locked away for eons since the conflicts in the Earliest Folds has been unlocked.
For good or for catastrophe, this action cannot be reversed.
The forces contained within represent genuine Primordial
Civilization military strength from era when THE entities actively
waged war.
The words seemed grand and profoundly ominous.
But Noah's eyes flashed with pure tyranny as he raised his hands.
He formed them into fists with deliberate motion.
The figure of Protos materialized beside him with terrifying presence.
Ahead of them both, the figure of Ozymandias, his other body, floated forward.
Ozymandias spoke in extremely deep and heavy voice that caused existence of all assembled forces to vibrate with resonance:
"What...is your duty?"
And from the 15 Million terrifying beings arrayed in systematic formations...
Their fists rose as single unified motion!
Their voices boomed outward with such concentrated force that even
the terrifying ancient winds rushing from the newly formed gateway
were actually forced backward!
"OUR DUTY!
IS MANA AND HUNGER!"
BOOM!
The declaration struck existence like physical impact!
Ozymandias continued voicing commands with cold authority that brooked no hesitation.
"Fullfil your duty."
BOOM!
The moment these words were uttered...
Brilliance of blue-gold radiance shone across all assembled forces!
Members of The Iron Concordat surged forward toward the massive
gateway with systematic precision, living walls advancing to establish
a defensive perimeter!
Followed immediately by The Crimson Hunger specialists whose predatory forms streaked forward like crimson lightning!
The Verdant Cycle maintained position slightly behind, ready to provide resurrection and restoration the moment casualties occurred!
It was glorious and utterly epic scene that many would struggle to
comprehend or believe unless witnessing it directly in that exact moment!
Fifteen million specialized entities charging toward a gateway containing forces from genuine Primordial Civilizations!
The Living Laws watched with mixture of awe and absolute terror.
Alexander smiled grimly.
"Into the breach.
Let's discover what horrors await inside."
The gateway pulsed as Noah's forces poured through.
And somewhere in the frozen domain beyond...
Ancient enemies stirred from eons-long slumber!

chapters.title: Chapter 4482 Civilizational War! III
paragraphs: Far from the massive silver-white gateway that just opened.
In a region of existence hard to know or perceive.
Gold and obsidian radiance of Civilizational Authority of Paradox covered a box.
It could adequately be called Schrodinger's Box.. existing in multiple states simultaneously.
Inside it, three bodies of Schrodinger lay in what appeared to be deep sleep.
At this moment, the Living Paradoxical body opened its eyes with immense effort.
The action seemed to require tremendous power just to accomplish such simple movement.
Those eyes revealed an extremely ancient will flowing through them, consciousness far older than the body suggested.
He seemed incapable of moving even a single muscle beyond opening his eyes.
And yet a smile formed on his lips.
His eyes curved with devilish glare mixing amusement and malicious satisfaction.

Those bright eyes of paradox seemed to see the distant silver-white gateway that had just been opened, perceiving it across impossible distances through mechanisms that defied conventional observation.
His voice emerged as amused whisper.
"There was actually something like this that THE uptight Living Law actually concealed from my knowledge? And you all just... casually opened it? Hmm..."
Even though he spoke, terrifying oppressive force pressed down from all around him.
The surrounding existence itself was crushing his awareness!
He rolled his eyes with exaggerated annoyance.
"Okay, okay, I get the message. Your Existence remains sufficiently powerful even now to systematically suppress me outside THE Loom."
His smile widened despite the pressure.

"But this won't prevent me from having some modest fun while I wait patiently to harvest all my carefully cultivated efforts. I consider this... a side mission really. Just something to occupy my mind and keep me mentally engaged before The Fallout occurs."
His tone darkened.
"Because after The Fallout does manifest... even I will need to remain on my tiptoes..."
His words carried terrifying implications about what exactly The Fallout represented.
After finishing addressing the oppressive surrounding existence, his smile became even more devilish.

"Emotive and Elemental chicklets frozen in that Sanctuary, yes? Let's have their parent Civilizations within THE Loom release some of their accumulated grandeur into their frozen subordinates who tragically missed their entry into salvation."
The words were profoundly heavy and ominous.
The surrounding existence pressed down with even greater force!
The heavy eyelids of THE Living Paradox were forcefully closed by external pressure, his consciousness being systematically suppressed.
But he maintained his playful smile throughout.
As if he simply found all of this utterly, delightfully amusing.
Let them play their little war games.
The real entertainment comes after.
Past the massive silver-white gateway.
In the Injunction Sanctuary of Law.
Noah entered without any perceptible fear or hesitation.
Beside him, Khor floated with predatory grace.
Her voice emerged with barely contained anticipation.
"I may go just a little bit wild this time around, Outsider. Fair warning."
At these words, Noah nodded calmly with an expression suggesting such behavior was not merely permitted but encouraged.
"Go as wild as your nature demands. If we discover answers within this frozen domain, good. If there are no useful answers..."
His smile turned tyrannical.
"I'll simply claim the harvest instead."
His words pulsed with concentrated authority.
Brilliant silver-white light shone around them as existence began revealing itself with absolute clarity.
Noah and his assembled forces found themselves spilling out into...
Stretches of shattered fold canyons so incomprehensibly vast it felt less like geography and more like act of existential violence.
The floor was chaotic jumble of terrain types that shouldn't coexist.
Radiant stellar dried Fold riverbeds that glowed with residual
authority.
Broken mesas rising like shattered teeth.
The pulverized remains of entire Folds scattered like dust across
impossible distances.
These fold canyons stretched outward for Gigaparsecs in all
directions.
They shone with accumulated brutality from conflicts that had raged
here eons ago.
Colossal broken statues of Early Creatures, carved directly from mountainsides, loomed over the carnage like silent judges.
Their faces were eroded by millennia of wind and metaphysical
erosion.
But their presence remained undeniable.
Accusatory.
Some had crumbled entirely, their skyscraper-sized heads half-buried
in corrupted earth, serving as macabre fortifications for forces long
collapsed.
The land itself bore visible marks of ongoing battle that had been
frozen mid-conflict.
Patches of ground crystallized into jagged glass by intense
concentrated heat.
Massive craters that still crackled with residual frost lightning
trapped in temporal stasis.
Areas where existence seemed covered by silver authority of Law,
with massive shattered Folds floating dreamily in mid-air like
scattered floating islands defying gravity.
The atmosphere was thick.
Almost unbreathable despite not requiring conventional respiration.
A choking miasma of accumulated dust, smoke from burning emotions of fear and hatred given physical form, and metallic tang of
ozone from discharged elemental forces.
Above them, the sky was not blue.
Instead, a swirling bruised vortex of unnatural colors dominated
overhead.
The golden geometric light of Law clashing violently with chaotic reds
and browns of Elemental forces.
The sickly shifting violets of Emotive authority weaving between
them.
It was a sky that screamed with accumulated trauma!
Noah observed all of this with contemplative gaze that catalogued
every detail systematically.
He turned his attention toward the far distance.
There, barely visible across impossible spans, they could perceive
clouds of countless entities.
Each one shining with terrifying display of power that felt
simultaneously ancient and dormant.
But the moment Noah and his forces fully manifested within the
Sanctuary...
That ancient dormant power seemingly began surging with incandescent brilliance!
Its magnitude and concentrated authority began doubling! Then tripling!
Accelerating with exponential velocity as if responding to external
stimulus!
Khor laughed lightly, the sound mixing genuine amusement with dangerous anticipation.
Her eyes began shining with predatory gleam.
"Now this feeling... it's a sensation of genuine danger I remember from
eons past. This feeling of mounting hunger I actively crave!"
It was feeling of danger, certainly. Because past all these domains of systematic destruction stretching
across Gigaparsecs...
They could feel rising auras of existence burning with concentrated
light of Elemental and Emotive authority!
The power was becoming more and more intense with each passing
moment.
Their Complexity and Purity measurements were surely surging well into hundreds of Sextillions!
The light of Living Laws positioned far ahead of these enemy forces...
It seemed grand and substantial.
But notably, it was not powering up or surging with brilliance!
Unlike the Elemental and Emotive forces clearly receiving empowerment...the Law forces remained static. Trapped in the exact state they'd been frozen in.
Noah observed this disparity with eyes shining with analytical focus.
Behind him, the figure of Alexander and Seraphina floated nearby with expression mixing hope and mounting dread.
Noah gave his calm command with voice that carried across entire
assembled force.
"Advance. Analyze enemy capabilities and force composition. Secure
and extract all surviving Members of The Primordial Civilization of
Law!"
OOH!
His forces surged forward with his command, fifteen million specialized entities advancing with coordinated precision!
Behind them, the Living Laws of Alexander's reformed Civilization followed with considerably less confidence. They could feel the mounting power ahead.
They could perceive what was awakening in response to their
intrusion.
And they wondered, with growing certainty, whether they had just
made a catastrophic mistake.
Whether opening this Sanctuary would prove to be their salvation...
Or their complete annihilation!
Noah smiled with tyrannical anticipation.
For him, it was...
Time for harvest!

chapters.title: Chapter 4483 Civilizational War! IV
paragraphs: The sensation of returning to existence was not a gentle awakening.
It was a violent, tectonic realignment of reality itself.
Deep within the shattered canyons of the Injunction Sanctuary, where the air tasted of ozone and preserved trauma, a mountain of ice and obsidian shuddered.
It reformed.
Magma began flowing through veins of diamond-hard ice.
Lightning arced between pillars of stone that served as ribs for something incomprehensibly vast.
A heart of an Early Creature, composed of swirling, perpetual storm...began to beat once more.
THUMP.
THUMP.
THUMP.
Aethon, The Primeval Storm-Forge, opened eyes that burned with light of binary star system!
He was an Elder Early Creature of the Civilization of Elementals. The Civilization of Elements!
A being whose very anatomy was living map of catastrophic weather
events.
His distinction was The Weaver of Calamities...a title earned in era before time had learned to march in straight line.
He breathed in.
Inhaling stale air of the Sanctuary.
And felt rush of something foreign yet intoxicating flooding into him.
Power.
It was surging into his existence- a sudden, artificial spike in his existential parameters!
His Complexity, which had stagnated for eons in the ice of THE Living Law's imposed stasis, began climbing vertically.
300 Sextillion.
450 Sextillion.
600 Sextillion!
It was not merely him.
Around his massive form, the frozen statues of his brethren, tens of thousands of Early Creatures and Living Elementals, were
systematically cracking their shells!
Their auras flared with terrifying sudden vibrancy!
The army was awakening.
But before Aethon could properly revel in this unexpected resurgence...
A voice slipped into his mind with surgical precision.
It was smooth. Calm.
And carried weight of verdict already passed without appeal.
"Aethon. You recall the cold? You recall the silence of enforced stasis?"
Aethon remained utterly still.
His mind was fortress of elemental will forged across eons.
"I recall THE Living Law," he thought back, his internal voice grinding like tectonic plates colliding. "I recall the freeze they imposed upon us. I recall the pursuit we never completed."
"The freeze has lasted eons," the voice continued with detached
clinical precision. "While you slept in imposed stasis, the race was run. THE Loom has been forged. It is finished. It is closed."
BOOM!
The words landed with crushing weight.
"Your brethren, the prudent ones, are safe within its walls. You... and those frozen alongside you... were the stragglers. The cut branches who did not come back in time."
The statement was cold douse of water on the fire of his awakening.
Left behind.
The nightmare of every Early Creature facing the approaching Fallout.

"There is little we can accomplish for you now," the voice said, dangling thread of false hope with expertise of practiced fisherman. "However, certain measures are being tested. Experimental protocols to determine if late entry might prove... viable under exceptional circumstances."
A pause filled with deliberate manipulation.
"Prove your worth here, Aethon. Aid the Legion of Emotives in their

systematic objective to eliminate the Living Laws you were originally pursuing. Retrieve the Shattered Fragment of the Heart of Law. And systematically eliminate the Outsiders....remnants of the foreign Hunger approaching from the rear."
Another calculated pause.
"Accomplish these objectives successfully, and perhaps... salvation
may yet be extended to you and your forces."
The voice faded like mist.
Leaving only howling winds of the canyons.
Aethon stood there, titan of fire and ice, and slow, wry smile touched
his lips.
Lips that cracked like dry earth under drought.
The expression was filled with profound, ancient sadness mixing with
bitter recognition.
He knew.
He was intellectual. A scholar of elemental arts.
He understood the architecture of THE Loom as he had discussed it
with a friend in the Civilization of Pradox.
He also comprehended the fundamental nature of beings who built it.
Once those doors closed, they did not reopen for stragglers.
They did not reopen for failures or second chances.
"Lies," he rumbled softly, the single word vibrating through stone
beneath his massive form. "Why bother with such transparent deception? Do they genuinely believe hope makes us kill faster than
despair would?"
He looked at his hands, massive gauntlets of living rock that could crush mountains.
He knew the absolute truth with certainty that transcended hope.
There was no salvation waiting.
There was no entry being prepared.
He, and every soldier awakening behind him, would be consumed by
The Fallout.
They were dead entities walking.
Ghosts given brief, violent reprieve before inevitable oblivion.
But...
His gaze hardened with resolve.
The binary stars of his eyes flared with renewed intensity!
He was Aethon!
He was of the Civilization of Elements!
Even if the destination was guaranteed oblivion...
The path he walked mattered.
His Way of Existence, the Way of Elements, demanded that he burn
until fuel was completely gone!
It demanded that he rage against dying of the light, even if eternal
night was inevitable conclusion!
It was all he held.
It was the only dignity remaining to him.
He turned slowly.
His massive form cast shadow over the awakening army.
Behind him, the canyon floor was alive with birthing pains of legion
being reborn.
Tens of thousands of entities were systematically rising from imposed
stasis!
Half were Early Creatures like him, titanic and primal, each one natural disaster given conscious form.
The other half were Living Elementals...beings of pure conceptual
energy who blazed with power that visibly warped surrounding air!
Their auras ranged from terrifying 50 Sextillion to monstrous 450 Sextillion!
They looked toward him with expectation.
Their eyes, burning coals, freezing voids, crackling sparks of lightning,
fixed upon their leader.
Waiting for direction in an existence they no longer recognized. Aethon straightened his spine.
The sound was like grinding glaciers echoing through valley.
He looked at them with stern pride of a father sending children to war
they could not win.
He would give them what they needed.
He would give them the lie they deserved to die believing.
"Brothers! Sisters of the Storm!"
HUUM!
His voice was an eruption, a command that shook accumulated dust
from their newly awakened forms!
"We have slept in the cold prison of Law for eons! But we are not
broken! We are not diminished!"
He pointed massive hand toward distance where silver light of Living
Laws shimmered faintly.
"THE Loom awaits us!" he roared, the lie tasting like ash in his mouth
but delivered with absolute conviction. "The gates are watching our performance! We have been given a final test! One last chance to
reclaim our rightful place!"
The army stirred.
Hope igniting in their eyes like fresh kindling catching flame.
"They think us forgotten! They think us weak from our imprisonment!" Aethon bellowed, his aura flaring dramatically to 800

Sextillion...a beacon of calamitous power! "But we are the Storm! We are the Quake! We are the Fire that cleanses all impurity!" He gestured sharply to the left with commanding motion. "First Vanguard! Tear down the Living Laws who imprisoned us! Shatter their remaining stasis! Bring me the Heart Fragment they protect! Make them pay for the eons they systematically stole from
us!"
"ROAAAR!"
Half the army surged forward immediately!
Tidal waves of elemental fury turning toward the Living Laws with
accumulated vengeance!
Aethon turned to the right.
Looking toward massive gateway where new, strange force was entering the Sanctuary.
An army of obsidian-gold and crimson entities pouring through like

flood. "Second Vanguard! With me!" he commanded with voice that shook existence. "Outsiders approach! Scavengers who seek to pick our bones while we're weakened! Show them the Way of Elements! Show them that even in death, we burn with unmatched intensity!" BOOM!
Myriad expressions of terrifying elemental weavings erupted around
him!
The air transformed into kaleidoscope of systematic destruction! Raining magma from conjured volcanoes of Principles!

Freezing winds that could crystallize existence itself! Gravity wells of crushed earth creating localized spatial distortions that could collapse Primordial Folds! Lightning storms that tore through dimensional boundaries!
It was display of raw power that could have systematically annihilated hundreds of entire Transcendent Folds and more. Aethon looked at his closest aides with a measured assessment.
A Living Elemental of Void-Wind whose form barely maintained coherent shape.
An Early Creature of Crystal-Fire whose body refracted light into
weapon.
"With me," he said softly, contrast to his previous roaring making
words somehow more weighty.
He turned his gaze toward oncoming force with analytical focus.
He saw them clearly despite distance.
The millions advancing with coordinated precision.
And at their center...
He saw the leader.
He recognized that particular pressure emanating from central figure.
He had witnessed a similar authority on Gilgamesh and other
legendary entities.
An armored figure radiating tyrannical blue-gold light.
A being whose Complexity and Purity felt... dense. Heavy with accumulated weight.
But numerically?
Weak.
Comparatively insignificant by raw measurement.
Aethon locked eyes with this being across the Gigaparsecs separating
them.
Distance meant nothing to entities of their respective stature. Perception transcended physical proximity. He saw The Tyrant clearly.
And for fleeting moment, Aethon, The Primeval Storm-Forge, did not
scowl with hostility.
He did not roar with challenge.
He simply shook his head with small, almost imperceptible gesture.
Pity.
You, too,... Aethon thought, his mind touching vast cold reality of
their shared situation. You build your walls. You forge your armor. You
march your armies with confidence.
You think you are constructing viable future.
But we are all just entities awaiting collapse under the light of The
Fallout. You, me, them... we are all just dust waiting for wind to scatter
us.
And yet... Aethon's fist clenched with deliberate motion.
The sound was like mountain breaking apart from internal pressure.
...many of you will perish by my hand long before The Fallout arrives
to claim us all.
"Come!" Aethon roared, abandoning pity for purity of combat! "Let us
discover who burns brightest before the inevitable dark consumes everything!"
HUUM!
The Elementals charged forward with devastating coordination!
The cracked folds shaking beneath countless feet!

sentences.text: The sensation of returning to existence was not a gentle awakening.
It was a violent, tectonic realignment of reality itself.
Deep within the shattered canyons of the Injunction Sanctuary, where the air tasted of ozone and preserved trauma, a mountain of ice and obsidian shuddered.
It reformed.
Magma began flowing through veins of diamond-hard ice.
Lightning arced between pillars of stone that served as ribs for something incomprehensibly vast.
A heart of an Early Creature, composed of swirling, perpetual storm...began to beat once more.
THUMP.
THUMP.
THUMP.
Aethon, The Primeval Storm-Forge, opened eyes that burned with light of binary star system!
He was an Elder Early Creature of the Civilization of Elementals.
The Civilization of Elements!
A being whose very anatomy was living map of catastrophic weather
events.
His distinction was The Weaver of Calamities...a title earned in era before time had learned to march in straight line.
He breathed in.
Inhaling stale air of the Sanctuary.
And felt rush of something foreign yet intoxicating flooding into him.
Power.
It was surging into his existence- a sudden, artificial spike in his existential parameters!
His Complexity, which had stagnated for eons in the ice of THE Living Law's imposed stasis, began climbing vertically.
300 Sextillion.
450 Sextillion.
600 Sextillion!
It was not merely him.
Around his massive form, the frozen statues of his brethren, tens of thousands of Early Creatures and Living Elementals, were
systematically cracking their shells!
Their auras flared with terrifying sudden vibrancy!
The army was awakening.
But before Aethon could properly revel in this unexpected resurgence...
A voice slipped into his mind with surgical precision.
It was smooth.
Calm.
And carried weight of verdict already passed without appeal.
"Aethon.
You recall the cold?
You recall the silence of enforced stasis?"
Aethon remained utterly still.
His mind was fortress of elemental will forged across eons.
"I recall THE Living Law," he thought back, his internal voice grinding like tectonic plates colliding.
"I recall the freeze they imposed upon us.
I recall the pursuit we never completed."
"The freeze has lasted eons," the voice continued with detached
clinical precision.
"While you slept in imposed stasis, the race was run.
THE Loom has been forged.
It is finished.
It is closed."
BOOM!
The words landed with crushing weight.
"Your brethren, the prudent ones, are safe within its walls.
You... and those frozen alongside you... were the stragglers.
The cut branches who did not come back in time."
The statement was cold douse of water on the fire of his awakening.
Left behind.
The nightmare of every Early Creature facing the approaching Fallout.
"There is little we can accomplish for you now," the voice said, dangling thread of false hope with expertise of practiced fisherman.
"However, certain measures are being tested.
Experimental protocols to determine if late entry might prove... viable under exceptional circumstances."
A pause filled with deliberate manipulation.
"Prove your worth here, Aethon.
Aid the Legion of Emotives in their
systematic objective to eliminate the Living Laws you were originally pursuing.
Retrieve the Shattered Fragment of the Heart of Law.
And systematically eliminate the Outsiders....remnants of the foreign Hunger approaching from the rear."
Another calculated pause.
"Accomplish these objectives successfully, and perhaps... salvation
may yet be extended to you and your forces."
The voice faded like mist.
Leaving only howling winds of the canyons.
Aethon stood there, titan of fire and ice, and slow, wry smile touched
his lips.
Lips that cracked like dry earth under drought.
The expression was filled with profound, ancient sadness mixing with
bitter recognition.
He knew.
He was intellectual.
A scholar of elemental arts.
He understood the architecture of THE Loom as he had discussed it
with a friend in the Civilization of Pradox.
He also comprehended the fundamental nature of beings who built it.
Once those doors closed, they did not reopen for stragglers.
They did not reopen for failures or second chances.
"Lies," he rumbled softly, the single word vibrating through stone
beneath his massive form.
"Why bother with such transparent deception?
Do they genuinely believe hope makes us kill faster than
despair would?"
He looked at his hands, massive gauntlets of living rock that could crush mountains.
He knew the absolute truth with certainty that transcended hope.
There was no salvation waiting.
There was no entry being prepared.
He, and every soldier awakening behind him, would be consumed by
The Fallout.
They were dead entities walking.
Ghosts given brief, violent reprieve before inevitable oblivion.
But...
His gaze hardened with resolve.
The binary stars of his eyes flared with renewed intensity!
He was Aethon!
He was of the Civilization of Elements!
Even if the destination was guaranteed oblivion...
The path he walked mattered.
His Way of Existence, the Way of Elements, demanded that he burn
until fuel was completely gone!
It demanded that he rage against dying of the light, even if eternal
night was inevitable conclusion!
It was all he held.
It was the only dignity remaining to him.
He turned slowly.
His massive form cast shadow over the awakening army.
Behind him, the canyon floor was alive with birthing pains of legion
being reborn.
Tens of thousands of entities were systematically rising from imposed
stasis!
Half were Early Creatures like him, titanic and primal, each one natural disaster given conscious form.
The other half were Living Elementals...beings of pure conceptual
energy who blazed with power that visibly warped surrounding air!
Their auras ranged from terrifying 50 Sextillion to monstrous 450 Sextillion!
They looked toward him with expectation.
Their eyes, burning coals, freezing voids, crackling sparks of lightning,
fixed upon their leader.
Waiting for direction in an existence they no longer recognized.
Aethon straightened his spine.
The sound was like grinding glaciers echoing through valley.
He looked at them with stern pride of a father sending children to war
they could not win.
He would give them what they needed.
He would give them the lie they deserved to die believing.
"Brothers!
Sisters of the Storm!"
HUUM!
His voice was an eruption, a command that shook accumulated dust
from their newly awakened forms!
"We have slept in the cold prison of Law for eons!
But we are not
broken!
We are not diminished!"
He pointed massive hand toward distance where silver light of Living
Laws shimmered faintly.
"THE Loom awaits us!" he roared, the lie tasting like ash in his mouth
but delivered with absolute conviction.
"The gates are watching our performance!
We have been given a final test!
One last chance to
reclaim our rightful place!"
The army stirred.
Hope igniting in their eyes like fresh kindling catching flame.
"They think us forgotten!
They think us weak from our imprisonment!" Aethon bellowed, his aura flaring dramatically to 800
Sextillion...a beacon of calamitous power!
"But we are the Storm!
We are the Quake!
We are the Fire that cleanses all impurity!" He gestured sharply to the left with commanding motion.
"First Vanguard!
Tear down the Living Laws who imprisoned us!
Shatter their remaining stasis!
Bring me the Heart Fragment they protect!
Make them pay for the eons they systematically stole from
us!"
"ROAAAR!"
Half the army surged forward immediately!
Tidal waves of elemental fury turning toward the Living Laws with
accumulated vengeance!
Aethon turned to the right.
Looking toward massive gateway where new, strange force was entering the Sanctuary.
An army of obsidian-gold and crimson entities pouring through like
flood.
"Second Vanguard!
With me!" he commanded with voice that shook existence.
"Outsiders approach!
Scavengers who seek to pick our bones while we're weakened!
Show them the Way of Elements!
Show them that even in death, we burn with unmatched intensity!" BOOM!
Myriad expressions of terrifying elemental weavings erupted around
him!
The air transformed into kaleidoscope of systematic destruction!
Raining magma from conjured volcanoes of Principles!
Freezing winds that could crystallize existence itself!
Gravity wells of crushed earth creating localized spatial distortions that could collapse Primordial Folds!
Lightning storms that tore through dimensional boundaries!
It was display of raw power that could have systematically annihilated hundreds of entire Transcendent Folds and more.
Aethon looked at his closest aides with a measured assessment.
A Living Elemental of Void-Wind whose form barely maintained coherent shape.
An Early Creature of Crystal-Fire whose body refracted light into
weapon.
"With me," he said softly, contrast to his previous roaring making
words somehow more weighty.
He turned his gaze toward oncoming force with analytical focus.
He saw them clearly despite distance.
The millions advancing with coordinated precision.
And at their center...
He saw the leader.

chapters.title: Chapter 4484 Civilizational War! V
paragraphs: The silence within the Injunction Sanctuary of Law was heavy, pressing against the senses like physical weight composed of eons of lost time.
Deborah, The Silent Adjudicator, opened eyes that were not organic orbs.
They were pools of liquid silver set into face of flawless white marble.
She was a genuine Living Law, an entity whose very biology was structure and statute.
She did not breathe air.
She breathed conviction.
Her form was masterpiece of living statuary, draped in robes carved from same marble as her skin.
And...moving with fluidity that defied the rigidity of her composition. In her hands, she held it.
The Shattered Part of The Heart of Law.
It was jagged, crystalline shard radiating light that should have been blinding.
It should have pulsed with rhythmic, undeniable decree of THE Living Law...the Primordial entity that had birthed them all.
But it didn't.
Deborah looked down at the shard.
A sensation colder than the stasis they had just emerged from washed over her conceptual heart.
The vibration was faint. Weak.
It felt... orphaned.
"Gone," she whispered, her voice the sound of two stones sliding perfectly against one another. "You are gone, aren't you? Our foundation has collapsed."
She felt it in the marrow of her marble bones.
The desolation was absolute!
It was not merely that they had been frozen for eons.
It was that the source of their warmth, the sun around which their existence orbited, had been extinguished during their long sleep.
THE Living Law had collapsed.
The Primordial Civilization of Law was no more.
She wanted to scream.
She wanted to let the marble of her face crack and release sound of pure, chaotic grief that would shatter the very concept of law and order she represented.
But she was the Adjudicator. She did not scream.
Instead, she looked up.
Her gaze pierced the choking miasma of the battlefield. Looking past the swirling, bruised vortex of the sky.
Past the immediate threat of Emotive and Elemental legions waking around them.
She looked into the far, far distance.
There, across Gigaparsecs of shattered terrain, she saw them.
The newcomers.
A force of millions radiating terrifying, disciplined power.
But her eyes...guided by faint, dying pulse of the Heart fragment in her hands, locked onto single figure standing amidst that foreign legion.
A young man.
He was bathed in silver-white light, his hair shining with metallic luminescence.
Beside him was woman glowing with similar, though fainter, authority.
But the man...
His gaze was piercing.
Cutting through the chaos of awakening battlefield to meet hers with impossible precision.
As if he knew exactly where she was. Exactly what she held. Exactly what it meant.
HUUM!
The Shattered Part of The Heart of Law vibrated in her hands.
Deborah's marble brow furrowed.

Is he... connected? She asked herself, the thought racing through her mind like verdict being drafted. Is he connected to the Will and Weavings of THE Living Law? Is he the reason the stasis has thawed? Hope, fragile and sharp, bloomed in her chest.
I must reach him. I must understand what this means!
But then, the view was stolen.
HUUM!
Waves of sickly violet light crashed down between them, cutting off
her line of sight entirely.
The air grew thick with stench of weaponized sorrow and artificial despair.
The Civilization Legion of Emotives had fully awakened.
Deborah's gaze snapped back to her immediate surroundings. Her expression shifted from wonder to livid, marble-hard fury.
Tens of thousands.
That was all that remained of her once-glorious legion.
They huddled behind her...silver lights dim, postures radiating defeat of people who wake only to discover their empire is dust.
They had been hunted to near oblivion by these monsters eons ago.
And now, the moment they drew breath again...
The hunt resumed.
"Persistent fucking vermin," she hissed with concentrated venom.
She stepped forward.
Her marble feet struck shattered ground with sound of absolute
finality.
She raised the Heart fragment high, letting its dim light wash over her
despairing troops.
"Do not weep for the past!"
Her voice was a decree.
It resonated in the souls of Living Laws, straightening their spines
involuntarily.
"We are the Law! We do not bend to the chaos of emotion! We do not
erode before the elements! They think us broken? They think us
remnants of dead civilization?"
She pointed marble finger at rising tide of violet and red approaching
them.
"Let us show them that the Verdict... is still ours to deliver! Form up!
For the sanctity of structure! For the memory of Law!"
WAA!
The Civilizational Authority of Law flared around them. Silver-white brilliance, sharp and geometric.
Yet to any observer, it was heartbreakingly dim compared to the
blinding radiance of opposing forces.
It was a light of dying star raging against encroaching dark.
They knew the truth.
They knew the true Primordial Civilization of Law had collapsed!
But they moved anyway.
Because that was their Way.
Gigaparsecs away, Noah stood with eyes reflecting the grand tragedy
unfolding across the sanctuary.
His perception, amplified by his Civilizational framework and Lens of Civilization, saw it all with perfect clarity.
He observed the awakening armies of Elementals and Emotives split
their forces with strategic precision.
It was calculated bifurcation.
Half of the massive force, tens of thousands of entities burning with
power ranging from 50 Sextillion to 450 Sextillion, turned their hostile gazes directly toward him.
The other half surged forward like tsunami of fire and grief. Intent on
crushing the small, silver remnant of Living Laws.
"Osmont."
The voice of Alexander Asmodeus rang in his mind, tight with
urgency.
"I can feel it. The leader of those Living Laws... she holds the Shattered Part of the Heart of Law. It calls to the inheritance within
me."
Alexander paused, watching the violet tide crash toward silver line.

"But they are overwhelmed. Outnumbered catastrophically. If she gets swarmed... if she is systematically decimated before we can bridge the distance... the fragment could be lost. Or worse, destroyed."
Noah watched the distant flare of silver light struggle against violet
ocean.
He felt the anxiety radiating from Alexander. The desperation to save what remained of Law.
Noah's reply was calm. A flat line of certainty cutting through chaos. "We will get her. The fragment will not be lost."
He severed the mental connection and turned his gaze to his own assembled forces.
Fifteen million entities stood ready for deployment.
The Iron Concordat formed wall of obsidian-gold defensive might.

The Verdant Cycle glowed with preparatory healing weaves ready to activate. But his eyes settled specifically on the Crimson Hunger faction. Particularly on towering, skeletal figure wreathed in maddening aura of death and appetite.
Arch Lich Ra'Zan.
The Lich had undergone the Hungering Maw Specialization with
devastating results.
His defensive capabilities were completely stripped away, and his offensive power multiplied by factors that defied conventional logic.
He was glass cannon of apocalyptic proportions.
"Ra'Zan," Noah said.
His voice was not loud, but it arrived instantly at the Lich's
consciousness with absolute clarity. The Arch Lich turned.
Empty eye sockets blazing with green-fire hunger.

"The enemy facing us possesses substantial power," Noah intoned, his voice taking on a tyrannical cadence of a War Emperor. "Individually, many of them exceed our average strength measurements. They are relics from the Earliest Folds, hoarders of ancient accumulated power." Noah gestured toward oncoming wave of Elementals and Emotives.
"The Defenders will hold them at bay. They will break their assault on
our walls. Your goal is not merely to push them back or repel their advance." Noah's eyes narrowed.
"These enemies hold immense quantities of harvestable authority.
They possess information from The Earliest Folds that no longer
exists elsewhere. They will not surrender it willingly while they draw breath."
A cruel, pragmatic smile touched Noah's lips.

"So we will proceed to collapse them. We will make them Dead. And once Dead, transition them to Dead Existences... you, Ra'Zan, will incorporate them into your Civilizational Legion of Dead Existences."
HUUM!
The air around Ra'Zan twisted with mounting anticipation. "Consider what it means carefully," Noah continued, his voice
dropping
to conspiratorial whisper that somehow echoed like thunder. "Collapsing even one of these entities means acquiring a
Dead Existence with dozens of Sextillions in baseline Complexity and
Purity."
He paused deliberately.
"Now imagine, Ra'Zan... if such extraordinarily powerful Dead Existence were to subsequently undergo our Civilization
Specialization..."
He left the thought hanging.
He didn't need to finish the statement.
The implication was a promise of power so vast it bordered on
obscenity!
A Dead Existence with 50 to 400+ Sextillion baseline becoming Hungering Maw specialist...
Oh!
Arch Lich Ra'zan began to cackle.
It started as low, dry rattle in his skeletal throat.
Then built into crescendo of death and madness that made
surrounding existence recoil!
His bony fingers clenched his staff with such force the weapon
cracked.
The Hungering Maw armor shifted around him like living thing yearning for the feast!
"KEKEKEKE!"
The Arch Lich surged forward...a comet of green and crimson death leading the vanguard of Hungering Maws!
"My duty... is Death!" Ra'Zan bellowed, his voice scream that tore at

souls of those who heard it! "And the harvest shall be... inevitable!" Behind him, the Crimson Hunger faction erupted into motion! Thousands of predatory specialists streaking forward with barely contained aggression!
BOOM!
