chapters.title: Chapter 4505: The Infinite Unfurling! II
paragraphs: When Noah thought about the terrifying capabilities of the Unquantifiable Unit of Everything and what it could do, many other possibilities flooded his mind.
His thoughts wandered to his Early Atlas of the Folds, to the feature that had always held immense promise and danger in equal measure.
Temporal Traversal!
He always knew how desperately he needed more knowledge regarding existence, and one of the foremost places to attain this knowledge was The Earliest Folds themselves!
If he used the product ofTHE Organ of Civilizationto power up his Temporal Traversal, how far back could he go? How pristine would the environment be? What secrets could he uncover?
The more he thought about it, the more his eyes shone brightly.
And then, without his conscious command...
|The Unquantifiable Units of Everythingdeem this action worthy of use. OneUnquantifiable Unit of Everythinghas flown into your Atlas.|
Noah’s eyes opened wide with alarm as he tried to speak.
"Hey, hold on!"
He was only just thinking about this as an abstract possibility! He wasn’t ready yet to actually execute such a journey!

And yet, his existence seemed to have found something it could not let go of, as if his very being had made a decision independent of his conscious mind. Even hisTHE Organ of Civilizationbuzzed with urgent resonance!
And before he could do anything else to stop the process...

|THE Organ of Civilizationunequivocally agrees with your line of thought. Unforeseen dangers have been detected with this Temporal Traversal due to your Existence being inherently different compared to all previous times. 2 additionalUnquantifiable Units of Everythinghave flown into your Atlas.An Absolute Civilizational Temporal Traversal is beginning.|
A rapid flashing of prompts appeared and disappeared in microseconds!
And right after...
WAP!
Noah disappeared from the Cultivation Citadel entirely!

A moment after he vanished, The Infiniverse appeared where he used to be. Her existence pulsed with newfound power from the recent empowerment, and the illusory figure of RUIN/EDEN materialized alongside her.

"Something unexpected occurred and he is going through Temporal Traversal rather early," RUIN/EDEN said with concern coloring her voice. "It seems to be unlike any other time before. His entire existence was pulled through."
The Infiniverse nodded at these words as she gazed at the empty space where Noah had been burning.
"Everything is as it can be," she said with calm acceptance. "Existence will continue to be unpredictable, and we can only continue to do what we can. Take care of him there."
After such words, The Infiniverse disappeared to attend to the countless tasks that required her attention!
A few seconds ago.
In the Injunction Sanctuary of Law.

Deborah stood before all remaining members of the Civilizational Legion of Law, her posture rigid with the weight of command. She gazed at the flaming bodies of Noah and Ozymandias with complex emotions.
At this moment, millions of Primus Inevitabilities surrounded them in protective formations alongside Aethon and his Civilizational Legion of Elementals who had sworn new allegiance.
All Emotives had been collapsed and mainly devoured by Ozymandias in this terrifying battle, and many still couldn’t believe how things had unfolded so dramatically.
At this moment, Deborah was about to take out the Shattered Part of The Heart of Law to give to Alexander when...
WAP!

Noah and Ozymandias’s flaming figures disappeared without warning! Ozymandias actually turned into a streak of light that shot across the space and disappeared into Noah’s body before both vanished completely!
Alexander and the others watched in astonishment as Noah simply ceased to exist before them.
Khor frowned for a moment with concern before she steadied herself as if she had received news through their connection. She turned to address the assembled forces.
"Continue with the mission," she said with absolute authority. "The Outsider is simply taking care of other matters."
Other matters.
Very few knew the ultimate truth about what had just occurred!
Unlike before, unlike previous Temporal Traversals where Noah could send a single body or clone and keep other instances behind to maintain presence...
This Temporal Traversal had taken every single ounce of his being.
As of this moment, Noah Osmont did not exist in this era at all!
Across weavings of existence.

Noah’s expression was solemn as the transition occurred, but he rapidly adapted his thinking. He understood that 3Unquantifiable Units of Everythinghad been consumed to power up what must be a ridiculous Temporal Traversal!
An Absolute Civilizational Temporal Traversalat that.

He observed his surroundings with careful attention and found himself surrounded by an intense and immense storm of existence that felt much wilder and more primal than any previous Temporal Traversal.
New prompts bloomed before his vision.
|ABSOLUTE CIVILIZATIONAL TEMPORAL TRAVERSAL - ACTIVE|
|Previously, your existence did not contain even a single iota ofTHE. You were able to freely use the unimaginable feature of Temporal Traversal with your Atlas as this alone was an impossibility.|
|When paired with a fairly weak entity utilizing such a feature, you were able to pass through the temporal gaps without being noticed byTHE Living Temporal.|

|Current Status: At this moment, you holdTHE Organ of Civilization.Even though your power is heading towards the right direction, you are still considered weak while holding an aspect budding withTHE.|
|Warning: It is significantly harder to pass through the gaps unnoticed.THE Living Temporalhas a high chance of discovering your movements.|

|Solution Implemented: For the sake of caution, the utility ofThe Unquantifiable Units of Everythinghas allowed your existence to traverse much further back than before, to a time beforeTHE Living Temporalhad much influence on the Temporal Weavings of Existence. You have been dropped in a region that would grant you the highest chance of survival, near Weavings of Existence that match your Civilization.|
|Current Location:You have arrived before The Earliest Folds. Extreme caution advised.|

The prompts were heavy with implications. Moments after they bloomed and faded, Noah’s existence pulsed with terrifying luminosity. His Sovereign Spires resonated with each other in harmonic frequencies until...
BOOM!
He felt space break and reform around him before darkness and light folded and collapsed in patterns. And he instantly found himself elsewhere entirely.
The moment he arrived, waves of ancient authority began to flood into his existence like water filling a vessel.

He found himself standing on what appeared to be an extremely tall crystalline obsidian mountain peak that stretched upward for what might have been miles. Misty clouds that even obscured his enhanced vision permeated all around in thick layers.

In the far distance, other massive crystalline obsidian mountain peaks could barely be seen through the mist. Some seemed to be growing upside down, defying conventional understanding of gravity and orientation!

The skies above and the supposed earth below were both filled with rising obsidian crystalline mountains in configurations of utter glory. Some mountains floated freely in the air, rotating slowly. Others grew in spirals that twisted through multiple dimensions.
The domain around him felt like his existence could continue drinking in the atmosphere forever and never be satisfied. It felt ancient beyond measure, old in a way that transcended simple time!
The air itself carried weight, each breath filling his lungs with authority that had existed since before existence learned to organize itself.

Between the mountain peaks, he could see what looked like rivers of liquid light flowing upward and downward simultaneously, defying direction. Crystalline structures that might have been buildings or might have been natural formations dotted some of the peaks in the distance.
The mist itself seemed alive, pulsing with patterns that suggested consciousness or at least awareness.
And everywhere,everywhere, there was the sensation of potential. As if this place existed before things had been decided, before reality had committed to specific rules!
New prompts rose a moment later.
|You have arrived in a place and time that THE Organ of Civilization has quantified as The Infinite Unfurling.|
|Definition: The period before The Earliest Folds solidified into distinct realities.|
|Critical Warning: The entirety of your existence is present in this location. You have no backup of yourself remaining in your home era.|
|Extreme Caution Required: You must move with immense care. The littlest thing has the potential to unmake your existence completely.|
|The rules of reality here are not yet fixed. What is impossible in your era may be commonplace here, and vice versa.|
The tiniest thing had the potential to unmake his existence completely!
And he was here with all of his being. Ozymandias was merged inside this body, and as he stood on the obsidian crystalline mountain peak, his figure was like a candle flame in the vast darkness.
Crimson-gold flames ofTHE Immolation Of The Sacrilegious Savagestill burned around him, marking him as something foreign in this ancient place!
How should he go about exploring this environment without triggering catastrophe?
"Ho? What’s this?"
A booming yet calm voice filled with profound immensity echoed out across the mountain peak.

Without Noah noticing any approach or movement, a humanoid figure peeled back the layers of existence in front of him as if he had always been standing there this whole time and Noah simply couldn’t perceive him until now.
He showed himself fully and looked at Noah up and down with analytical interest burning in eyes that held abyssal folds!
Noah’s expression became unfathomably heavy as he stared at this humanoid being whose voice continued to echo across the mountains.

The figure was tall and lean, his form seemingly composed of shifting shadows and hungry voids. His skin looked like night sky filled with dying stars. His eyes were black holes that consumed light rather than reflected it.
And around him, space itself bent inward as if reality wanted to be devoured by his mere presence.
"I was about to take a bite of you, you know,"the entity said with casual menace. "You feel like something that does not belong here. Something... displaced."
He tilted his head with curious intensity.
"Who are you, Outsider? And why do you give off the scent of my Hunger?"
A profound and terrifying sense of suffocation spread out from the entity like a physical force. The pressure made Noah’s newly elevated 63 Septillion Complexity feel insignificant!
The entity before Noah burned with the unmistakable allure ofTHE.
He had met aTHEExistence mere seconds after his entry into a place before The Earliest Folds, intoThe Infinite Unfurlingitself!
But for good or bad, he could say with certainty that he knew this being!

The figure was tall and lean, his form seemingly composed of shifting shadows and hungry voids.
His skin looked like night sky filled with dying stars.
His eyes were black holes that consumed light rather than reflected it.
And around him, space itself bent inward as if reality wanted to be devoured by his mere presence.
"I was about to take a bite of you, you know,"the entity said with casual menace.
"You feel like something that does not belong here.
Something... displaced."
He tilted his head with curious intensity.
"Who are you, Outsider?
And why do you give off the scent of my Hunger?"
A profound and terrifying sense of suffocation spread out from the entity like a physical force.
The pressure made Noah’s newly elevated 63 Septillion Complexity feel insignificant!
The entity before Noah burned with the unmistakable allure ofTHE.
He had met aTHEExistence mere seconds after his entry into a place before The Earliest Folds, intoThe Infinite Unfurlingitself!
But for good or bad, he could say with certainty that he knew this being!

chapters.title: Chapter 4506: The Infinite Unfurling! III
paragraphs: Noah looked at the entity in front of him as he rapidly analyzed the situation. It could be considered extremely perilous or fortuitous depending on how he handled the next few moments.

No, when truly considered on the spectrum of danger versus opportunity, if he ever had to meet an existence at the next scale of power, this entity would be among those that would be the most ideal to come across.
So his eyes shone brightly with calculated brilliance as he spoke carefully.
"What your senses detect can be considered a form of your Hunger," Noah said with measured words. "But it emerges eons down the line from this moment."

At these words, the entity in front of him smiled with genuine interest before he came just a bit closer towards Noah. His skin truly looked like a night sky filled with dying stars, and with his dark flowing hair and eyes that held the depth of black holes, it was like staring into the gaze of one of the most apex predators in existence.

"Eons down the line, huh?" the entity said with contemplative curiosity. "That would explain why you do not belong here, why your existence feels displaced. But even then, the purity of this Hunger I sense would be something that could only come from me directly... well, or from someone that has a similar authority to mine."
He leaned in slightly.
"Who shared this Hunger with you, Outsider?"
Noah looked at him calmly as he said with simple honesty, "Khor."
The name caused the eyes of this being, of Tor, to open wide with shock!
His face went through a range of emotions in rapid succession. Surprise bloomed first, then morphed into worry, then shifted to caution before it ultimately settled into calm acceptance.
He looked at Noah silently for a long moment before he sighed deeply and gazed out at the surrounding landscape of inverted mountains and flowing light.
"That little runt? She wouldn’t be able to share my Hunger with another unless something significant happened to her," he said quietly. "Is she okay? Tell me truly."
Noah replied with calm certainty, "She is okay."
At these words, this terrifyingly powerful entity simply nodded with visible relief.
"Then there is more than enough,"he said, his tension easing. "Since you do exhibit the same Hunger within your existence, you can be considered a junior of mine in the Way."
His analytical gaze swept over Noah again.

"Why are you playing with temporal weavings of existence and coming to a place where many things could collapse you in the span of an instant? Even more than that, how did you get the flames of an Elemental sovereignty to be burning your existence?"
He tilted his head with curiosity.

"Did you meet someone here before me? But they would have simply collapsed you and eaten you up as I don’t see the reason for them to torture you like this. Oh, were you branded with this flame where you come from?"
Noah’s eyes opened wider as he felt his existence buzzing. He nodded as he said, "A brand was given to me by a fiery pathetic fucker who can’t even appear in front of me directly."
Tor laughed at his words with genuine amusement.

"Outsider, you are so quick to insult beings who could squash you if they were here in person," he said with entertained approval. "Oh well, I am sure that it is no fun to have that blazing around your existence constantly."
He paused thoughtfully.
"I could move to erase that right now with minimal effort. But would it not be better, would you not feel more satisfied, if you took care of it yourself?"
Noah’s eyes shined with understanding at such words. He looked at this being who was smiling with encouragement and asked the critical question.
"How would I gain the power to erase the flames of an entity withTHEdesignation?" Noah asked. "Only THE Civilizational Authority can go against THE Civilizational Authority."
His eyes pulsed with immensity as he said this fundamental truth.

Tor nodded with approval as he responded, "Yeah, that’s accurate. And although you can be considered far from THE currently, I can see that you have begun developing something with such a designation within your existence."
He gestured to Noah’s form analytically.

"It may be the only reason that you can stand in a place like this which could kill you in so many different ways. It means that you have taken a step on the path, and taking a step is already halfway to reaching the destination."
His smile widened.

"As my junior walking on the Way of Hunger, I can definitely give you some guidance on how to reach THE and eliminate those flames yourself. Or, you can tell me to simply take these flames away right now, and we can part ways right here."
The disposition of this being seemed to be unique and genuine. Noah could see how he operated with clear observation, so the answer came as a calm declaration.
"I’ll take care of it myself."
Tor smiled broadly and clapped his hands together with satisfaction.
"Good! A strong quality for those who walk on the Way of Hunger is to eat up everything with their own effort and strength."
He straightened to his full imposing height and spoke with formal gravity.
"I am Tor, THE First Hunger," he said simply. "What is your name, Outsider?"
Noah nodded as he replied, "Osmont. Noah Osmont."
Tor nodded with acknowledgment as he said, "Alright Osmont, what do you know about THE?"
What did he know aboutTHE?
He felt his existence buzzing at such a fundamental question as he answered honestly, "Not much."
Tor nodded with understanding as he said, "Okay. Then the best way for you to learn about THE and what it truly means... is to experience it directly. Come on."
As he said this, he moved to place his hand on Noah’s shoulder.
The crimson-gold flames of the curse ofTHE Living Elementalroared violently as if they were seeking to allow their contagion to spread onto this new target as well.
But Tor only raised a single eyebrow as if he was warning these flames of their presumption.
A moment later, the flames actually receded from Noah’s shoulder where Tor placed his hand, leaving that small area untouched!
Noah watched such a scene with shining eyes filled with wonder at the casual display of authority.
In the next moment, crimson-obsidian stellar waves of light wrapped around both of their bodies like protective cocoons. They began to float away from the mountain peak they had been standing on.

Their figures seemingly melted into the surrounding existence, entering its folds and layers to such an extent that one could not even perceive them anymore. They became part of the fabric of reality itself.
Tor explained as they began to fly across the landscape ofThe Infinite Unfurlingwith smooth motion.
"You are currently within The Infinite Unfurling, a place and time of immense glory, power, and danger," he said with grand calm.
He gestured to the inverted mountains and flowing rivers of light.

"Here, potential still exceeds actuality. Here, what will be has not yet defeated what could be. This is when THE entities emerge, and where entities with the potential to become THE are eaten up for lunch. It is when many learn what it means to hold authority over fundamental aspects of existence."
They passed through a cloud of mist that sang with harmonic frequencies.
"The first thing you need to understand about THE," Tor continued with teaching intensity,"is that it is not about power in the way you currently understand it."
He looked at Noah with piercing focus.

"THE is about Sovereignty. About claiming dominion over existence itself and making that claim absolute. I am THE First Hunger because I have Sovereign Authority over the concept of Hunger itself. Not just physical appetite, but existential consumption, the fundamental drive to take in and make part of oneself."
They flew past a mountain peak where crystalline structures pulsed with ancient light.

"When two THE entities clash," Tor said seriously, "it’s not about who has more power. It’s about whose Sovereignty is more complete, whose claim is more absolute, whose authority runs deeper into the fabric of Existence."
He smiled at Noah.

"The flames burning you come from THE Living Elemental, right? A worm who has Sovereign Authority over Elemental interactions. That’s why they persist despite your resistance. That’s why numerical weavings like Complexity and Purity don’t matter against them. you could be as complex and as pure as you want, but if you have nothing to go against The Sovereignty of Elemental... none of that will matter."
Noah absorbed this information with analytical intensity.
"But you said I could learn to eliminate them myself," Noah said carefully.
Tor nodded with approval at the question.
"Yes, because you’re developing your own path to THE. Your existence should be attempting to claim its own Sovereignty. Once it matures enough, once your claim becomes strong enough..."
He grinned with predatory satisfaction.
"Then you can tell those flames to fuck off, and they’ll have to listen."

"Oh, but don’t have any expectations of you attaining THE anytime soon. Your existence still feels a bit off. And that bit off could be years or eons depending on your existence. Or it could be months if you are in the Infinite Unfurling long enough, who knows? But I should be able to get you far enough that those weak flames would be something you can take care of."
WAA!

The landscape shifted around them as they flew deeper intoThe Infinite Unfurling, and Noah felt his existence drinking in the ancient atmosphere with desperate thirst as the flames causing excrutiating pain all around him...seemed to dim in comparison!

chapters.title: Chapter 4507: The Infinite Unfurling! IV
paragraphs: As Noah and Tor flew acrossThe Infinite Unfurling, the landscape shifted dramatically around them.

They entered into a unique region where massive crystalline mountains rose like titans frozen in time, each one surrounded by rotating clusters of nascent Folds that spun in orbital patterns. The Folds themselves looked incomplete, as if reality was still deciding what they should become.

The landscape was filled with storms of pure existence that defied conventional understanding. When Noah looked toward certain regions with careful observation, he saw terrifying natural phenomena that made his mind recoil. Torrents of raw authority that could shred across his 63 Septillions in Complexity and Purity as easily as wind through paper.

Lightning that wasn’t electricity but the concept of sudden change made manifest, striking in patterns that erased causality itself. Whirlwinds of collapsed probability that would unmake anything caught within them by retroactively preventing their existence.

This entire region was also filled with extremely dense layers of mist that obscured vision beyond a few hundred meters. One was not able to see too much of the surrounding environment, which made the danger feel even more oppressive and immediate.
But across these distant regions, cutting through the mist and the howling winds, Noah shockingly heardroars.
ROOOOAAAAAR!

The sound waves alone caused his existence to buzz with resonance, making his cells vibrate at frequencies that bordered on painful. These were not the sounds of mere beasts but the declarations of beings claiming their right to exist through sheer force of will.
This was the moment when Tor slowed his flight and tilted his head as if he was listening carefully for where the sound of those roars originated. His dark eyes gleamed with interest.
He then smiled with anticipation and said, "Oh, this ongoing battle may be ideal for you to understand what I’ve been explaining. Let’s go see."

They moved through the dangerous regions with Tor navigating expertly. After traversing what Noah estimated to be a few Gigaparsecs, passing through layers of folded space and compressed distance, they entered a clearing filled with tumultuous waves of power.
The region they arrived in was a vast expanse that looked like an ancestral battlefield carved from the bones of reality itself.

The ground was composed of compressed existence that had been hammered flat by countless impacts over what must have been eons of conflict. Plateaus of crystalline material jutted upward at irregular intervals, each one scarred with claw marks and burn patterns that glowed with residual authority.

Massive weathered pillars rose like the ribs of some dead existential beast, creating natural archways and obstacles throughout the terrain. The sky above swirled with auroras of impossible colors that bled into each other, painting the entire scene in shifting hues of violet, crimson, and glacial blue.

The entire region was filled with terrifying swirling shattered Folds that moved through the space like debris in a Primordial storm. These fragments could eradicate a creature of 1 Septillion Complexity on impact, simply erasing them from existence through contact.
And yet, at the center of such a dangerous place, Noah observed two monstrous entities locked in combat.

The first creature was a titanic wyvern-like being whose body stretched for what looked like light-years. Its sleek form was covered in obsidian scales that crackled with constant electrical discharge. A magnificent crest of horn-like protrusions jutted from its head, each one serving as a conductor for the purple lightning that wreathed its entire existence.

Its wings were vast membranes of crystallized energy that sparked and flashed with every movement, creating afterimages of light that burned into the retina. Its tail was segmented and whip-like, trailing arcs of electricity that carved through the surrounding space.
The creature was surrounded by endless purple obsidian seas of lightning that formed a domain around it, making the very air ionize and glow.

The second creature was ape-like in its basic structure but magnified to apocalyptic proportions. Its body was covered in white fur that looked like compressed glacial ice, each strand sharp enough to cut through reality. Massive curved horns grew from its head like the tusks of some primordial mammoth, glowing with frozen light.
Its arms were disproportionately long and muscular, ending in fists that looked capable of shattering continents. Its eyes burned with blue fire that held the cold fury of absolute zero.

This beast was surrounded by glacial waves of storms and ice that manifested as swirling blizzards of frozen authority, creating a domain of perpetual winter that fought against the electrical storm of its opponent.
Noah’s vision pulsed as information flooded his perception.
|Name: Voltaic Sovereign Incarnate - Raijax|
|Classification: Pre-THE Existence attempting Lightning Sovereignty|
|Complexity: 485 Decillion|
|Purity: 515 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Thunder Genesis, Lightning Propagation, Voltage Manifestation, Electric Dominion, Storm Convergence, Plasma Authority, Conductivity Mastery, Arc Supremacy|
|Status: Engaged in existential combat|
|Name: Glacial Sovereign Incarnate - Hyorath|
|Classification: Pre-THE Existence attempting Glacial Sovereignty|
|Complexity: 555 Decillion|
|Purity: 555 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Frost Genesis, Ice Propagation, Absolute Zero Manifestation, Glacial Dominion, Winter Convergence, Crystalline Authority, Thermal Negation Mastery, Permafrost Supremacy|
|Status: Engaged in existential combat|
He looked at such terrifying beings with analytical wonder, cataloging their power and comparing it to his own vastly inferior capabilities.
In the next moment, Tor spoke with teaching intensity.

"These two here are good examples of existences trying to reach THE," he said calmly, gesturing toward the battling titans. "Their existence is ripe for it as they have not concentrated so much on their numerical Complexity and Purity, though those numbers are still a little large."
He crossed his arms as he observed.

"But they have leaned towards a specific aspect of existence and are actively seeking to claim Sovereignty towards it. One is seeking Lightning Sovereignty while the other is seeking Glacial Sovereignty. One is walking the Way of Lightning and the other is walking the Way of Glacial."
His expression became slightly pitying.

"They are grand ideals, worthy pursuits. But these existences would never truly have the chance to reach THE at the end of their paths. You see, the aspects of existence they are trying to lay claim over... well, even both of these could be superseded by the authority that is currently burning you. Elemental."
He shook his head.

"Lightning falls under Elemental. Glacial falls under Elemental. Both of their Ways are subcategories of a broader Sovereignty that has already been claimed. So while it could theoretically be possible for them to eventually attain THE through these paths, it would be immensely hard, perhaps impossible without completely redefining their chosen domains."
As Tor finished his explanation, the terrifying apocalyptic battle intensified before them.
BOOM!

Raijax, the lightning wyvern, swooped down from the swirling sky with wings spread wide. Each beat of those vast membranes created shockwaves that propagated across light-years, compressing space and time with the force of impact.
If Noah had been nearby, he would have been absolutely shredded!

Purple lightning gathered around its open jaws, condensing into a sphere of such concentrated electrical authority that it bent space around itself. The creature released it with a shriek that shattered the sound barrier across multiple dimensions simultaneously.
CRAAAACK!

The blast struck Hyorath directly in the chest, and the glacial ape roared with pain and fury. Ice exploded outward from the point of impact as frozen armor shattered, revealing flesh beneath that steamed and burned.
But Hyorath retaliated immediately.

The ape-like titan slammed both fists into the compressed ground beneath it, and the entire battlefield trembled. From the point of impact, jagged spears of absolute-zero ice erupted upward in a forest of frozen death, each one kilometers thick and moving at impossible speeds, burning with its Way of Existence and Civilizational Authority!

Raijax twisted in mid-air, its serpentine body contorting to avoid the rising spears. Lightning arced from its body to meet the ice, creating explosions where the conflicting authorities collided. Each explosion released enough energy to vaporize Fold systems.

The two entities circled each other, their domains and Ways of of Lightning and Glacial creating a boundary where purple electricity fought against blue frost. The air between them crackled and froze simultaneously, creating impossible phenomena where matter existed in contradictory states.

Noah observed Raijax as it descended in a spiral dive, its tail whipping forward like a lance. The segmented appendage struck Hyorath across the shoulder, carving through glacial armor and drawing blood that froze before it could fall.
Hyorath caught the tail with one massive hand and pulled.
THOOM!

The wyvern was yanked from the sky and slammed into the ground with force that created a crater spanning hundreds of light-years. The impact sent shockwaves rippling outward that obliterated the surrounding environment, reducing mountains to dust and shattering the floating Fold fragments into smaller pieces.
’What the fuck is this...’
The scale of the battle was enough to make Noah shake his head at the impacts of brutality as any single one of them would have been an end to his Temporal Traversal!
And yet...the battle still continued!
Raijax was far from defeated.

Lightning erupted from its entire body in a nova of electrical fury. The discharge was so intense that it turned the air itself into plasma, creating a sea of superheated matter that expanded outward in all directions.

Hyorath released the tail and leaped backward, creating walls of glacial ice to shield against the plasma wave. The ice held for microseconds before sublimating directly into vapor, but those microseconds were enough for the ape to escape the worst of the blast.
As Tor continued to observe, he spoke with calm instruction.
"The Civilizational Scale of Existence, the designation of THE, requires for one to lay an undeniable claim over something. To have complete Sovereign Authority over it."
He gestured toward the battling titans.

"Their power would be dependent on what I call the Depth of Sovereignty. Depth is how thoroughly they can rewrite their chosen domain and impose it against all others. It can be measured as Surface, Intermediate, Fundamental, or Absolute."
His dark eyes gleamed!

Massive curved horns grew from its head like the tusks of some primordial mammoth, glowing with frozen light.
Its arms were disproportionately long and muscular, ending in fists that looked capable of shattering continents.
Its eyes burned with blue fire that held the cold fury of absolute zero.

This beast was surrounded by glacial waves of storms and ice that manifested as swirling blizzards of frozen authority, creating a domain of perpetual winter that fought against the electrical storm of its opponent.
Noah’s vision pulsed as information flooded his perception.
|Name: Voltaic Sovereign Incarnate - Raijax|
|Classification: Pre-THE Existence attempting Lightning Sovereignty|
|Complexity: 485 Decillion|
|Purity: 515 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Thunder Genesis, Lightning Propagation, Voltage Manifestation, Electric Dominion, Storm Convergence, Plasma Authority, Conductivity Mastery, Arc Supremacy|
|Status: Engaged in existential combat|
|Name: Glacial Sovereign Incarnate - Hyorath|
|Classification: Pre-THE Existence attempting Glacial Sovereignty|
|Complexity: 555 Decillion|
|Purity: 555 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Frost Genesis, Ice Propagation, Absolute Zero Manifestation, Glacial Dominion, Winter Convergence, Crystalline Authority, Thermal Negation Mastery, Permafrost Supremacy|
|Status: Engaged in existential combat|
He looked at such terrifying beings with analytical wonder, cataloging their power and comparing it to his own vastly inferior capabilities.
In the next moment, Tor spoke with teaching intensity.
"These two here are good examples of existences trying to reach THE," he said calmly, gesturing toward the battling titans.
"Their existence is ripe for it as they have not concentrated so much on their numerical Complexity and Purity, though those numbers are still a little large."
He crossed his arms as he observed.
"But they have leaned towards a specific aspect of existence and are actively seeking to claim Sovereignty towards it.
One is seeking Lightning Sovereignty while the other is seeking Glacial Sovereignty.
One is walking the Way of Lightning and the other is walking the Way of Glacial."
His expression became slightly pitying.
"They are grand ideals, worthy pursuits.
But these existences would never truly have the chance to reach THE at the end of their paths.
You see, the aspects of existence they are trying to lay claim over... well, even both of these could be superseded by the authority that is currently burning you.
Elemental."
He shook his head.
"Lightning falls under Elemental.
Glacial falls under Elemental.
Both of their Ways are subcategories of a broader Sovereignty that has already been claimed.
So while it could theoretically be possible for them to eventually attain THE through these paths, it would be immensely hard, perhaps impossible without completely redefining their chosen domains."
As Tor finished his explanation, the terrifying apocalyptic battle intensified before them.
BOOM!
Raijax, the lightning wyvern, swooped down from the swirling sky with wings spread wide.
Each beat of those vast membranes created shockwaves that propagated across light-years, compressing space and time with the force of impact.
If Noah had been nearby, he would have been absolutely shredded!
Purple lightning gathered around its open jaws, condensing into a sphere of such concentrated electrical authority that it bent space around itself.
The creature released it with a shriek that shattered the sound barrier across multiple dimensions simultaneously.
CRAAAACK!
The blast struck Hyorath directly in the chest, and the glacial ape roared with pain and fury.
Ice exploded outward from the point of impact as frozen armor shattered, revealing flesh beneath that steamed and burned.
But Hyorath retaliated immediately.
The ape-like titan slammed both fists into the compressed ground beneath it, and the entire battlefield trembled.

From the point of impact, jagged spears of absolute-zero ice erupted upward in a forest of frozen death, each one kilometers thick and moving at impossible speeds, burning with its Way of Existence and Civilizational Authority!
Raijax twisted in mid-air, its serpentine body contorting to avoid the rising spears.
Lightning arced from its body to meet the ice, creating explosions where the conflicting authorities collided.
Each explosion released enough energy to vaporize Fold systems.
The two entities circled each other, their domains and Ways of of Lightning and Glacial creating a boundary where purple electricity fought against blue frost.
The air between them crackled and froze simultaneously, creating impossible phenomena where matter existed in contradictory states.
Noah observed Raijax as it descended in a spiral dive, its tail whipping forward like a lance.
The segmented appendage struck Hyorath across the shoulder, carving through glacial armor and drawing blood that froze before it could fall.
Hyorath caught the tail with one massive hand and pulled.
THOOM!
The wyvern was yanked from the sky and slammed into the ground with force that created a crater spanning hundreds of light-years.
The impact sent shockwaves rippling outward that obliterated the surrounding environment, reducing mountains to dust and shattering the floating Fold fragments into smaller pieces.
’What the fuck is this...’
The scale of the battle was enough to make Noah shake his head at the impacts of brutality as any single one of them would have been an end to his Temporal Traversal!
And yet...the battle still continued!
Raijax was far from defeated.
Lightning erupted from its entire body in a nova of electrical fury.
The discharge was so intense that it turned the air itself into plasma, creating a sea of superheated matter that expanded outward in all directions.
Hyorath released the tail and leaped backward, creating walls of glacial ice to shield against the plasma wave.
The ice held for microseconds before sublimating directly into vapor, but those microseconds were enough for the ape to escape the worst of the blast.
As Tor continued to observe, he spoke with calm instruction.
"The Civilizational Scale of Existence, the designation of THE, requires for one to lay an undeniable claim over something.
To have complete Sovereign Authority over it."
He gestured toward the battling titans.
"Their power would be dependent on what I call the Depth of Sovereignty.
Depth is how thoroughly they can rewrite their chosen domain and impose it against all others.
It can be measured as Surface, Intermediate, Fundamental, or Absolute."
His dark eyes gleamed!

chapters.title: Chapter 4508: The Infinite Unfurling! V
paragraphs: "Countless existences in The Infinite Unfurling will never even manage to touch the Depth of THE Surface of Absolute Sovereignty Authority. These two before you are trying to build up the Depth of their declared Ways to at least touch THE Surface threshold, and so they battle against each other."
He paused as the combat intensified.

"If one Way triumphs over the other, the easiest thing to do is to devour the losing Way and use it as fuel for one’s own progression. And here’s where the truly interesting thing that I mentioned before becomes relevant."
Tor’s smile widened with predatory satisfaction.

"I mentioned how their Ways of existence, the Sovereignties they are trying to establish, are Lightning and Glacial. Both of these would fall under Elemental. Both of these would also fall under Conceptual. And the very action of what they are doing when they eventually consume each other, or even during the battle as they try to devour each other’s authority..."
His eyes spun like terrifying gravitational black holes that would devour absolutely everything.

"All of these actions fall under the purview of my Hunger. Both of them are hungering for victory, for growth, for Sovereignty. So in choosing and selecting a Way of existence, one has to be unfathomably careful. Because if they choose something that can be incorporated into another, broader Way..."
He left the implication hanging in the air!

Noah thought about the words of this terrifying being with intense focus. He considered his own Mana and Hunger, how Mana was so pervasive and widespread across all of existence. It was indeed a glorious Way to be following, a glorious Civilization to be enacting.

He also thought aboutThe Depths of Sovereigntythat Tor had mentioned. How countless creatures could never even touchTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.How he himself was nowhere close toTHE Surface, not even a fraction of a fraction of the way there.
And how even these two terrifying creatures at Decillions of Complexity and Purity, beings that could obliterate him with a thought, had not even touchedTHE Surfacethreshold.
The gulf between where he stood and whereTHEexisted was almost incomprehensible.
As Noah processed all of this information, Tor continued speaking.

"The Infinite Unfurling is filled with beings like the two you see fighting in front of you. Many trying to establish their dominion and Sovereignty, clashing and devouring each other in an endless cycle of growth and consumption."
His expression became more serious.

"In this place, there are a few entities that you have to be especially careful of. I guess THE Living Elemental is a creature that managed to survive these brutal regions and establish his Sovereignty successfully. But there are other truly terrifying ones that you need to keep track of and make absolutely sure that you don’t come in front of."
He held up fingers as he counted.
"The rampant monster of THE Paradox Absolute Sovereignty is one. They delight in contradiction and impossibility, and their very presence can unmake logical existence."
He held up another finger.
"And the other goes by a few distinctions, as they are the most terrifying entity to encounter in these parts. They go by THE Titan, THE Sovereign Killer, THE Feared Sovereignty..."
His voice dropped as if one had to be careful when they said the name.
"THE Creature."
BOOM!
THE Creature!
A terrifying existence that was feared acrossThe Infinite Unfurlingitself!
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he obtained information regarding such glorious and terrible history!
BOOM!
And as he thought about all of it, his eyes continued to observe and track the terrifying battle occurring in the distance.

Raijax had recovered from being slammed into the ground and now hovered above the battlefield with wings spread wide. Lightning condensed around its form in layers upon layers of electrical authority, building to something catastrophic.
Hyorath stood below, fists raised and glowing with glacial power. Ice formed and reformed around its massive hands, creating gauntlets of frozen matter compressed to impossible densities.
The two entities launched themselves at each other simultaneously.
CRASH!

They collided in mid-air, and the shockwave from the impact obliterated everything within several light-years. Fists met claws, ice met lightning, and the very fabric of existence strained under the pressure.
They separated and clashed again, and again, and again. Each impact created explosions of conflicting authority. Lightning carved through ice, and ice shattered electrical fields.
Way against Way. Civilization against Civilization.

Raijax wrapped around Hyorath like a constricting serpent, its body channeling millions of volts directly into the ape’s form. Hyorath roared and flexed, muscles expanding as glacial authority pushed back against the electrical assault.
The ape caught the wyvern’s neck in both hands and began to squeeze. Ice formed along Raijax’s scales, frost creeping toward vital organs with the intent to freeze the creature from within.
But Raijax twisted violently, using its superior mobility to escape the grip. It slashed with razor-sharp claws wreathed in purple lightning, opening wounds across Hyorath’s chest and arms.
Blood sprayed, freezing and evaporating simultaneously in the contradictory environment.
They separated again, both wounded but neither willing to concede.
And then came the pivotal moment.

Raijax gathered all of its remaining power, channeling every iota of Lightning Sovereignty it had accumulated. The creature’s limbs began to glow with obsidian-purple seas of lightning so dense that they looked solid, like weapons forged from the concept of electricity itself.
The wyvern threw its wings and limbs forward as if launching spears.
WHOOOOSH!

Lances of pure lightning shot across the distance, each one carrying the full weight of Raijax’s claim to Lightning Sovereignty. They pierced through Hyorath’s glacial defenses as if they weren’t even there, carving through ice and flesh with equal ease.
The chest and existence of the ape became carved wide open, revealing the glowing core of its being beneath layers of frozen armor and muscle.
Hyorath howled with pain and despair, the sound echoing across dimensions!
Raijax roared triumphantly, the sound mixing with thunder that announced victory!

The wyvern descended toward its fallen opponent, jaws opening wide in preparation. It would devour everything about the Way of existence of its enemy, consuming the Glacial Sovereignty that Hyorath had spent eons building.
This consumption would increase the Depth of Raijax’s own Lightning Sovereignty, pushing it closer towardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntythat it hungered for!
Noah nodded at this battle as it truly made things somewhat clear regarding competing Ways of Sovereignties.
And yet at such a moment of triumph, the figure of Tor beside him smiled with something like amusement.
"This is existence,"he said calmly. "Existence is glorious. Existence is unpredictable."
He paused for effect.
"And existence is...brutal."
As he finished saying these words, he took a single step forward.
Both their figures became fully visible, shedding the veil of folded existence that had concealed them.
In the distance, Raijax turned toward them. The victor’s eyes, which had been gleaming with triumph, quickly began shaking with panic and absolute terror as they locked onto Tor.
Recognition and fear bloomed across the wyvern’s features.
In the next moment, Tor simply opened his mouth and took a bite.
CHOMP!

Above both Raijax and the collapsed Hyorath, reality itself split open like a wound. Terrifying obsidian-crimson jaws emerged from the tear, vast beyond comprehension. Each tooth was the size of a fold continent, dripping with authority that made space itself bend.
The jaws descended with inexorable finality.
They bit down and proceeded to devour the entire region of existence and the two entities within it!
THE Absolute Sovereignty Authority of Hunger, THE Civilizational Authority of Hunger,covered everything like a shroud and consumed it all in a single bite!
Both Raijax and Hyorath, with their Decillions of Complexity and their Grand Principles each, with their lifetimes of struggle toward Sovereignty...
Gone.
Erased.
Devoured.
Not even their screams had time to echo before they became part of Tor’s existence.
Noah observed such a terrifying scene with eyes wide!

Beside him, Tor licked his lips with satisfaction. His abyssal eyes shone with an even greater intense obsidian light, and the weight of his existence seemed to become even more profound, as if he had just taken a step deeper into his own Sovereignty.
He repeated himself with calm certainty.
"Existence is brutal, Outsider. The powerful eat the weak without even a second of hesitation or mercy. There is no fairness here, no cosmic justice. Only strength and hunger."
He turned to Noah with a devilish smile.

"Now for you, let us find you something weak and feeble to fight to the death with. If you can handle it, you will come out the other side even grander, your path toward THE more clear. And if you cannot..."
His smile widened.
"Ah, then it was not meant to be. Do not worry though, I will let you rest in peace within my Hunger, becoming fuel for my own ascension."
Tor’s authority wrapped around both of them again like a protective cocoon, concealing them from the perception of other entities.
The two proceeded further ahead into The Infinite Unfurling, and Noah couldn’t help but wonder what "weak and feeble" meant to a being like Tor.
And...he wouldn’t really let him die, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 4509: Tatakae! I
paragraphs: Noah’s eyes were unusually bright as they took in everything that he was observing in The Infinite Unfurling.

After watching the casual collapse of entities that were considered Pre-THE Existence, beings with Decillions of Complexity and Purity who had spent eons building their Ways, his entire existence felt a sense of urgency and need.

It was like being a small insect witnessing the movements of giants, and understanding with sudden clarity that he desperately needed to be among those giants if not exceed them completely in what would be considered a short period of time.
Not to mention that he now stood at the threshold of answers regarding survivingTHE Loom, regarding The Fallout, regarding the fundamental questions that had driven him forward.
So as they crossed Gigaparsecs in a matter of seconds, moving through folded space with the ease that only aTHEexistence could manage, Noah spoke with carefully measured words.
"Can you tell me more aboutTHE Creature?"

Noah asked such a thing calmly, without mentioning that in the future, to save Khor, Tor would fight againstTHE Creatureand subsequently face collapse due to this confrontation. That Tor’s Way andTHE Civilizational Authority of Hungerwould be inherited by Khor after his fall...though he inherently knew that Tor already put the clues together since he appeared here! He knew, but he didn’t know the full picture.

Noah did not know how things would unfold if he said something that would alter the future in unpredictable ways, and what the consequences of the wrong words might cascade into. He had to be careful in this delicate temporal situation.
His words caused Tor to look at him with those abyssal eyes before the entity smiled with calm recollection.
"Ah, THE Creature," Tor said with something like respect mixed with wariness. "Now that is an entity worth speaking about."
He gestured at the passing landscape as they flew.

"I have come across them a few times over the eons, though never in direct confrontation. And I have heard countless stories from the memories of creatures that I devoured, entities who witnessed THE Creature’s actions or heard tales passed down through their own consumed victims."
His expression became more serious.

"THE Creature is... different from other THE existences. Where most of us claimed our Sovereignty over specific domains and built our authority within those boundaries, THE Creature took a path that many considered insane, and did not even have the ability to take."
Tor’s eyes gleamed with the light of remembered glory.

"There was a memory I extracted from the memories of a Pre-THE existence I consumed some time ago. This entity had witnessed something that scarred their existence so deeply that the memory remained vivid even after death."
He paused for effect.

"There was once a THE existence who had achieved THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty over the concept of Conquest. Not just existence victory or territorial expansion, but the fundamental idea of imposing one’s will over another. This entity had spent uncountable eons building their claim, devouring countless other Ways that fell under their domain."
Noah listened with rapt attention.

"This THE Conquest Sovereignty had allied with a dozen Pre-THE existences, each one comparable to or exceeding those lightning and glacial entities I just ate up. Together, they sought to expand their influence across a cluster of forming domains in the Infinite Unfurling, to claim new territory and resources."
Tor’s smile became darker.

"And they encountered THE Creature in their path. The Conquest Sovereignty, confident in their Surface Depth authority and their allied forces, demanded that THE Creature submit or be destroyed. They gave THE Creature a choice: bend the knee or face annihilation."
The air around them seemed to grow heavier as Tor continued.

"THE Creature’s response was to simply begin walking forward and ignore. No declarations, no threats, no gathering of power. Just... walking. And as THE Creature walked, the Conquest Sovereignty and all dozen Pre-THE existences attacked with everything they had accumulated."
Tor’s eyes spun with remembered violence.
"The battle lasted for a second, and for eons where THE Creature faced overwhelming numbers and supposed strategic superiority. And do you know what happened, Outsider?"
Noah shook his head silently.

"THE Creature brutalized all of them so thoroughly, so completely, that the very concept of Conquest was eradicated from existence,"Tor said with quiet intensity. "Not just defeated. Not just consumed. Fucking Eradicated. The Absolute Sovereignty that the Conquest entity had claimed was erased so utterly that nobody even remembers what that concept fully entailed anymore. The Way of Conquest itself may never exist again."
He let that sink in.
He! Let! That! Sink! In!

"The dozen Pre-THE existences? Also consumed, their Ways incorporated into THE Creature’s ever-expanding domain. The entity whose memories I consumed had watched from a safe distance and fled immediately after, but the terror of what they witnessed never left them."
Noah felt his existence buzzing at such a story.
Tor continued as he seemed to enjoy this topic a great deal.

"Here’s another record I know of... this one from more recent times relatively speaking. There was a coalition of THE existences, three of them who had achieved varying Depths of Surface Sovereignty. They had decided that THE Creature was becoming too dangerous, that their expanding claim over existence needed to be curtailed before it grew beyond containment."
MoreTHEentities that Noah never knew existed.
Because even in the stories ofTHEEarliest Folds, none were mentioned apart from those he knew!
But just because fabricated history did not mention them...did that mean they did not exist?
His smile was grim.

"These three THE existences ambushed THE Creature in a prepared battlefield, a region of The Infinite Unfurling that they had spent millennia preparing with traps. They attacked in perfect coordination, their Sovereignties complementing each other."
Tor shook his head slowly.

"THE Creature killed the first one within moments by simply touching them. Reached out, made contact, and the entity collapsed as if their entire existence had been deemed unnecessary by reality itself. The second one lasted longer, managing to wound THE Creature before being torn apart and devoured. The third one fled and survived, but from what I understand, they collapsed their own existence shortly after out of sheer terror as they felt like they were being followed."

Where most of us claimed our Sovereignty over specific domains and built our authority within those boundaries, THE Creature took a path that many considered insane, and did not even have the ability to take."
Tor’s eyes gleamed with the light of remembered glory.
"There was a memory I extracted from the memories of a Pre-THE existence I consumed some time ago.
This entity had witnessed something that scarred their existence so deeply that the memory remained vivid even after death."
He paused for effect.
"There was once a THE existence who had achieved THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty over the concept of Conquest.
Not just existence victory or territorial expansion, but the fundamental idea of imposing one’s will over another.
This entity had spent uncountable eons building their claim, devouring countless other Ways that fell under their domain."
Noah listened with rapt attention.
"This THE Conquest Sovereignty had allied with a dozen Pre-THE existences, each one comparable to or exceeding those lightning and glacial entities I just ate up.
Together, they sought to expand their influence across a cluster of forming domains in the Infinite Unfurling, to claim new territory and resources."
Tor’s smile became darker.
"And they encountered THE Creature in their path.
The Conquest Sovereignty, confident in their Surface Depth authority and their allied forces, demanded that THE Creature submit or be destroyed.
They gave THE Creature a choice: bend the knee or face annihilation."
The air around them seemed to grow heavier as Tor continued.
"THE Creature’s response was to simply begin walking forward and ignore.
No declarations, no threats, no gathering of power.
Just... walking.
And as THE Creature walked, the Conquest Sovereignty and all dozen Pre-THE existences attacked with everything they had accumulated."
Tor’s eyes spun with remembered violence.
"The battle lasted for a second, and for eons where THE Creature faced overwhelming numbers and supposed strategic superiority.
And do you know what happened, Outsider?"
Noah shook his head silently.
"THE Creature brutalized all of them so thoroughly, so completely, that the very concept of Conquest was eradicated from existence,"Tor said with quiet intensity.
"Not just defeated.
Not just consumed.
Fucking Eradicated.
The Absolute Sovereignty that the Conquest entity had claimed was erased so utterly that nobody even remembers what that concept fully entailed anymore.
The Way of Conquest itself may never exist again."
He let that sink in.
He!
Let!
That!
Sink!
In!
"The dozen Pre-THE existences?
Also consumed, their Ways incorporated into THE Creature’s ever-expanding domain.
The entity whose memories I consumed had watched from a safe distance and fled immediately after, but the terror of what they witnessed never left them."
Noah felt his existence buzzing at such a story.
Tor continued as he seemed to enjoy this topic a great deal.
"Here’s another record I know of... this one from more recent times relatively speaking.
There was a coalition of THE existences, three of them who had achieved varying Depths of Surface Sovereignty.
They had decided that THE Creature was becoming too dangerous, that their expanding claim over existence needed to be curtailed before it grew beyond containment."
MoreTHEentities that Noah never knew existed.
Because even in the stories ofTHEEarliest Folds, none were mentioned apart from those he knew!
But just because fabricated history did not mention them...did that mean they did not exist?
His smile was grim.
"These three THE existences ambushed THE Creature in a prepared battlefield, a region of The Infinite Unfurling that they had spent millennia preparing with traps.
They attacked in perfect coordination, their Sovereignties complementing each other."
Tor shook his head slowly.
"THE Creature killed the first one within moments by simply touching them.
Reached out, made contact, and the entity collapsed as if their entire existence had been deemed unnecessary by reality itself.
The second one lasted longer, managing to wound THE Creature before being torn apart and devoured.
The third one fled and survived, but from what I understand, they collapsed their own existence shortly after out of sheer terror as they felt like they were being followed."

chapters.title: Chapter 4510: Tatakae! II
paragraphs: The weight of these records hung in the air!

"The Way of THE Creature is a unique one,"Tor said with something approaching interest. "THE Creature seeks to encompass all of Existence itself. Not pieces of it, not aspects of it, but the totality. It is ambitious beyond measure, it is grand beyond comprehension."
His eyes met Noah’s.

"And if THE Creature succeeds in fully claiming that Sovereignty completely, nothing will be able to do a single thing to them in Observable Existence. They would become synonymous with reality itself, unkillable and absolute."
Noah’s existence buzzed at these words and stories, his mind racing through implications.

He wondered...with how powerfulTHE Creatureclearly was, how did THELiving Paradox and Emotivesucceed in whatever they did in the future? How didTHE Loomoccur ifTHE Creaturewas this overwhelming? Were...any of the Stories of The Earliest Folds filled with accuracy, or were they loose events embellished here and there or even told in a version that never occurred?
DidTHE Creaturetruly give his Everythings to all of Existence?
There had to be a critical piece of information he was missing here, some variable he didn’t yet understand.
At his churning thoughts, Tor looked at him with knowing eyes before speaking.
"But stories of others are fun and entertaining, educational even," Tor said with a shift in tone. "But at the end of the day, your story is what matters the most."
Tor’s gaze drifted to their changing surroundings, to the inverted mountains and flowing rivers of light that composed The Infinite Unfurling.

"In this place, in The Infinite Unfurling where everything is still being decided, one should do their best not to compare themselves against others," he said,"I have seen countless entities destroy themselves through comparison, through measuring their worth against beings they could never match."
His voice took on a teaching quality.

"Do not compare yourself to THE Creature. Do not even compare yourself to me. Comparison against others does not do much to aid one in existence. It only breeds either arrogance or despair, and both are equally poisonous to growth."
He turned to look directly at Noah.

"So what if others are immensely powerful? So what if THE Creature can eradicate Sovereignties or I can devour Pre-THE existences with a single bite? Their power is theirs, built on their choices, their struggles, their unique paths through existence."
Tor’s expression became intense.

"Find your own definition of powerful and set it for yourself. Never define yourself or measure your worth based on comparisons to others. If you are stronger than yesterday, that is growth. If you understand more today than you did before, that is advancement. If your Sovereignty deepens even by the smallest fraction, that is progress."
His dark eyes seemed to see through existence itself!

"The moment you start comparing yourself to others, you begin walking their path instead of your own. You begin trying to match their Depth, mimic their Sovereignties, follow their Ways. And in doing so, you guarantee that you will always be lesser, always be a copy, always be derivative."
He gestured at the infinite expanse around them.

"Every THE existence you will ever encounter, myself included, we all had moments where we could have compared ourselves to those who came before. We could have measured ourselves against the ancient powers and found ourselves wanting. But we didn’t. We chose to walk our own paths, to claim our own Sovereignties, to build our own unique Ways regardless of how they compared to others."
Tor’s voice dropped to something profound.

"The day you truly stop comparing and measuring yourself against others, the day you stop feeling lesser because someone is more powerful or grander because you surpass another, that will truly be the day you head towards THE with clear purpose."
He smiled with genuine warmth.
"Your unique THE growing within you? That is your path, Outsider. Not my Hunger, not THE Creature’s Existence, not THE Living Elemental’s Elemental authority. Yours. Something completely novel."
His words carried the weight of absolute certainty.

"Do not waste it by trying to measure how it compares to what already exists. Build it into something incomparable, something that stands on its own merits. Let others compare themselves to you in the future, if they must engage in such futile exercises."
Tor’s words hung in the air like a revelation.

"Power is not a ladder where you climb by stepping on others or measuring yourself against their positions. Power is a vast landscape where each being carves their own mountain from the raw stone of existence. Some mountains are taller, some broader, some more beautiful. But the only mountain that matters to you is the one you are building with your own hands."
He looked at Noah with eyes that held eons of experience.

"So build, Outsider. Build without comparison. Build without measuring. Build simply because that is your nature, your choice, your Way. And when you finally achieve THE Absolute Sovereignty over whatever you choose to claim, it will be yours alone, incomparable and absolute."
Noah listened to such words as his eyes shone with unfathomably grand luminosity!
While they may not be immensly applicable since his Existence was a Quintessential one, there was no harm drawing some lessons from this.
He had been comparing himself a few times. To Khor, to the entities withinTHE Loom, to the descriptions ofTHEpowers.
Measuring, always finding himself wanting or surprisingly advanced, sometimes defining his progress in relation to others. How rapidly he advanced in days instead of years.
But Tor was right.
HisTHE Organ of Civilizationwas unique. His combination of Mana and Hunger was his own. His Mana even moreso. His path through existence belonged to him alone. Quintessential!
And if he was to survive The Fallout, if he was to build a Civilization that could endure what was coming, he needed to stop measuring himself against others and simply... build.
BuildhisSovereignty. BuildhisDepth. BuildhisWay.
Not because others had done it better or worse, but because it was his to build!

chapters.title: Chapter 4511: Tatakae! III
paragraphs: Build something incomparable and absolute that was all his.
Noah’s mind buzzed with brilliance and possibilities as such a thought repeated again and again in rhythmic waves. His gaze turned and observed all the surrounding changes with intensity.

The Infinite Unfurling was vast and seemed to hold immense secrets within its impossible weavings. At this moment, while he was in contact with an existence atTHE Civilizational Scale of Existence, he would continue trying to extract even more information that could aid his survival and growth.
So his eyes flashed brightly as he addressedTHE First Hungerwith carefully considered words.

"I know of the FalseTHEexistences and now,Pre-THE Existenceslike the two we just witnessed. What is the distinction between them and entities that have reachedTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty?"
At such a direct question, the figure of Tor actually laughed with genuine amusement.
"Ah, now that is a question,"Tor said with a smile. "The distinction between False THE and Pre-THE is something I have strong opinions about, Outsider."
He gestured broadly as he began his explanation.

"In my sanctuary where I have Little Khor and others playing around and training, there was once a dull Inevitability who was envious of one of his brothers reaching the Pre-THE stage. This envious fool wanted desperately to attain a similar distinction that had THE in the name, something that would mark him as special."
Tor’s expression became stern with the memory.

"So he went ahead and claimed the title of False THE for himself, building his authority on shortcuts and borrowed power rather than genuine development of his Way. The moment that I found out what he had done, I went back to my sanctuary immediately and I whooped that dull Inevitability into shape."
His eyes gleamed with dark satisfaction.

"I broke its foundation completely until its false claim to THE was gone, shattered beyond repair. And I did all of this not out of cruelty, but to actually save it and give it a real chance at advancement. Because anything that claims the allure of False THE will never, ever become a true THE.Never."
His voice took on a grander quality as he continued.

"Let me speak to you about the concepts of false and true in existence, because this is fundamental to understanding the path forward. If one taints their Way with anything that is false, with shortcuts or borrowed power or unearned claims, how can it suddenly become true in existence?"
He looked at Noah with intense focus.

"False would never spontaneously change to become true. The nature of falsehood is that it remains false no matter how much time passes or how much power one accumulates. A foundation built on lies cannot support a structure of truth. The day that one truly grasps THE, it can only be as a true THE and not as a False THE."
Tor gestured toward the landscape around them.

"That is where those who are arduously trying to build up their Way of existence to establish their Sovereignty are following the right path, even if it seems slower and more difficult. By the time they achieve Pre-THE status, they at least have a set of stairs to climb in order to reach THE Civilizational Scale of Existence. The foundation is solid, the path is clear, and advancement is possible."
His expression became more contemplative.

"Some do take what appears to be an easier way out. They inherit someone else’s Absolute Sovereignty through consumption or merger or other means. Because it is not entirely through their own efforts, because the foundation was not built by their own hands, they may pass through a stage labeled as False THE before they ultimately attain a version of THE Civilizational Scale of Existence."
He paused meaningfully.

"But here is the critical point: they may be stuck at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty for all of their existence, unable to deepen their claim because the roots were not truly their own. They wear the title but lack the substance. They hold the power but cannot develop it further."
At this moment, the figure of this terrifying being turned to look at Noah with a daring smile that held challenge and expectation in equal measure.

"The enemy that we are looking for you to fight cannot even have the False THE distinction,"he said with absolute certainty."I don’t want you to even taint yourself with the Ways of such beings by consuming them. You will fight something that has potential but has not yet corrupted itself with false claims."
As he said this with finality, he came to a complete stop. Their figures paused in mid-flight, hovering in the strange atmosphere.
Tor closed his eyes for a brief moment before he tapped his finger outward to release a circular burst of Hunger authority that radiated in all directions like a sonar pulse.
In less than a second, he opened his eyes again with satisfaction.
"Found one."
An obsidian-crimson light of Hunger wrapped around both him and Noah like a protective cocoon. They disappeared from their current location in the next instant.
By the time they reappeared, they were in an entirely different environment.

Noah observed the new landscape with careful attention. For countless Gigaparsecs in every direction, mist and steam surged through the air in thick layers that obscured vision and created an oppressive atmosphere.

He and Tor were standing on top of a massive swamp tree whose trunk was as wide as a continent. Bubbling pools of liquid dark-green poison stretched out all around them like a toxic sea. The pools emitted vapors that rose in writhing columns.

Ancient trees with twisted roots emerged from the poisonous waters at irregular intervals, creating a maze-like environment. Some trees were dead and skeletal, their branches reaching toward the sky like accusing fingers. Others were somehow alive despite the toxic environment, their leaves a sickly yellow-green.

Floating islands of compressed vegetation drifted across the surface of the larger pools, each one dripping with condensed poison that fell in steady streams. The air itself felt heavy and corrosive, carrying particles of toxin that would be deadly to weaker beings.

What was most astonishing to Noah’s mind was how across this entire region, the natural environment held poisonous concentrations that would actually melt the bones or cause the complete deterioration of any entity with Complexity and Purity below Septillion levels.
"That one there should do nicely," Tor said such words as Noah was still cataloging the environmental hazards. The entity pointed approximately ten Gigaparsecs away across the toxic landscape.
Noah’s gaze followed the direction and focused on what Tor had indicated.
A monstrous abomination could be seen in the distance, its form massive.

The creature resembled a titanic toad, but warped and magnified. Its skin was a mottled mix of dark green and purple that seemed to shift and pulse with internal toxins. The surface was covered in pustules and nodules that occasionally burst, releasing clouds of poison into the air.

Its eyes were enormous and bulbous, glowing with a sickly yellow-green light that suggested intelligence behind the bestial form. Its mouth was wide enough to swallow mountains, lined with rows of teeth that dripped with concentrated venom.

The creature’s surroundings were filled with floating rivers of stellar verdant-obsidian light that represented pure concentrated poison given form. These rivers orbited the creature like satellites, occasionally converging on its body before dispersing again.
Noah’s eyes flashed brilliantly as details of this entity flooded his perception.
|Name: Venomarch Sovereign Aspirant - Toxoghra|
|Classification: Following The Way of Poison, seeking enough distinction to attain Pre-THE|
|Complexity: 1 Decillion|
|Purity: 1 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Venom Genesis, Toxin Propagation, Corrosion Manifestation, Poison Dominion, Plague Convergence, Caustic Authority, Contamination Mastery, Virulence Supremacy|
|Current Sovereignty Progress: Attempting to establish claim over Poison|
|Status: Territorial, aggressive toward intruders|
