chapters.title: Chapter 4512: Tatakae! IV
paragraphs: Noah looked at this monstrous creature with growing concern as he compared their relative power levels.
His own Complexity and Purity had not stayed at the 63 Septillion level after he had used up his Unquantifiable Units of Everything. It had lowered.
The moment he had arrived in The Infinite Unfurling, he had continued flooding his Primus Mana and Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger intoTHE Organ of Civilization.

He had already recovered 3 Units, and was waiting for a few more minutes before he would have the full number of Nine Unquantifiable Units of Everything again. The one beneficial aspect was how they continued to be generated so long as there were fewer than nine present.
But either way, that was his current offensive capability.
And yes, one could say that Complexity and Purity became less and less important as one approachedTHE, but... this was a gap from Septillions to full Decillions!
There was an entire magnitude designation between their power levels!
In pure numerical Complexity and Purity, he was entirely outclassed. The only thing that he had within his existence to potentially fight such an entity was...

"Why do you have such a gaze of hesitation, Outsider?"Tor’s voice cut through his analysis. "Does the discrepancy between your Complexity and Purity and that little creature’s numbers bother you that much?"
He smiled with challenge.

"It will be hard for you to fight that one, certainly. But it should be entirely possible for you to take it down. Number one, it has a stupid fucking Way built entirely around Poison. The Way of Poison, so singular and so limited. Is it not ridiculous?"
Tor gestured dismissively toward the distant creature.

"You have Hunger by your side, which already gives you an advantage in consuming and negating its attacks. And I can sense even something else within you, something that has frankly made me very curious about your origins."
His eyes gleamed with interest.

"It would mean that you are doing something that even Entities who have achieved THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty cannot typically accomplish. Don’t ask me what I noticed as I won’t reveal this to you just yet, but just know that it makes you a little bit special."
He pointed at Noah’s chest.

"So you have those advantages. And the other thing that would allow you to fight that little frog there is the product of THE that I sense inside of you. You were wrapped in its glow when you first arrived in The Infinite Unfurling, before I concealed both of us."
Noah was silent after these words, understanding what Tor was referring to.

The only thing that he could think of that would potentially help him fight against a creature with so much higher Complexity and Purity was indeed the Unquantifiable Units of Everything generated byTHE Organ of Civilization!

As for the other words that Tor had mentioned regarding sensing something else within him apart from Hunger, this should naturally be his Primordial Civilization of Mana. He essentially held two complete Civilizations within his existence simultaneously.

And Tor had said that this was something that evenTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentities could not typically manage. That was certainly an interesting revelation about the uniqueness of his path.
As he was observing the creature with analytical calculation, Tor smiled and continued speaking.

"Sometimes you can have the strength to take on something and simply not know how to properly use that strength," he said with teaching intensity. "That same power and authority that brought you safely to The Infinite Unfurling, you may not truly know how to consciously wield it yet."
He stepped closer to Noah.

"So I can guide you here. That product of THE within you, it is a manifestation and representation of the smallest component of your Way of existence or your budding Absolute Sovereignty. You can choose to focus it and guide it into any specific aspect of your existence that you wish to empower."
Tor’s eyes gleamed with instructional focus.

"Or you can simply let it burn within your existence as fuel. As it burns and provides energy, you can freely use its output and power to allow you to exert the weight of your entire Way and pit it directly against another Way of existence."
He emphasized his next words carefully.

"Complexity and Purity would not matter in such a clash because you would simply be putting your Way against another’s. It is not merely the exertion of Civilizational Authority, though that is part of it. Since you have begun forging your Civilization connected to your Way of existence, it becomes a culmination that includes your Civilization, your Authority, and everything regarding your fundamental Way."
Tor gestured at Noah’s head whereTHE Organ of Civilizationresided.

"That is the power that you possess but have not yet begun to consciously utilize. Use that fuel from the scrap of THE I sense within you, and fight. Fight for your Way, and fight for your Existence."
His expression became stern.

"If you cannot even utilize your immense Way of existence against something as laughable and fucking stupid as a singular Poison Way, then that would simply be it, Outsider. Our journey together would end here and now."
His next words carried finality.

"Because if you do get devoured by that tiny little frog, I will devour that frog in turn and bring you closure by incorporating your existence into my Hunger. At least then you would serve some purpose."

Tor said this with calm certainty, and Noah remained composed at his words. He understood that this terrifying being was simply saying all of this to push him forward, to force him to reach for power he didn’t yet know how to grasp- even if he did not really need this push as he knew he had to exceed everything about himself to survive The Fallout!
And as if to make his feelings even more clear, as if the challenge wasn’t already apparent, Tor’s voice filled with genuine emotion as he spoke his next words.

"Fight, or Collapse!" he said with intensity that shook the surrounding space. "If you are the only thing protecting Little Khor in the future, you have to be strong! So fight! Show me that Khor’s faith in you is not misplaced!"
Yes.
While Tor may not know the full details of what would come to pass, he seemed to already grasp exactly where the future was headed. His only real concern was for Khor’s safety and wellbeing.
He wanted Noah to be strong, for Khor’s sake!
Noah sighed internally as he looked at the terrifying creature in the distance, observing how it moved through the toxic waters with ease, how the floating rivers of poison responded to its presence.
And then he took a step forward toward it without hesitation.
A single step.
Sometimes that was all that one needed to take in the face of impossible odds.

In the face of immense adversity and terrifying possibilities, a step was enough to begin the journey. Enough to declare one’s intention. Enough to accomplish countless things. Enough for Quintessence.
The Unquantifiable Units of Everythingwithin his existence pulsed with response to his determination.
And Noah prepared to fight an entity a thousand times more powerful than himself, armed only with fragments ofTHEand the unyielding will to survive.
The crimson-gold flames ofTHEImmolation continued to burn across his form, but now they would serve as a reminder.
He had already survived one THE entity’s curse.
What was one more impossible challenge?

chapters.title: Chapter 4513: Tatakae! V
paragraphs: Noah took a step toward Toxoghra, and the moment he did so, the monstrous creature turned its bulbous yellow-green eyes toward him with sudden focus.
He had left the protection of Tor’s concealing authority, and his presence was now fully exposed in this toxic domain.

The creature’s massive form swelled with territorial aggression, its pustule-covered skin pulsing with increased toxin production. Its enormous mouth opened to release a roar that shook the surrounding space for Gigaparsecs in every direction.
ROOOOAAAAAR!

The sound carried concentrated waves of poison authority that turned the mist green and caused the swamp trees to wilt further. Noah’s mereappearancehad offended this creature’s territorial claim over this region.
At this moment, something unexpected occurred.

The crimson-gold flames ofTHE Immolation Of The Sacrilegious Savagethat had been wrapping around Noah’s existence shockingly receded inward. They became contained deep within his being, no longer visible on the surface.
Tor’s voice echoed out from behind with a casual explanation.

"That little creature should be able to evade the contagion of those little flames for some time if it’s careful," he said with measured words. "But I do not want to have it slip up and make a mistake and be affected by flames that are not your own power, not your own achievement."
His voice carried satisfaction.

"So I’ve gone ahead and suppressed them temporarily. They remain within you without being capable of affecting anything external. This is my gift to you, junior, to make sure that your fight is decided by your hands and your Way as much as possible."
Tor smiled with brutal satisfaction when he said this, as if he had just made the greatest joke in existence by removing Noah’s protective curse.
Noah remained analytically calm as he took another step forward and disappeared across Gigaparsecs of distance, moving ever closer to the monstrous Toxoghra through spatial compression!

The glorious standoff between them intensified as Toxoghra roared again with increased fury. A dark green sea of concentrated poison began to swirl around its massive form, orbiting like a planetary ring made of pure toxicity.
The floating rivers of stellar verdant-obsidian light that had been drifting around converged on the creature, merging with its conjured sea to create a domain of absolute poison.

Noah observed with precision that if his existence became wrapped up in just a single drop of liquid from that poisonous sea, much of his weavings would begin to unravel and deteriorate at the fundamental level.
So at this moment, he breathed out slowly and his eyes began to shine with the light of brutality and determination mixed together.
He spoke commandingly to his own existence.
"Burn an Unquantifiable Unit of Everything to support my Existence. Let my Way be expressed fully!"
The moment these words emerged from his mouth, his entire existence buzzed with wonder and possibility.
Prompts bloomed before his vision with unprecedented glory.
|THE Organ of Civilizationis joyous at the usage and purpose of the Unquantifiable Unit of Everything.|
|One Unquantifiable Unit of Everything has been utilized to allow for theTrue Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hungeraround your existence for 1 minute.|

|If your existence can elevate this Sovereignty to the utmost and infuse it with unfathomable Harvest through combat and consumption,THE Organ of Civilizationwill continue to mature gradually untilTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Mana and Hungeris attained, however immeasurably long and arduous that journey may be.|
|Current Duration: 60 seconds.|
|Warning: Use this time wisely.|
BOOM!
The phenomenon that erupted around Noah was glorious beyond description.

Gold-blue seas filled with crimson stellar brilliance began to rage around his form like a living aura of concentrated authority. His entire figure became surrounded by this swirling ocean of power that represented the fundamental nature of his chosen Way.
His appearance transformed dramatically.
Gold-blue wings erupted from his back, each feather composed of compressed Mana that sparkled with inner light. The wings spread wide, spanning what looked like light-years in their full extension.

His eyes released crimson beams of pure light that cut through the toxic atmosphere, illuminating everything they touched. His hair floated upward as if suspended in water, each strand glowing with blue-gold radiance.

His skin took on a celestial quality, appearing simultaneously solid and translucent, as if he existed partially in multiple states. Patterns of flowing Mana traced across his flesh in intricate designs that shifted and evolved.
His expression burned with glory and determination as he roared toward Toxoghra at this moment, his entire visage seeming like a primordial beast declaring war against the natural order!
The True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hungerfor 1 minute per Unquantifiable Unit of Everything!
Using such a rare and precious fuel to enter such a glorious state of existence meant that he had to use this one minute to its absolute fullest potential!
So...
"Fight!"
His voice boomed out across the distance as he took another step forward, closing the gap.
"Fight!"
He got ever closer to Toxoghra as the creature also roared toward him in response, its full Sovereignty of Poison being expressed through the swirling toxic sea!
"FIGHT!"
Noah roared one last time as he surged forward at maximum speed, and the swirling poisonous sea of Toxoghra clashed directly with his swirling blue-gold sea filled with crimson stellar light!
The contact between these two Ways caused the surrounding space to fizzle and tremble violently. Reality itself strained under the pressure of conflicting Sovereignties asserting their dominance.
A glorious high-paced symphony of battle began!

The impacting seas created explosions of authority that obliterated everything nearby. The poisonous sea held vastly more Complexity and Purity, powered by Toxoghra’s Decillion-level existence. By all conventional measurements, they should have devoured Noah’s seas of Mana and Hunger which held merely Septillions.
And yet, Mana and Hunger were not pushed back at all!

Because they were unfathomably grand Ways that touched on fundamental aspects of existence itself. Even if Poison was more complex currently in raw numerical terms, how could it possibly stand against the pure expression of Mana and Hunger?
This became the first time in his existence that Noah truly observed how Complexity and Purity could be overcome with the sheer expression of a much higher and much grander Way of existence!
The realization was profound and terrifying in its implications.
And at the point of impact where their seas clashed with explosive force, Noah and Toxoghra also met in direct combat!

Noah’s hands, wreathed in the swirling seas of Mana and Hunger, shot forward with devastating speed. His arms transformed mid-strike into 9 heads of a Primordial Mana-Flame Wyrm, their serpentine forms writhing with glorious power of his Way.
Their jaws opened wide to unleash beams of blue-gold flaming brilliance that burned with the heat of collapsing folds!
Meanwhile, Toxoghra unleashed a plague sea of concentrated poison forward from its massive mouth. The toxic wave contained every variation of venom and corruption it had mastered over eons.
The two attacks collided!
CRASH!
The explosion carved a crater in the swamp that extended for hundreds of light-years, vaporizing the poisonous waters and turning the ancient trees to ash instantly.
Noah was pushed backward by the force of impact, his feet carving trenches through the compressed ground as he struggled to maintain position.
Toxoghra...was still many times stronger. Even with the difference in their Ways, this fucking toad was stronger!
Toxoghra pressed its advantage immediately.

The creature lunged forward with surprising speed for its massive size, its enormous body moving through the toxic waters like a torpedo. One of its massive limbs swung out to strike Noah with the force of a Fold-killing impact.
BOOM!

Noah raised his arms to block, but the sheer difference in sheer power and Sovereignty meant the blow sent him flying backward. He crashed through a swamp mountain, his body carving a tunnel straight through the poisonous stone before emerging on the other side.
Golden Blood sprayed from his mouth as he recieved a direct impact from the display of The Way of Poison! The Sovereignty of Poison!

ButThe True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hungerimmediately went to work, flooding his damaged tissues with healing authority. The injuries began to close even as Toxoghra pursued relentlessly.
The monstrous entity opened its mouth and unleashed a technique.
"Plague Breath: Ten Thousand Toxin Cascade!"

A waterfall of different colored poisons erupted from Toxoghra’s maw, each shade representing a different form of toxicity. Green for corrosion, purple for necrosis, yellow for paralysis, black for dissolution.
The cascade spread across light-years of space, impossible to dodge completely.

Noah’s wings flared as he attempted to evade, His Way of Existence churning furiously all around him, but portions of the toxic waterfall sliced through his Mana and Hunger and caught his left arm and leg.
The limbs immediately began to liquefy, flesh melting away to reveal bone beneath!
Oh!
Oh!!!
The pain was excruciating, but Noah roared through it!
His Way surged through the damaged areas, Mana reconstructing tissue while Hunger devoured the invasive poison. Within seconds, the limbs had fully regenerated.
But Toxoghra was already upon him again!
The creature’s massive foot came down like a hammer, aiming to crush Noah entirely. He rolled aside at the last instant, the impact creating a crater where he had been floating.
Noah retaliated by transforming his entire right arm into a single massive Wyrm head that lunged forward to bite into Toxoghra’s leg, The Way of Hunger blazing!
The jaws clamped down with grinding force, tearing through toxic flesh and devouring everything they could.
Toxoghra howled in pain and kicked violently, sending Noah tumbling across the landscape again. He smashed through three more poisonous mountains before managing to stabilize himself.
The battle was clearly weighted in Toxoghra’s favor at this time as this fucker was truly powerful- this being something that nobody could deny!

The vastly more complex entity, paired with its Way that it had refined for eons longer than Noah had even existed, pushed Noah back repeatedly. With every major impact, Noah was thrown and smashed across this grand and terrifying swamp region as Way clashed against Way, and neither Way gave up!
Even as the True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger continued to protect his internal existence, externally his body was taking tremendous punishment everytime they continued to clash.
He would try to keep things long ranged, but Toxoghra did not relent and came as close as he could his way deadly!

His skin and muscle became shredded repeatedly as they got infected with concentrated poison that Mana and Hunger had to constantly heal and cleanse. The only reason his core existence wasn’t reached and destroyed was because his Way continued to burn brightly around him like armor. Like an illusory form of his Living Mana-Born Existential Armor!
But the external damage was mounting.
In the impacts that followed...
Half of Noah’s face was melted off by a direct splash of acid poison, revealing his skull beneath. His chest was punctured by a crystallized poison spear that Toxoghra conjured, creating a hole!
His left arm was torn completely off at one point, flying through the air before dissolving into toxic residue.
And yet, every injury healed within seconds as his Way refused to let him fall!
The battle raged across the entire swamp region, their clash creating permanent scars in the landscape.
And then came a point where Noah felt his Way shining brilliantly after he...came in contact with The Way of Poison so much and even felt it all within his existence from thr many injuries.
Noah looked at the monstrous Toxoghra through eyes that blazed with realization. Blood dripped from his constantly-healing wounds as he bellowed out with commanding authority.

"Your poison was powered by my Mana." he declared with absolute certainty. "Your birth involved my Mana existing first! Your existence relied on this fundamental authority until you got to this point!"
HUUM!
The words carried the weight of truth.
"Mana is behind poison! Mana is behind all changes in existence! And Hunger consumes all things, including toxicity itself!"
After Noah made such grand declarations, Existence began to tremble!

Noah retaliated by transforming his entire right arm into a single massive Wyrm head that lunged forward to bite into Toxoghra’s leg, The Way of Hunger blazing!
The jaws clamped down with grinding force, tearing through toxic flesh and devouring everything they could.
Toxoghra howled in pain and kicked violently, sending Noah tumbling across the landscape again.
He smashed through three more poisonous mountains before managing to stabilize himself.
The battle was clearly weighted in Toxoghra’s favor at this time as this fucker was truly powerful- this being something that nobody could deny!
The vastly more complex entity, paired with its Way that it had refined for eons longer than Noah had even existed, pushed Noah back repeatedly.
With every major impact, Noah was thrown and smashed across this grand and terrifying swamp region as Way clashed against Way, and neither Way gave up!
Even as the True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger continued to protect his internal existence, externally his body was taking tremendous punishment everytime they continued to clash.
He would try to keep things long ranged, but Toxoghra did not relent and came as close as he could his way deadly!
His skin and muscle became shredded repeatedly as they got infected with concentrated poison that Mana and Hunger had to constantly heal and cleanse.
The only reason his core existence wasn’t reached and destroyed was because his Way continued to burn brightly around him like armor.
Like an illusory form of his Living Mana-Born Existential Armor!
But the external damage was mounting.
In the impacts that followed...
Half of Noah’s face was melted off by a direct splash of acid poison, revealing his skull beneath.
His chest was punctured by a crystallized poison spear that Toxoghra conjured, creating a hole!
His left arm was torn completely off at one point, flying through the air before dissolving into toxic residue.
And yet, every injury healed within seconds as his Way refused to let him fall!
The battle raged across the entire swamp region, their clash creating permanent scars in the landscape.
And then came a point where Noah felt his Way shining brilliantly after he...came in contact with The Way of Poison so much and even felt it all within his existence from thr many injuries.
Noah looked at the monstrous Toxoghra through eyes that blazed with realization.
Blood dripped from his constantly-healing wounds as he bellowed out with commanding authority.
"Your poison was powered by my Mana." he declared with absolute certainty.
"Your birth involved my Mana existing first!
Your existence relied on this fundamental authority until you got to this point!"
HUUM!
The words carried the weight of truth.
"Mana is behind poison!
Mana is behind all changes in existence!
And Hunger consumes all things, including toxicity itself!"
After Noah made such grand declarations, Existence began to tremble!

chapters.title: Chapter 4514: Brutality! I
paragraphs: The battle continued with Noah taking the offensive!
He surged forward with renewed purpose, his wings propelling him at speeds that distorted existence!
His mouth opened to release a beam of blue-gold light composed of septillions of individual fireballs compressed together.
The beam struck Toxoghra’s chest and detonated!
BOOM!
The creature was pushed backward for the first time, its toxic sea disrupted by the explosion.

Noah pressed the attack. His arms transformed into the nine-headed Wyrm configuration, and each head unleashed a different assault. Some bit with crushing jaws, others breathed flames, others released beams of concentrated Primus Mana.
Toxoghra retaliated with its own techniques.
"Virulent Spear Garden!"
Thousands of crystallized poison spears erupted from the toxic waters, each one seeking Noah’s form with homing precision. Several found their mark, puncturing his torso and limbs.

But Noah simply roared andpulledthe spears out of his own body, his wounds healing even as he did so. He used the momentum of removing the spears to spin and deliver a devastating kick filled with Seas of His Sovereignty to Toxoghra’s jaw.
CRACK!
The impact shattered several of the creature’s teeth, sending them flying like meteors.
The battle’s brutality intensified further.

Above Noah’s head, a massive blue-gold throne materialized out of compressed Mana and Hunger. The throne was the size of a continent, ornate and majestic, carved with patterns that represented his Way with a glimmer of Tyranny.
Glorious Tyranny burning with a colorless veil of Quintessence!
It descended like the judgment of existence itself!
CRASH!

The throne’s weight crushed down on Toxoghra, driving the creature into the toxic waters with tremendous force. The swamp exploded upward from the impact, poisonous liquid raining down across light-years.
But Toxoghra was far from defeated!
"Sovereignty Evolution: Adaptive Toxin!"
The creature’s body began to shift and mutate, its poison adapting specifically to counter Mana and Hunger. New toxins emerged that were designed to corrupt these specific authorities.
When these adapted poisons made contact with Noah’s protective aura, they actually managed to penetrate deeper than before. Noah felt his Way being challenged at a fundamental level.

His left leg was caught in a splash of this adapted toxin and began to deteriorate more rapidly than his healing could compensate. The limb collapsed into bubbling flesh before his Hunger finally managed to devour the invasive substance.
The leg regrew, but the message was clear: Toxoghra was learning and adapting.
Noah responded by evolving his own approach.
His entire body began to glow brighter as he infused...the glorious allure of infinity of his way. Endless seas of Primus Mana and Hunger erupted!
His body split into nine separate serpentine forms, each one a perfect copy surrounded by blue-gold flames. The nine Wyrms circled Toxoghra from different angles, attacking in coordinated patterns.
Toxoghra tried to track all nine simultaneously but struggled. Bites and burns began accumulating across its massive form as the Nine Noah’s struck from every direction.
The creature’s toxic sea expanded outward violently in a desperate area attack.
"Sovereignty Domain: Ocean of Eternal Dissolution!"
The entire battlefield became saturated with such concentrated toxicity that reality itself began to break down. Space fractured, time stuttered, and causality bent.
Time stopped completely!
Eight of Noah’s nine forms dissolved immediately upon contact with this ultimate technique.

But the ninth form had transformed entirely into pure infinite energy. Noah had converted his body into a spear composed of septillions of blue-gold fireballs, each one containing concentrated Primus Mana and Hunger.
He was purely...Primus Mana and Hunger. Purely his way, carrying a deadly sharpness of infinity!
The spear pierced straight through the Ocean of Eternal Dissolution, the flames burning away toxicity through sheer intensity of opposing authority.
And then the spear passed through Toxoghra’s body!

The creature’s massive form was punctured from chest to back, a tunnel of burning destruction carved through its existence. Organs vaporized, toxic blood boiled away, and the creature’sWaybegan to unravel.
The Way of Poison began to unravel!
Toxoghra crashed backward into a massive poisonous mountain, its body twitching and convulsing as it tried desperately to heal.
Noah reformed his body and came to float above the fallen creature.
He looked down at Toxoghra with eyes that blazed with Quintessence!

"Your Way of Poison," he said with commanding authority, "is encompassed by my Way of Mana. Mana existed before Poison. Mana will exist after Poison. And my Hunger consumes all things, including the very concept of toxicity you sought to claim Sovereignty over."
His voice grew louder.
"In the end, the hierarchy of Ways is absolute. Mine supersedes yours!"
Noah’s mouth opened unnaturally wide, stretching far beyond what should have been physically possible. The opening became a void of blue-gold light mixed with crimson stellar brilliance.
And he began to devour Toxoghra completely!
He began to devour The Way of Poison as green virulent droplets became blue gold rapidly!
Oh!
The massive creature tried to resist, tried to escape, but Noah’s Hunger was absolute in this moment. Toxoghra’s form began to compress and flow into Noah’s mouth like water down a drain.
The creature’s roars of defiance became weaker and weaker until they faded entirely.
Within moments, all of Toxoghra, along with its barely-formed Sovereignty of Poison, had been completely consumed!
The battlefield fell silent except for the bubbling of toxic waters.

Noah floated in the air, his body covered in healing wounds that closed rapidly. His True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger still blazed around him, though he could feel the duration nearing its end.
Prompts bloomed before his vision.
|GLORIOUS VICTORY ACHIEVED|
|Your Way of Existence has advanced further through triumphant combat.|
|THE Organ of Civilization has advanced further as you devour immense efforts, harvest, and the barely-formed Sovereignty of Poison.|
|Complexity increased by: 1 Nonillion|
|Purity increased by: 1 Nonillion|
|Additional Boon: Understanding of Poison-based Sovereignties has been cataloged for future reference.|
|Additional Boon: Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to supersede all poison-based concepts.This will now and forever remain true|
|Additional Boon: Combat experience against entities of higher Complexity has been successfully integrated.|
|THE Organ of Civilization Progress: 0.15% toward THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger|
From the distance, the figure of Tor began to clap his hands slowly while looking at Noah’s body that was still healing from deadly injuries all across its surface.
"Good, my junior!" Tor called out with satisfaction."You have taken down this weak enemy admirably!"
His smile widened with brutal anticipation.
"I already have the next nine opponents picked out for you, though they might be a tiny bit stronger than this one was. Shall we continue your education?"
Noah looked at his own hands, feeling the power flowing through his existence, and smiled despite the exhaustion.
He had just defeated an entity with Decillions of Complexity using only Septillions boosted by the True Expression of his Way.
He was beginning to understand whatTHEtruly meant.
"Let’s continue," Noah said with calm determination.
The crimson-gold flames remained suppressed within him, but his own power was growing rapidly.
This was the path forward.
This was his Way, gloriously and brutaly so.
This was The Way!

chapters.title: Chapter 4515: Brutality! II
paragraphs: The Way.
After defeating a terrifying enemy that should have been far beyond his capabilities, Noah found himself thinking about this concept again and again. He could not get his mind off the topic.

As he stood there amidst the devastation of what he had just accomplished in this poisonous region, he found himself looking upward to the expanse of roiling mists and terrifying environments that composed The Infinite Unfurling.
He voiced out his thoughts with calm certainty.
"The Way is... totality."
HUUM!
His existence buzzed as if he was touching upon something of profound profundity, as if Existence itself was acknowledging his understanding.
Tor heard him say this after his glorious victory and appeared beside him again. The entity looked Noah over from head to toe as if he had passed some sort of critical test.
"Yes," Tor said with satisfaction gleaming in his abyssal eyes. "The Way is the totality of how one lives their existence. Not just how you fight, but everything."
He gestured broadly.

"The way one talks, the way one walks, the way they eat, the way they shit, the way they fuck, the way they sleep, the way they breathe... all of it has to match the fundamental nature of your claimed Sovereignty. If your Way is Hunger, you have to hunger in totality across every single thing that you do. Not just in battle, not just when consuming enemies, but in everything."
His voice took on a glorious quality.

"You are barely just beginning to discover your Sovereignty, Outsider. The more you use your Way of existence in legitimately applicable ways, like having your Way oppose other Ways in direct confrontation, it will be like you are honing your blade and making it sharper and sharper with each stroke."
He looked at Noah with intensity.

"You realize more and more about your Way of existence through use, through conflict, through application. After a battle like the one you just fought, where you exerted your Way with that glimmer of THE in your existence through, you should be extremely perceptive to your Way of existence right now."
Tor’s smile widened.

"You may even feel as if you’re standing at the top of Existence. As if you are untouchable, invincible, absolute. This is a unique and good state of mind to be in, a heightened awareness that allows for rapid growth. We just need to make sure that it does not get you killed through overconfidence."
He gestured toward the horizon.

"But it is also why I had multiple other opponents already located that you could fight next. When your Way burns brightly as it is right now, when you can feel every aspect of your Sovereignty with crystal clarity, we have to continue striking the iron while it burns hot and see just how far you can get before this state of heightened awareness fades."
Noah nodded slightly at this wisdom, and when he spoke, his voice carried the weight of absolute certainty.
"Mana and Hunger," he said with calm authority. "These are not merely Weavings I wield. They are thetotalityof my existence."
His eyes gazed into the distance as he continued.

"When I breathe, I am breathing in Mana from the surroundings and hungrily devouring the authority in the atmosphere to fuel my existence. When I move, my body burns Mana and hungers for more movement, more action, more advancement. When I think, my thoughts are composed of Mana arranged in patterns, and my mind hungers for knowledge, for understanding, for revelation, for Quintessence."
His hands clenched into fists.

"When I fight, I am not simply using Mana and Hunger as weapons. IamMana and Hunger manifested in physical form, opposing all that stands before me. When I consume my enemies, I am not merely growing stronger. I am expressing the fundamental truth of my Way: that all things can be broken down into Mana, and all things hunger to become more than they are."
Noah’s voice grew more commanding.

"My Way is infinitely profound because I can apply it in countless manifestations. Every action I take, every word I speak, every thought I process, all of it reinforces and deepens my understanding of what Mana and Hunger truly represent at the most fundamental level of existence."
His gaze turned cold and tyrannical.

"So yes. Let us see who else will be cut down for the sake of my Way. Let us see what other so-called Sovereignties will be devoured and incorporated. Let us continue until my understanding reaches such depths that evenTHEentities will have to acknowledge it."
Tor’s eyes shone with brilliant satisfaction at such words. Obsidian-crimson waves of Hunger wrapped around both of them, and they disappeared from the poisonous swamp.

Noah felt the surging waves of spatial compression all around them as they traveled. He continued to look at his hands, feeling the terrifying strength of the True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger that had faded away and now waited to be activated once more.
It could only be unleashed with the usage of a product that could only come fromTHE Organ of Civilization.

He continued endlessly pouring more and more of his Primus Mana and Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger into the Organ as he knew that the more it developed, the more Unquantifiable Units of Everything he would likely be capable of forging simultaneously.

TowardTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, this authority in the form of Mobius strips would be something unfathomably normal for him to possess. They would make up every single ounce and iota of his power.
When such time came, how much closer would he be to being capable of withstanding The Fallout?
His eyes flashed coldly at the thought as he focused on his surroundings.
Tor seemed to be looking at him and smiling silently before he spoke with approval.

"I had expected you to be burning with arrogance after such a victory, drunk on the feeling of power," he said with measured words. "But you seem to be reining it in a great deal. It is a good quality."
His expression became stern.

"Be strong, yes. Be confident in your Way, absolutely. But do not forget that you are still weak in the grand scheme of things. Use that weakness as if it is a monstrous predator chasing you, forcing you to run unfathomably fast toward more strength."
His voice dropped.

"Because if that monster does ever catch you, if you come across another THE entity that simply wants to use you as a snack and you cannot escape or hide, no matter how grand your Way of existence is, if it has not matured and developed sufficiently, it will be snuffed out completely."
He gestured ahead.
"But hey, here we are. Let’s see how much you can grow before something inevitably happens to derail us...haha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4516: Brutality! III
paragraphs: Noah clenched his fist and continued feeling the immensity of his Way as he looked around and felt a wave of scalding heat wash over him.
The region they had arrived in was dramatically different from the poisonous swamp.

This domain was filled with countless layers of volcanic smoke that rose in towering columns stretching toward the sky. Churning volcanic mountains released extremely complex and pure volcanic materials in continuous eruptions.

Molten brilliance flowed like rivers between the mountains, glowing with crimson-orange-gold light that illuminated the perpetual twilight. The lava was condensed authority given liquid form, each drop containing enough power to obliterate Folds.
Geysers of superheated plasma erupted at irregular intervals, creating fountains of stellar fire that arced across the sky before raining down as meteoric destruction.

The entire region was surrounded by crimson mountains that pulsed with internal heat, their peaks glowing like forge fires. Floating meteorites spun in orbital patterns overhead, each one burning with such intense heat that space itself warped around them.
A single spinning meteorite colliding with an unprepared entity could collapse anyone with mere hundreds of Septillions in Complexity and Purity instantly.
No weak Living Existences or Early Creatures could survive here!
Noah’s gaze did not even need to be directed before he found the target that Tor had brought him to.
His eyes flashed with a light of tyranny as he observed another glorious monstrosity.
The creature was a nightmare given flesh and fire.

Its body was serpentine and elongated, stretching for what looked like light-years in length. But it had no eyes, no visible sensory organs at all. Its head was smooth and rounded, featureless except for a massive circular mouth lined with rings of crystallized flame teeth.

The skin appeared pale and translucent, almost sickly, but this was deceptive. The flesh burned with crimson lava flowing just beneath the surface like blood in veins. Flames erupted from pores across its entire body in rhythmic pulses.
Its neck could extend to impossible lengths, and the creature moved with disturbing fluid grace despite its titanic size. The tail ended in a whip-like appendage that left trails of fire in the air.
With a mere flash of light, Noah saw its details.

Noah saw its details and gauged the threat calmly.
The Way of Fire.
Tor began to speak as he prepared to explain the nature of this opponent.

"This one is another entity that is a bit stronger than the first, with its Way being another limited path as it focuses solely on Fire, which can fall under an umbrella of many broader concepts. For this one—"
Before Tor could even finish his explanation, Noah took a step forward to leave the veil of concealment that this being naturally held.
He spoke with glorious certainty.
"I will take it from here."
Tor’s smile became even wider behind him as he said with satisfaction, "Good, good!"
Noah floated domineeringly toward the creature, his posture radiating absolute confidence. He gave the command internally with calm authority.
"Burn another Unquantifiable Unit of Everything. Let my Way be fully expressed."
|THE Organ of Civilization rejoices at continued combat application.|

As his body began to burn with the True Expression of The Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger, the creature he was approaching roared toward him with fury.
ROOOOAAAAAR!

The temperature in the surroundings directly increased to levels that would extinguish even creatures at Nonillion Complexity and Purity! The air itself ignited, burning with plasma fire that consumed oxygen and replaced it with pure thermal energy.
The floating meteorites began to glow brighter, responding to Pyrokhan’s rage.
And yet, while surrounded by the glorious weight of his Way manifested fully, Noah did not even feel a change in temperature.
His protective aura of blue-gold and crimson stellar light simply negated the heat as irrelevant.
He spoke with imposing authority as he approached the eyeless creature.

"You play with the Way of Fire," he said with cold certainty. "What do you think allows your sparks to flicker and bloom? When the first flame formed in existence, what do you think it was composed of?"
His voice carried absolute conviction.
"It was Mana!"
BOOM!

As he said this, Noah’s body became surrounded by extremely concentrated seas of blue-gold and crimson Primus Mana and Hunger. He allowed it to form into Nonillions of miniature Primordial Fireballs that began condensing around his entire body.
But most of them gathered toward his legs and hands, concentrating at the extremities of his limbs.

The extremities began to pulse and shine with an increasingly concentrated glow of blue-gold and crimson stellar light. His entire figure became extremely prominent in this volcanic hellscape, outshining even the molten rivers.
For his entrance and first meeting with Pyrokhan, he shockingly raised his right foot as if he planned to step on this massive titanic creature!
His foot swirled with endless concentrations of his Way, visible authority coiling around it like dragons made of fire and light.
He was truly learning how to manipulate his Way of existence, testing out different methods of exerting his influence.
Noah’s gaze flashed with immense tyranny and Quintessence amidst unfathomable calmness as he spoke his declaration.
"In the minute to come, I will pound your Way until it understands that even Fire belongs only under Mana and Hunger!"
The creature roared in defiance, and the battle began!

Churning volcanic mountains released extremely complex and pure volcanic materials in continuous eruptions.
Molten brilliance flowed like rivers between the mountains, glowing with crimson-orange-gold light that illuminated the perpetual twilight.
The lava was condensed authority given liquid form, each drop containing enough power to obliterate Folds.
Geysers of superheated plasma erupted at irregular intervals, creating fountains of stellar fire that arced across the sky before raining down as meteoric destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 4517: Brutality! IV
paragraphs: Pyrokhan’s entire body coiled and then lunged with apocalyptic force. Its movements were cataclysmic, each motion forming flaming mountains and volcanic eruptions in its wake.

As it moved, volcanoes spontaneously formed from the sheer heat and pressure of its passage. Each volcano immediately erupted, launching continent-sized masses of molten rock toward Noah at relativistic speeds. As if they were tachyons of molten brilliance traveling far faster than light itself!
The surrounding existence melted from the impacts. Space liquified,time burned away, and causality itself became unstable.
Noah raised his right foot, now glowing like a blue-gold sun, andstompeddown on the first incoming volcanic mountains.
CRASH!
His foot, wrapped in the True Expression of his Sovereignty, erased everything, breaking down theWay of Fire that composed it and converting it into pure Mana that he absorbed.
Pyrokhan responded by opening its massive circular mouth and unleashing a beam of concentrated fire that could have melted Primordial Folds.
Noah raised both hands, his arms now glowing with the same solar intensity as his feet, and...clapped them together.
PAH!
BOOM!
The clap created a shockwave of Mana and Hunger that intercepted the fire beam and devoured it entirely!
But Pyrokhan was relentless.
The creature’s body coiled around the battlefield, creating a ring of volcanic mountains that all erupted simultaneously toward the center where Noah floated.
Hundreds of Decillion-level volcanic projectiles converged on his position from every direction!

Noah’s limbs blazed brighter as he spun in place, his arms and legs trailing arcs of blue-gold and crimson light. Each limb that struck an incoming volcano completely scorched away the fire authority that composed it.
His movements were precise and economical, wasting no energy.
But some attacks got through.

A stream of molten plasma struck his left shoulder, burning through his protective aura and charring flesh down to the bone. Another volcanic boulder crashed into his back, creating a crater in his torso.
Noah did not even make a sound.
His expression remained calm and analytical as the injuries rapidly healed, his Way flooding the damaged areas with regenerative authority.
His enemy was still much more powerful than him in raw numerical terms, but the quality of his Way was too grand for Pyrokhan to overcome.
The battle raged across the volcanic region, their clashes creating permanent scars in the landscape.
Noah continued gathering high concentrations of his Way of Mana and Hunger onto the extremities of his limbs. More and more authority compressed into smaller and smaller spaces.

Pyrokhan used fire to warp existence itself, melting everything to instsntly appear around Noah as it wrapped its elongated body around him like a constrictor, applying pressure that would have crushed everything! The creature’s skin burned with such intensity that it turned Noah’s flesh black and crispy.
Noah simply raised his arms, which now looked like endlessly radiant blue-gold suns, andpushedoutward.
CRACK!
Pyrokhan’s body was forced away, sections of its flesh scorched and burned by contact with Noah’s limbs.
The creature shrieked and created a volcanic apocalypse, summoning thousands of erupting mountains simultaneously!

Noah’s legs, also glowing like miniature suns of concentrated authority, kicked out repeatedly. Each kick generated a blade of compressed Mana and Hunger that sliced through the volcanic formations and scorched away their fire authority.
His arms punched forward, creating shockwaves that erased entire mountain ranges.
The radiance from his limbs grew brighter and brighter until it actually began to scorch away the scorching flames of Pyrokhan itself!
Eventually, as his arms and legs looked like shining blue-gold suns that outshone everything in the region, Noah spoke with calm and domineering certainty.

"Your Way of Fire," he said without emotion, "is a subset of Mana. Fire cannot exist without Mana providing its foundation.Fire cannot burn without Mana fueling its reaction.Fire cannot spread without Mana carrying its authority."
His limbs blazed even brighter.

"And Hunger consumes all things, including the very concept of heat and combustion that you have tried to claim. Your Sovereignty is incomplete. Your claim isweak. And ultimately, your entire existence can only be devoured."
The creature shrieked and bellowed with desperate fury, unleashing everything it had accumulated over eons!
A final volcanic cataclysm erupted, creating a sea of molten destruction that should have obliterated anything in the Decillions of Complexity scale!
And Noah had just stepped in the Nonillions!
Yet...
Noah simply walked forward through it, his sun-like limbs scorching away all fire authority they contacted.
He reached Pyrokhan’s main body and grabbed it with both hands.
The creature tried to burn him, tried to melt his grip, but Noah’s hands had become something beyond simple flesh.
They were manifestations of his Way made solid.
And then, brutally, he began toripPyrokhan apart.
His fingers tore through flesh that should have been impervious. His hands scorched the creature’s Sovereignty, burning away its claim to Fire piece by piece.
Pyrokhan writhed and screamed, but Noah wasmerciless.
He proceeded to brutally eat the creature’s Way of existence piece by piece, consuming its Fire Sovereignty bite by bloody bite.
His own Way shone ever brighter with each consumption!
The end scene was apocalyptic and destructive. Blood boiled and evaporated. Flesh charred and disintegrated. The surrounding existence buzzed with resonance and melted from the sheer intensity.
And when it was finally over, Noah stood alone amidst the devastation, his body still glowing with solar radiance as the last traces of Pyrokhan’s existence were absorbed.
As the battle ended, even Tor was looking at him with shining eyes of genuine appreciation.
This being who loved to talk, who always had commentary and philosophy to share...
Had no words.
He simply smiled with profound satisfaction and nodded once.
The message was clear: Noah had exceeded expectations again!
And they were just getting started.
As glory unfolded in a far, far distant past...
The Present Era.
In the Heart of Elemental, within the Transcendent Elemental Folds.

The domain stretched across Gigaparsecs of compressed space, a testament to the ancient power of the residual Civilization of Elementals. Glorious elemental towers rose like titans frozen in eternal ascent, each one carved from crystallized authority that pulsed with fundamental forces.
The entire region was surrounded by spinning Transcendent Wheels of Existence, massive constructs that rotated with glory.
This was the seat of power for the Living Elementals, a place that had stood unconquered for eons!
Well, until today...as this was about to drastically be changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4518: Brutality! V
paragraphs: The Infiniverse arrived at the center of the Heart of Elementals with the inevitability of a falling star.

Her humanoid form materialized above the grand central plaza, and the moment she appeared, existence itself trembled with acknowledgment. She stood suspended in the air, her figure composed of flowing Omniverses and rivers of verdant-gold light.
Above her, a million Primus Inevitabilities blotted out the sky like a swarm of ascending titans.

The Infiniverse’s aura blazed outward with terrifying intensity, washing across the entire domain like a tsunami of absolute authority. The pressure was inexorable, the weight of existence itself demanding acknowledgment!
Throughout the Heart of Elementals, every being with even a modicum of power felt that presence.

The Kleos Council of Elementals, the governing body of this ancient domain, had no choice but to respond as they were all already at high alert ever since Primus Inevitabilities appeared and unleashed Sparks across the folds, but previously...none of these entities had forced anyone to take the Sparks.
But the new aura they felt seemed purposefully intimidating!
So...

Spatial tears opened across the plaza as figures began to emerge. The Dukes of Elemental, each one a powerhouse who commanded respect and controlled vast territories, assembled with grim determination.
Their combined presence should have been overwhelming, a display of concentrated power that could reshape reality.
But before The Infiniverse’s blazing aura, they appeared... diminished.

She gazed down at the assembled Dukes with eyes that held infinite calculation and cold purpose. She did not need to be here. Protos and other Primus Inevitabilities could simply lead the charge. But...she came because she wanted to!
When she spoke, her voice carried across Gigaparsecs without effort.
"One hand offers fealty," she said with calm finality, extending her right hand forward. "And one hand offers death."
Her left hand remained at her side, but the implication was clear.
"What will you choose?"

The plaza fell into tense silence as the Dukes of Elemental looked at each other with visible uncertainty. Some showed anger at such brazen disrespect. Others displayed caution, having sensed the vast gulf in power.
A particularly powerful Duke of Elemental stepped forward from the assembled group as he seemingly unveiled hidden power!
His form pulsed with 20 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, making him one of the strongest beings present!
He was wreathed in crimson flames that burned with the authority of primordial fire, and his voice boomed out with defiance.

"We are the Living Elementals! In existence, there is decorum, there is understanding. The Coalition of Living Existences stand together as if you attack one, you attack all. We will not be bullied by-"
Before his words could even finish, The Infiniverse raised her leg with casual grace and stepped down through the air.

An illusory stellar leg formed above the Duke, vast beyond comprehension. It was composed of compressed Omniverses and Folds, and flowing with authority that represented a semblance of the totality of her power.
The leg descended with a terrifying force.
CRASH!

The Duke of Elemental was crushed downward, his flames extinguished instantly as he was driven into the plaza floor. The impact created a crater that stretched for light-years, and the Duke lay at its center, nearly decimated.
His body twitched weakly, still clinging to existence but utterly defeated.
The Infiniverse’s expression did not change. She looked at the rest of the assembled Dukes with the same calm certainty.
"Do not waste my time," she said with cold authority. "Fealty, or death?"
HUUM!
The message was unmistakably clear!
And it did not take too long.
Not really!
One by one, the Dukes of Elemental began moving toward her outstretched right hand. Their movements were reluctant at first, pride warring with survival instinct.
But as they approached her extended palm, something extraordinary occurred.

Sparks of The Way of Mana began producing from her hand, brilliant blue-gold motes of light that danced in the air. Each spark represented an offer, a connection, a pathway to serving under her Master.
The first Duke to reach obtained the Spark and felt the inclusion into The Way of Mana!
Oh, Mana!
Fire fueled by Mana burned hotter. Water infused with Mana flowed more fluidly. Earth reinforced by Mana stood more solidly.

The Duke stepped back with newfound understanding and knelt, acknowledging fealty with shaking eyes as it did not even feel like they lost something, with their progression over the elements seemingly made even grander!
One by one, the others followed.

The conquest unfolded with efficiency as each Duke of Elemental accepted The Way of Mana and submitted to The Infiniverse’s authority. Even the Duke who had been crushed eventually crawled forward and accepted the inevitable.
When the last Duke had sworn fealty, The Infiniverse’s gaze turned upward to the million Primus Inevitabilities hovering above.
She commanded them with absolute authority.

"Go stand as nodes and break apart these Transcendent Folds. Everything shall be devoured into The Infiniverse. The lifeforms within these Folds will gain entry only after complete submission and fealty."
Her voice carried the weight of inevitability.
The Primus Inevitabilities responded as one, their voices creating a chorus that shook existence.
"We shall fulfill our duty!"
They dispersed instantly, each one moving to positions around the vast expanse of the Transcendent Elemental Folds.
And then they began to work.

The Primus Inevitabilities released waves of Primus Mana that connected between them, forming a vast web of authority. The web began to constrict, applying pressure to the very fabric of the Transcendent Folds.
Primus Mana permeated across The Transcendent Elemental Folds like an invasive species that could not be resisted. It seeped into every corner, every hidden pocket, every defended sanctuary.
Regions began to split as the Folds themselves were torn apart at the fundamental level!
Entire territories that had existed as separate spaces started flowing toward the humanoid form of The Infiniverse.
She stood at the center of it all, arms spread wide, absorbing everything.
Mountains of crystallized elemental authority flowed into her like water into an ocean. Forests of living flame were consumed and integrated. Seas of liquid lightning were devoured whole.
The lifeforms within these regions had two choices: submit and be incorporated into The Infiniverse, or resist and be left behind in regions of collapsed existence.
All chose survival. All Wheels of Existence holding Weak Fold Dwellers and Living Existences flowed towards her as these beings would passively be filtered and branded to ensure nothing was missed!
Waves of Elementals, from the weakest to the most powerful, streamed toward The Infiniverse and accepted The Way of Mana.
Her humanoid form remained at the center, but The massive Infiniverse itself in the distant Wandering Territories....
New Frequencies of Existence bloomed within her. New Wheels of Existence began to spin. New domains formed to house the conquered territories and their inhabitants.
The process was brutal in its totality but not unnecessarily cruel. Those who submitted were welcomed. And all faced no other result but submission.
And this was only the beginning of The Infiniverse’s campaign of conquest.
The final image was one of immensity and glory.

The Infiniverse stood radiant at the center of what had once been the Heart of Elementals, now transformed into another domain within her vast existence. Primus Mana flowed through everything like golden blood through veins.
Above, the Primus Inevitabilities continued their work, dismantling the last remaining pockets of existance.
The Infiniverse had declared that she would devour every Fold, conquer every territory, and subsume every fragment of power outside THE Loom.
And nothing would stand in her way.
This was conquest, and this was duty.
This was love expressed through absolute domination!

His form pulsed with 20 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, making him one of the strongest beings present!
He was wreathed in crimson flames that burned with the authority of primordial fire, and his voice boomed out with defiance.
"We are the Living Elementals!
In existence, there is decorum, there is understanding.
The Coalition of Living Existences stand together as if you attack one, you attack all.
We will not be bullied by-"
Before his words could even finish, The Infiniverse raised her leg with casual grace and stepped down through the air.
An illusory stellar leg formed above the Duke, vast beyond comprehension.
It was composed of compressed Omniverses and Folds, and flowing with authority that represented a semblance of the totality of her power.
The leg descended with a terrifying force.
CRASH!
The Duke of Elemental was crushed downward, his flames extinguished instantly as he was driven into the plaza floor.
The impact created a crater that stretched for light-years, and the Duke lay at its center, nearly decimated.
His body twitched weakly, still clinging to existence but utterly defeated.
The Infiniverse’s expression did not change.
She looked at the rest of the assembled Dukes with the same calm certainty.
"Do not waste my time," she said with cold authority.
"Fealty, or death?"
HUUM!
The message was unmistakably clear!
And it did not take too long.
Not really!
One by one, the Dukes of Elemental began moving toward her outstretched right hand.
Their movements were reluctant at first, pride warring with survival instinct.
But as they approached her extended palm, something extraordinary occurred.
Sparks of The Way of Mana began producing from her hand, brilliant blue-gold motes of light that danced in the air.
Each spark represented an offer, a connection, a pathway to serving under her Master.
The first Duke to reach obtained the Spark and felt the inclusion into The Way of Mana!
Oh, Mana!
Fire fueled by Mana burned hotter.
Water infused with Mana flowed more fluidly.
Earth reinforced by Mana stood more solidly.

The Duke stepped back with newfound understanding and knelt, acknowledging fealty with shaking eyes as it did not even feel like they lost something, with their progression over the elements seemingly made even grander!
One by one, the others followed.
The conquest unfolded with efficiency as each Duke of Elemental accepted The Way of Mana and submitted to The Infiniverse’s authority.
Even the Duke who had been crushed eventually crawled forward and accepted the inevitable.
When the last Duke had sworn fealty, The Infiniverse’s gaze turned upward to the million Primus Inevitabilities hovering above.
She commanded them with absolute authority.
"Go stand as nodes and break apart these Transcendent Folds.
Everything shall be devoured into The Infiniverse.
The lifeforms within these Folds will gain entry only after complete submission and fealty."
Her voice carried the weight of inevitability.
The Primus Inevitabilities responded as one, their voices creating a chorus that shook existence.
"We shall fulfill our duty!"
They dispersed instantly, each one moving to positions around the vast expanse of the Transcendent Elemental Folds.
And then they began to work.
The Primus Inevitabilities released waves of Primus Mana that connected between them, forming a vast web of authority.
The web began to constrict, applying pressure to the very fabric of the Transcendent Folds.
Primus Mana permeated across The Transcendent Elemental Folds like an invasive species that could not be resisted.
It seeped into every corner, every hidden pocket, every defended sanctuary.
Regions began to split as the Folds themselves were torn apart at the fundamental level!
Entire territories that had existed as separate spaces started flowing toward the humanoid form of The Infiniverse.
She stood at the center of it all, arms spread wide, absorbing everything.
Mountains of crystallized elemental authority flowed into her like water into an ocean.
Forests of living flame were consumed and integrated.
Seas of liquid lightning were devoured whole.
The lifeforms within these regions had two choices: submit and be incorporated into The Infiniverse, or resist and be left behind in regions of collapsed existence.
All chose survival.
All Wheels of Existence holding Weak Fold Dwellers and Living Existences flowed towards her as these beings would passively be filtered and branded to ensure nothing was missed!
Waves of Elementals, from the weakest to the most powerful, streamed toward The Infiniverse and accepted The Way of Mana.
Her humanoid form remained at the center, but The massive Infiniverse itself in the distant Wandering Territories....
New Frequencies of Existence bloomed within her.
New Wheels of Existence began to spin.
New domains formed to house the conquered territories and their inhabitants.
The process was brutal in its totality but not unnecessarily cruel.
Those who submitted were welcomed.
And all faced no other result but submission.
And this was only the beginning of The Infiniverse’s campaign of conquest.
The final image was one of immensity and glory.
The Infiniverse stood radiant at the center of what had once been the Heart of Elementals, now transformed into another domain within her vast existence.
Primus Mana flowed through everything like golden blood through veins.
Above, the Primus Inevitabilities continued their work, dismantling the last remaining pockets of existance.
The Infiniverse had declared that she would devour every Fold, conquer every territory, and subsume every fragment of power outside THE Loom.
And nothing would stand in her way.
This was conquest, and this was duty.
This was love expressed through absolute domination!

chapters.title: Chapter 4519: History is Written I
paragraphs: History.
Many argued endlessly about what history actually was, debating definitions and methodologies with the passion of scholars who had devoted lifetimes to the subject.
But what was history actually, when one stripped away all pretense?
Were they not simply stories that were passed down from those who had lived longer than others? Tales told by survivors, by victors, by those with the power to ensure their version endured?

So could history always be accurate if those who had lived longer simply passed down stories of their own fabrications, shaped by bias and self-interest? Was any history actually true history, based on the accounts of many, or preserved in written texts and records that themselves could be altered and fabricated at will?

Unless one was able to go back in time to see how things actually unfolded with their own eyes, could they truly say they knew and understood the true history? Or were they simply being fed lies dressed up as truth, generation after generation?

There were countless Stories of The Earliest Folds that spoke ofTHE Living Existences and THE Creature.Of Early Creatures, Inevitabilities, and Fold Dwellers who shaped reality through their conflicts and achievements.
But was that all there was to history, these grand narratives of powers and conflicts?
Because the most pivotal thing that many needed to understand and grasp was that history was written by thevictors. History was always, inevitably, written by those who survived and triumphed.
And they could weave whatever story they wished, painting themselves as heroes or saviors, casting their enemies as monsters or tyrants, regardless of what actually occurred.
Truth became whatever the powerful decided it should be.
Truth could be written.
History could be written!
In the Infinite Unfurling.

Noah stood in the decimated volcanic region, surrounded by the aftermath of his brutal victory. The ground was scorched black for light-years in every direction, molten rivers cooled into twisted formations of glass and obsidian.
He was looking at a set of prompts that bloomed before his vision with brilliant light, and his own existence continued to buzz with glory as his Way advanced further and further with each battle.
|Your Way of Existence has advanced significantly through triumphant combat against a superior foe.|
|THE Organ of Civilizationhas advanced further as you devour immense efforts, harvest, and the barely-formed Sovereignty of Fire.|
|Complexity increased by: 66 Nonillion (New Total: 66 Nonillion+)|
|Purity increased by: 66 Nonillion (New Total: 66 Nonillion+)|
|Additional Boon: Grand Principle Fragment of Thermal Immunity is being studied by The Cheating Architect|
|Additional Boon: Grand Principle Fragment of Combustion Manipulation is being studied by The Cheating Architect.|
|Additional Boon: Understanding of Fire-based Sovereignty has been cataloged and can be referenced.|
|Additional Boon: Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to supersede all fire-based concepts at fundamental levels.|
|Additional Boon: Combat effectiveness against entities of vastly higher Complexity continues to improve.|
|THE Organ of Civilization Progress: 0.28% toward THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Unquantifiable Units of Everything Generated: 2 (Current Total: 12)|
|Note: Your mastery of True Expression continues to deepen. Each battle refines your understanding.|
Oh!
After Noah observed these prompts with satisfaction, Tor appeared before him with an approving smile.
"Ready?" he asked simply. "The next one is not stationary as they are on the move across the Infinite Unfurling."
After such words, Noah gave a light nod of acknowledgment.
Obsidian-crimson light wrapped around both of them like a protective cocoon, and they disappeared once more into the vast expanse.
An unknown number of Gigaparsecs away from Noah and Tor, in a different region of the Infinite Unfurling.

The domain was filled with radiant purple brilliance that pulsed in rhythmic waves across impossible distances. Blazing fiery purple numbers in different runic etchings floated powerfully throughout the space, each one burning with the unmistakable allure ofthe authority of time.
Numbers that represented moments, durations, sequences, and causality itself drifted like embers on unseen currents.

The entire region was suffused with the potent authority of time in its rawest form. Past, present, and future existed simultaneously here, creating a disorienting effect where one could see echoes of what had been and shadows of what might yet be.

Crystalline structures grew in impossible spirals, their formation both complete and ongoing depending on which temporal layer one observed. Rivers of temporal energy flowed upward and downward simultaneously, defying conventional direction.
At the very peak of this domain floated a smooth round purple crystalline structure the size of a continent, perfectly spherical and rotating slowly on multiple axes at once.
And on that structure, the auras of utterly terrifying beings could be felt radiating outward with suffocating intensity.

One aura was immensely domineering, their Way of existence truly and fully established as they burned with terrifying waves ofTHECivilizational Authority of Time. This was not someone approachingTHEbut someone who had achieved it and deepened their claim!

There were a few others that orbited around such terrifying authority like planets around a star, and all of them seemed to be at the Pre-THE stage of power. Each one was formidable individually, but together they created a constellation of authority that would be devastating.

At this moment, the entity that emanated the aura ofTHEfloated casually on a pulsing purple sea of temporal energy that formed beneath them like a throne. The dozen or so Pre-THE Existences formed a circle around them in a posture of attentive listening, as if receiving teachings from a master.
The Way of Time swirled all around with terrifying potency, and its origin was an extremely wild-looking woman who possessed rabbit ears that twitched with each fluctuation of temporal authority.

She was humanoid in basic structure but clearly not purely so. Her rabbit features included not just the ears but alsodigitigradelegsthat ended in powerful clawed feet, and a subtle coat of fine fur that covered portions of her exposed skin.
Her eyes pulsed with purple brilliance that seemed to see through multiple timelines simultaneously, giving her gaze an unsettling quality of knowing what you would do before you did it!

chapters.title: Chapter 4520: History is Written II
paragraphs: She was adorned in archaic clothing and accessories that appeared primitive at first glance but were actually supremely sophisticated.
What she wore was seemingly made from the skin and fur of other powerful lifeforms, and these materials still pulsed with silent radiance of Ways of Existence that had been elevated toTHE.

Her vest was crafted from scaled hide that shimmered with suppressed lightning authority. Her bracers were made from bone that still resonated with earth sovereignty. Her belt incorporated fur that held traces of wind dominion!

This meant that this entity had actually decimated or injured other existences atTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyor even higher, and had used their bodies to forge her clothing and accessories as trophies!
This wasTHE Purple River, THE Time Surfer, and her reputation was one of calculated brutality mixed with unexpected mercy.
She looked at the entities assembled around her with sharp intelligence and spoke with commanding clarity.

"You all are powerful in your own right," she said with acknowledgment. "But if you can understand your weavings of existence in relation to time, you will be able to advance truly far beyond your current limitations."
Her eyes shone with a sharp light of ingenuity as she turned toward one of the Pre-THE Existences, a being wreathed in radiant white light.

"You follow The Way of Light," she said with teaching precision. "Photons traveling through space, illumination piercing darkness, energy manifesting as visible spectrum. It seems straightforward, does it not?"
She paused for effect.

"But light has an intimate relationship with time that you have not fully grasped. Light travels at a fixed speed through space, which means it is bound by temporal constraints. When you observe distant stars, you are seeing light from the past because time was required for that light to reach you."
Her hands gestured as if manipulating invisible threads.

"If you can understand how your Way of Light intersects with time, you can manipulate not just illumination but causality itself. You can make light arrive before it departs. You can create illumination that exists in the past, present, and future simultaneously."
She leaned forward with intensity.
"Do you understand?"

Shockingly, the Pre-THE Existence she was addressing nodded with visible reluctance. Their eyes showed a light of fear mixed with unwillingness, but they could only follow these teachings because the alternative was collapse.

THE Time Surferwas effectively trying to incorporate and extract tremendous gains from their Ways of existence by connecting them with her own Way of Time. Any advancements they made while following her guidance would increase her Civilizational Authority through their connection.

And yet, none of them would be remaining true to their original Ways of existence if they incorporated the aspect of time into their own unique Sovereignties. They would become derivative, subordinate to her Time Sovereignty!

But they were not as powerful as this being, and under the threat of complete collapse or potential elevation, they followed her without question. They progressed their Sovereignties while weaving connections with time along the way, hoping the benefits would outweigh the cost.
An instant later,THE Time Surferturned toward another direction as she looked at an entity shining with calm white gold light that seemed to contain all possibilities.

"You are a unique one," she said with genuine interest. "You call yourself The Living Origin, correct? Well, whether living or dead won’t matter much in the end, because if you are walking the Way of Beginnings, you absolutely cannot be distant from time."
The Living Origin!
THE Time Surferwas actually holding The Living Origin among the dozen Pre-THE Existences gathered here!

"Origin implies the starting point of all things,"THE Time Surfercontinued with philosophical depth. "But what is a beginning without the context of time? A beginning only has meaning because time flows forward from that point. Your Way encompasses the moment of genesis, but that moment exists within the temporal framework."
She smiled with calculating precision.

"If you can understand how Origin and Time interweave, you can manipulate not just what begins but when it begins. You can create multiple simultaneous origins, or delay the genesis of something until the perfect moment. You can make endings become beginnings and beginnings become endings through temporal manipulation."
Her voice carried certainty.

"Your Way of Origin gives you power over initiation and genesis. My Way of Time gives context and control over when and how those initiations occur. Together, we could reshape the very concept of causality itself."

Opposite her sat a woman in a white-gold dress who nodded with acknowledgment, though her eyes did not hide their regal light of defiance even as she complied. The Living Origin was submitting to these teachings but not surrendering her pride or her ultimate ambitions.
THE Time Surferlooked at her calmly and laughed with genuine amusement at such defiance.
She was about to continue her lessons when something unexpected occurred.
She blinked and turned her head sharply toward a certain direction, her rabbit ears twitching with sudden alertness.
"What is this...?" she murmured with confusion bleeding into her tone.

Her Way of existence buzzed with sudden intensity as someone of her caliber possessed unfathomably powerful sensory perception when it came to anything dealing with their Way. She could sense temporal fluctuations across vast distances, detecting even the smallest discrepancies.

And at this moment, she sensed unique musings of the Way of Time that should not exist here. More specifically, a type of temporal authority that was foreign and did not belong to The Infinite Unfurling at all.
Her expression shifted to something dangerous as a smile spread across her features.

"Who the hell has come here from a different time?" she said with deadly curiosity. "This should be an impossibility. Nothing should be able to appear in The Infinite Unfurling unless it had always existed here from the beginning!"
Her eyes shone with sharpness and brutal calculation as she rose up from her seated position. The purple sea beneath her rippled with her movement.
She beckoned to the entities assembled around her with commanding authority.

"Come on, you little things," she said with a mix of condescension and purpose. "There seems to be a discrepancy in time that should not exist here, and I need to understand how it is even possible in the first place."
She paused with a predatory smile.
The dozen Pre-THE Existences rose as one, following their temporary master toward the source of the temporal anomaly.
And...
History was about to be written by whoever survived the coming encounter!
