chapters.title: Chapter 4521: History is Written III
paragraphs: In the Infinite Unfurling.
In a region filled with endlessly billowing waves of snow that stretched across countless Gigaparsecs in every direction.

The air was thick with crystalline ice particles that refracted light into prismatic colors, creating an otherworldly atmosphere of beauty mixed with deadly cold. Mountains of compacted snow rose like frozen titans, their peaks lost in clouds that themselves were composed of frozen temporal energy.
The end of a terrifying battle played out withbrutal finality.

A massive winged furred eel-like creature fell from above and crashed into a mountain of heavy snow with devastating force. The impact created an avalanche that buried the creature under millions of tons of frozen matter.

The creature was easily the size of several continents, its serpentine body covered in thick white fur that had been scorched and burned across most of its length. Most notably, it was missing one wing that had been brutally ripped from its body.
That severed wing was held up triumphantly by none other than Noah, who stood amidst the falling snow with blue-gold brilliance blazing around his form.

He opened his mouth unnaturally wide, the opening expanding far beyond what should have been physically possible, and swallowed the entire massive wing whole. His Way of Hunger devoured it instantly, breaking down the authority ofMassthat had composed it.
And then he tyrannically waved his hands upward with commanding certainty.

A sea of Mana surged in response to his will, forming beneath the buried creature and forcefully lifting its massive form up from the snow. The creature was brought directly toward Noah despite its attempts to resist, pulled by irresistible authority.
Noah opened his mouth again, even wider this time, and swallowed the entire titanic creature whole!

The scene was a terrifying one as around Noah, blue-gold brilliance visibly surged with increased intensity. His Way had grown stronger with each consumption, each battle refining his understanding and deepening his claim.
Prompts bloomed before his vision with familiar glory.
|Your Way of Existence has advanced significantly through triumphant combat.|
|THE Organ of Civilizationhas advanced further as you devour immense efforts, harvest, and the barely-formedSovereignty of Mass.|
|Complexity increased by: 100 Nonillion (New Total: 166 Nonillion)|
|Purity increased by: 100 Nonillion (New Total: 166 Nonillion)|
|Additional Boon: Grand Principle Fragment of Gravitational Manipulation is being studied by The Cheating Architect.|
|Additional Boon: Grand Principle Fragment of Density Control is being studied by The Cheating Architect.|
|Additional Boon: Grand Principle Fragment of Weight Nullification is being studied by The Cheating Architect.|
|Additional Boon: Understanding of Mass-based Sovereignties has been cataloged and can be referenced.|
|Additional Boon: Your Way of Mana has been confirmed to supersede mass-based concepts.|
|Additional Boon: Your physical body can now naturally manipulate its own mass at will.|
|THE Organ of Civilization Progress: 0.45% toward THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Unquantifiable Units of Everything Generated: 1 (Current Total: 12)|
|Note: Your understanding deepens.|
After he observed all these prompts with analytical satisfaction, Noah’s gaze lifted to the distant figure of Tor hovering above.

"I seem to be getting the hang of it more and more," Noah said with calm observation. "I want to say that pending no disruptions, I can continue to fortify my Way of Existence over the next few hours and days, but..."
His eyes narrowed with perception.
"When do I see a frown on your face for the first time?"

Yes, at this moment, Noah could actually see a frown on the face of this terrifyingly powerfulTHEentity. It was the first time such an expression had crossed Tor’s features since they had begun their massacre.
Tor blinked at Noah’s words before he shook his head with a smile that did not quite reach his eyes.

"My Hunger is very sensitive," he explained with measured words. "Anything relating to its propagation or challenges is sensed before it can fully occur. And right now, my Hunger feels a sense of challenge approaching."
He paused thoughtfully.

"A type of challenge that I have encountered a few times before across the eons. It usually means anticipation. My own Hunger can sense something coming and it begins to salivate in anticipation of what might be consumed or what might pose a genuine threat."
His expression became more serious as he continued.

"Once a Way of existence reaches a certain depth of understanding and Sovereignty, one will be able to carry out what others only believe to be possible through different Ways. Hunger should in no way be capable of telling me about things that are coming in the future. Hunger should not be able to burn or freeze or manipulate temporal flows."
He smiled with dark satisfaction.

"But it can do all of that and more, as long as one understands how to properly use their Way. And right now, my Hunger is showing me in its anticipation the image of a savage being coming toward this location with an entourage of followers."
His eyes focused on Noah.
"And you seem to be the one that attracted this savage thing, Outsider."
Noah frowned at these words as he closed his eyes and focused with his own Way of existence, extending his perception outward as far as it could reach.
He sensed nothing approaching, no threat on the horizon.

His perception had not reached the level that Tor was experiencing, and this only further demonstrated how entities that had not achievedTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywere so far below in capability. Someone could be in mortal danger and about to die, and they would not even know it until the killing blow landed.
And yet Tor already sensed the incoming threat, and had even gained an image of what that threat was before it arrived. What a glorious and terrifying capability this was!

At the same time, Noah was reminded of the immense dangers all around. While he currently had Tor as protection, he had to prepare for the inevitable possibility when he would not have such a being as a guardian.
He would be entirely defenseless, simply walking with hope through these dangerous environments. And he did not like to rely on hope.

He would either have to remain hidden while allowing his body of Ozymandias to be the one to move out freely and risk collapse, or he had to make the decision whether the unfathomably glorious opportunities in this dangerous landscape were worth potentially being collapsed before he even knew it. Worth being unable to even return to his current era.
Of course, these were all contingencies and things that he was thinking through in case things should go catastrophically wrong. As of now, he still hadTHE First Hungerwith him.
As he was processing all of this analytically, the figure of Tor smiled and spoke.

"Well, this encounter will serve as a teaching lesson,"he said with anticipation. "You can get a glimpse of the scale of power between genuine Sovereignties at THE level. It will be extremely hard for you to even perceive what is truly happening, but you should be able to catch a glimpse at least."

chapters.title: Chapter 4522: History is Written IV
paragraphs: His eyes gleamed.
“Are you ready?”
The words of Tor echoed out across the snowy domain, and before Noah could even formulate an answer, another voice cut through the atmosphere.
“My oh my, what is this?”

Noah’s gaze became solemn as he heard a voice emerge from one corner of this snowy domain, and if that voice had not echoed out deliberately, he would not have even known that the entity was there at all.
Space peeled back like layers of an onion, and an entity burning with THE Civilizational Authority emerged in all her terrifying glory.

She appeared with a glorious confidence, her rabbit ears twitching as she analyzed the scene before her. Her eyes pulsed with purple brilliance as her gaze locked onto Noah with laser focus, actually ignoring Tor entirely in her initial assessment.

Noah felt her piercing gaze as if she was trying to see right through him, to unravel every secret and mystery his existence contained. He could sense that she wanted to do much more than simply observe, and the only reason this entity was unable to act on those impulses was because of Tor’s presence.

His eyes focused immensely on this situation as he cataloged details. Behind this being, there were actually a dozen other terrifying signatures emanating authority, but all of them seemed much less powerful than her.
They appeared to be at the Pre-THE stage of power.
Noah’s gaze passed through them analytically as his attention was suddenly drawn toward the back of the group where he sensed something utterly unexpected.
Something familiar.
Familiar? What could possibly be familiar to him here?
His eyes turned heavier as his gaze actually left THE entity who was still analyzing him, and he focused far behind her where he saw a woman in a white-gold dress.
His eyes buzzed with recognition when he saw her, because the familiarity he sensed was his own Living Existential Authority of Origin flowing within his existence and resonating with her presence!
Noah’s eyes flashed with immensity as he looked at her with newfound understanding.

The woman was otherworldly in her appearance, her features so perfect they seemed almost unreal. Her hair flowed like liquid starlight, shining with white-gold brilliance that illuminated the space around her. Her eyes held an unfathomable depth, as if they contained the origin points of countless realities.
A prompt bloomed before Noah’s eyes unbidden.
|Name: ???????????? [The Living Origin...THE Living Origin?]|
|Classification: ????????????|
|Complexity: ???????????? [Displayed as Pre-THE ]|
|Purity: ???????????? [Displayed as Pre-THE]|
|Grand Principles: ????????????|
|Singularity Principles: ????????????|
|Current Sovereignty Status: Extremely advanced in Way of Origin|
|Warning: This being’s current existence exhibits power of Pre-THE designation.|
|Analysis suggests this is likely a significant deception- a fucking lie.|
|Note: Entity is far more developed than surface observation indicates.|
|Threat Assessment: EXTREME|
Noah looked at all of this information with analytical marvel, his mind racing through implications.

Opposite him, his intense gaze made the eyes of The Living Origin also lock onto him calmly. She looked him over with the same analytical precision he was using on her, and recognition seemed to spark in her gaze as well no matter how much it was hidden!
He had actually met one of THE Living Existences in the Infinite Unfurling, encountering them before they were known as the esteemed beings they would become in his era!
Seeing The Living Origin also got him questioning the nature of what truly happened in this past.

There were obviously multiple THE entities present in this era. THE Creature was feared, as was THE Living Paradox. How was it that in The Earliest Folds of his time, only THE Creature was prevalent alongside THE Living Existences as a collective? What had happened to the countless other monsters and powers that roamed across the Infinite Unfurling?
His mind buzzed with many questions that had no immediate answers!
But at this moment, the calm words of Tor cut through his contemplation.
“Have you looked enough?” Tor asked with dangerous politeness.
THE Time Surfer laughed with genuine amusement at the question.
“No, not nearly enough,” she said with brutal honesty. “I might need a much closer look to properly understand what I am sensing.”
Her eyes remained fixed on Noah.

“That thing you have beside you there does not belong in The Infinite Unfurling. Never has, never will. I can consider myself somewhat of an expert on time mechanics, and if there was someone fucking with time itself, I can usually manage to understand how and why.”
Her smile widened with predatory interest.

“But that thing beside you should not be able to even exist here at this point in time. The temporal displacement is impossible by every metric I understand. I need to see how he can do such a thing when it seems he has not even reached THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, so yes, I will need a much closer look.”
She tilted her head with challenge in her gaze.
“The only question will be whether you will take some of my time before I am able to examine him properly.”
At such pointed words, Tor smiled with a sense of profound brutality as he looked at THE Time Surfer up and down with his own analytical assessment.
“Hunger and Time,” he said with philosophical weight. “Two concepts that many believe to be fundamentally different, operating on separate principles of existence.”
His eyes began to spin like black holes.

“But they are not so different, O Time Surfer, right? You are the weaker practitioner of time compared to that...Living Temporal, is it? Let me educate you slightly. Everything is prey to Hunger eventually. Even time itself can be consumed, devoured, made part of something greater.”
His smile became predatory.

“At this moment, I can already taste time on my tongue as I look at you. It is a little salty, with undertones of inevitability and decay. The flavor of something that believes itself untouchable but will ultimately be consumed like everything else.”
He paused for emphasis.

“Your time authority is impressive, certainly. But authority over when things happen means nothing if those things are devoured before they can occur. Hunger exists outside of temporal flow because it is a constant, an inevitability that transcends your manipulations.”
His voice dropped to something profound.
“So before you take a closer look at my junior here, ask yourself this question: Are you prepared to be tasted in return?”
With such words, existence itself began to tremble with the weight of conflicting Sovereignties preparing to clash!

The storm of snow in the surroundings intensified dramatically, becoming even heavier as the atmosphere charged with tension. The temperature dropped further despite already being at levels that would collapse weaker beings.
And in the space between THE First Hunger and THE Time Surfer, reality itself began to fracture under the pressure of their combined presence.
Noah stood amidst it all, about to witness a clash between genuine THE Sovereignties for the first time!
4/4 Keep the Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

chapters.title: Chapter 4523: Predator! I
paragraphs: As existence churned and trembled in the face of two entities at the level ofTHEexpressing their Sovereignties, Tor walked deliberately in front of Noah and began to take measured steps towardTHE Time Surfer.

As he moved forward with calm certainty, the expanse of space behind him turned obsidian-crimson as if his Hunger covered everything in that direction. The color spread like spilled blood across reality itself, staining the very fabric of existence.
And Noah continued to hear the voice of Tor echoing in his mind even as this being fearlessly walked toward anotherTHEentity.

"A river that carves through stone does not succeed through strength, but through relentless focus on a single path,"Tor’s voice resonated with teaching intensity. "My Hunger has been honed again and again across eons, Outsider. It has tremendous Depth."
His mental voice carried weight.

"And remember what I taught you before: Depth is how thoroughly one can alter and rewrite existence through their Sovereignty. THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty is just that, scratching the surface of what is possible. And yet many entities will only ever stop there, unable to progress further."
The obsidian-crimson light that shone behind Tor and encompassed Noah and everything else became even more intense as he continued speaking.

Opposite him,THE Time Surferradiated vivid purple luster that also painted everything behind her with that color. The two expanding domains met in the middle, creating a boundary where obsidian-crimson clashed against purple in silent contest.
And yet Tor continued calmly inside Noah’s mind with his teachings.

"Apart from Depth, there is also Breadth," he explained with measured words. "Breadth is exactly how many Sovereignties one can claim simultaneously. When Depth becomes significant enough, when one has truly mastered their primary Way, they can proceed to claim Sovereignty over another Way if they are capable enough."
His voice carried profound meaning.

"Such a thing is only possible much further down the path, with tremendous Depth already established. And yet you, Outsider, currently hold two Ways of Existence running parallel within you. I will tell you honestly that you are way out of your depth attempting such a thing at your level."
There was approval in his tone despite the warning.

"And yet you are doing everything seamlessly somehow. You have taken a semblance of my Hunger and proceeded to do something unfathomable with it, making it walk hand in hand with Mana in the same Way and Civilization that you are forging. This makes you an anomaly among anomalies."
His voice became stern with advice.

"But make sure that you do not branch yourself out too much in the future. After all, a single blade sharpened ten thousand times will cut deeper than ten thousand blades sharpened once. Observe everything through the lens of your Civilization of Mana and Hunger as unified concepts, and you will not go wrong."
Noah absorbed these words with analytical focus as Tor’s mental voice shifted to more immediate concerns.

"For now, I wish to tell you to observe what is about to occur if you can,"Tor said with slight regret. "But it seems that even this may not be a possibility for you. You would need significant time to adapt your perception just to be capable of seeing us properly when we clash at full intensity."
His voice dropped with finality.
"And it does not look like you will be given that time."
The moment after Tor said this, his physical figure disappeared from Noah’s perception entirely!
The figure ofTHE Time Surferalso vanished simultaneously, as if both had simply ceased to exist in observable space!
And then...
BOOM!

Instantly, Noah observed the utterly ridiculous scene of reality itself in front of him being torn open like a page in a book. A massive rift spread upward and downward for countless Gigaparsecs, splitting existence into two distinct halves.
One side shone with obsidian-crimson brilliance that represented Hunger’s domain. The other side pulsed with purple luminescence that represented Time’s authority.
And Noah felt existence trembling even more violently than before, but shockingly, he could not see either ofTHEentities that were supposedly fighting right in front of him!
Their forms had vanished completely from his perception.
And yet the evidence of their battle was unmistakable.
BOOM!

Another massive tear in reality spread far above them, also stretching out for Gigaparsecs in length. It gushed out a deluge of endless collapsed existence from this rending of space, pouring destruction like a waterfall.
He could not see them fighting, and yet they were clearly already engaged in combat of apocalyptic proportions!

He actually could not fully comprehend the scope of the battle unfolding before him. Even their figures were not observable to his eyes as they moved at speeds and through weavings of existence he could not even begin to perceive.

Noah’s gaze turned toward the Pre-THE entities that THE Time Surfer had brought with her, and he saw that even they seemed to be struggling. They were moving their heads around rapidly, whipping their attention from one point to another as they tried desperately to keep track of the entities fighting.
But they were unable to successfully follow the clash either!
The Living Origin stood with intense focus, her white-gold eyes narrowed. The other Pre-THE existences showed frustration mixed with awe.
Noah’s eyes pulsed with tyranny as he refused to accept such a limitation. Their power was so vastly superior that he could not even perceive them fighting properly?
At such a moment of frustrated realization, Tor’s voice echoed in his mind again.

"If you had enough time to stay here and continue to witness the clash between two opposing Ways of existence, you would have eventually adapted,"Tor explained with clinical precision. "You would have eventually seen how our Sovereignties clash against each other and how I manipulate mine to systematically eat apart hers."
His mental voice carried grim news.

"But you do not have that time, unfortunately. It seems this savage opponent of mine who is proficient in temporal manipulation already knows the results of the future of this battle through her Way. She has seen her own defeat."
There was dark amusement in his tone.

"And precisely because she knows her fate, she has already called for reinforcements in the past, seconds before our battle even began. That is how utterly frustrating time manipulation and temporal fuckery can be when facing a master of it."
Noah’s mind raced to understand the implications.

"She only knew of the result of this battle after we began clashing and she saw the trajectory of events,"Tor continued with a unique observation. "And yet she somehow made it so that her Way of Time retroactively called for help from her acquaintances before we even started fighting. She altered the past based on knowledge from the future."
His voice carried grudging respect.

"Itmay not make much logical sense when stated plainly, but essentially the situation is this: You staying here is no longer a viable option. I will not be able to fight multiple other THE entities alongside this manipulative Time Surfer while simultaneously being able to protect you adequately."
The reality of the situation became clear.

"So for now, for your safety and for me to truly enjoy this feast without being held back by defensive considerations, we will have to temporarily part ways," Tor said with finality. "You will be on your own for some time, Outsider."

"For now, I wish to tell you to observe what is about to occur if you can,"Tor said with slight regret.
"But it seems that even this may not be a possibility for you.
You would need significant time to adapt your perception just to be capable of seeing us properly when we clash at full intensity."
His voice dropped with finality.
"And it does not look like you will be given that time."
The moment after Tor said this, his physical figure disappeared from Noah’s perception entirely!
The figure ofTHE Time Surferalso vanished simultaneously, as if both had simply ceased to exist in observable space!
And then...
BOOM!
Instantly, Noah observed the utterly ridiculous scene of reality itself in front of him being torn open like a page in a book.
A massive rift spread upward and downward for countless Gigaparsecs, splitting existence into two distinct halves.
One side shone with obsidian-crimson brilliance that represented Hunger’s domain.
The other side pulsed with purple luminescence that represented Time’s authority.
And Noah felt existence trembling even more violently than before, but shockingly, he could not see either ofTHEentities that were supposedly fighting right in front of him!
Their forms had vanished completely from his perception.
And yet the evidence of their battle was unmistakable.
BOOM!
Another massive tear in reality spread far above them, also stretching out for Gigaparsecs in length.
It gushed out a deluge of endless collapsed existence from this rending of space, pouring destruction like a waterfall.
He could not see them fighting, and yet they were clearly already engaged in combat of apocalyptic proportions!
He actually could not fully comprehend the scope of the battle unfolding before him.
Even their figures were not observable to his eyes as they moved at speeds and through weavings of existence he could not even begin to perceive.
Noah’s gaze turned toward the Pre-THE entities that THE Time Surfer had brought with her, and he saw that even they seemed to be struggling.
They were moving their heads around rapidly, whipping their attention from one point to another as they tried desperately to keep track of the entities fighting.
But they were unable to successfully follow the clash either!
The Living Origin stood with intense focus, her white-gold eyes narrowed.
The other Pre-THE existences showed frustration mixed with awe.
Noah’s eyes pulsed with tyranny as he refused to accept such a limitation.
Their power was so vastly superior that he could not even perceive them fighting properly?
At such a moment of frustrated realization, Tor’s voice echoed in his mind again.
"If you had enough time to stay here and continue to witness the clash between two opposing Ways of existence, you would have eventually adapted,"Tor explained with clinical precision.
"You would have eventually seen how our Sovereignties clash against each other and how I manipulate mine to systematically eat apart hers."
His mental voice carried grim news.
"But you do not have that time, unfortunately.
It seems this savage opponent of mine who is proficient in temporal manipulation already knows the results of the future of this battle through her Way.
She has seen her own defeat."
There was dark amusement in his tone.
"And precisely because she knows her fate, she has already called for reinforcements in the past, seconds before our battle even began.
That is how utterly frustrating time manipulation and temporal fuckery can be when facing a master of it."
Noah’s mind raced to understand the implications.
"She only knew of the result of this battle after we began clashing and she saw the trajectory of events,"Tor continued with a unique observation.
"And yet she somehow made it so that her Way of Time retroactively called for help from her acquaintances before we even started fighting.
She altered the past based on knowledge from the future."
His voice carried grudging respect.
"Itmay not make much logical sense when stated plainly, but essentially the situation is this: You staying here is no longer a viable option.
I will not be able to fight multiple other THE entities alongside this manipulative Time Surfer while simultaneously being able to protect you adequately."
The reality of the situation became clear.
"So for now, for your safety and for me to truly enjoy this feast without being held back by defensive considerations, we will have to temporarily part ways," Tor said with finality.
"You will be on your own for some time, Outsider."

chapters.title: Chapter 4524: Predator! II
paragraphs: Before Noah could even formulate a response to the dire situation unfolding around him, he felt a surge of obsidian-crimson authority wrapping around his existence with protective intensity.
Tor’s voice echoed in his mind with rapid urgency.

"The most I can give you without the power of THE being immediately sensed on you is a singular THE Barrier of Hunger,"he explained with clinical precision. "It can collectively withstand a single killing strike of any entity at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, no matter how concentrated or devastating that strike may be."
His voice carried grim determination.

"I will also extinguish those shitty elemental flames wrapped around you. That curse is another flare shining with the power of a THE entity that can be used to track and find you across vast distances. With it gone, you can focus on your survival without being a beacon for every predator in the Infinite Unfurling."
The authority around Noah intensified.

"I will send you far away from here so that the incoming reinforcements cannot perceive your departure or track your destination. It will be up to your own power and luck if you can survive until I can find you again."
His voice dropped with finality.

"Hide, hunt, do what you must to survive. For me to collapse all the coming THE entities and properly devour them without interruption, it could take hours or days depending on how many respond to her call and how deeply they commit to the battle."
A moment after he said this, Noah felt the constant burning pain that had been suppressed within his existence pulse violently and then flicker away entirely!
A terrifying burst of Hunger raged all around him, devouring the crimson-gold flames that had marked him since his confrontation withTHE Living Elemental!
Prompts bloomed before his vision with glorious detail.
|THE Immolation Of The Sacrilegious Savagehas been devoured by an UnfathomableTHE Civilizational Authority of Hunger.|
|You are now completely free from its effects and tracking capabilities.|
|THE Barrier of Hungerhas been laid upon your existence.|
|Classification: Absolute Defense Shield|
|Source:THE First Hunger |
|Protection Level: Can withstand one complete killing strike from any entity atTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Coverage: Encompasses entire existence including physical form, soul, consciousness, and all derivative aspects|
|Activation: Automatic upon detection of lethal threat|
|Duration: Permanent until triggered, and until depleted|
|Additional Properties: Undetectable by entities belowTHEscale. Will not register as foreign authority to most scanning methods.|
|Warning: Once triggered and exhausted, protection is completely gone. Use wisely.|
Noah felt a glorious change ripple through his entire existence as the transformation completed.

Shockingly, the curse placed upon him byTHE Living Elementalthat should have killed him outright, but instead had inadvertently paved the way for him to forge something unprecedented within Observable Existence, disappeared completely at this moment.
In its place was a barrier that could withstand the full killing strike of an entity that had already stepped intoTHE Depths of the Civilizational Scale of Existence.

It was an unfathomably grand progression of cause and effect when he truly thought about it. Him encroaching upon the Primordial Civilization of Elemental had been the first domino that fell, which led inevitably to the rage ofTHE Living Elementalbranding him with that curse.
And that curse had led to everything else that followed.

It had led him to developTHE Organ of Civilizationas the only viable counter. It had led to his Temporal Traversal to the Infinite Unfurling where opportunities beyond measure existed. It had led to meeting Tor and receiving teachings aboutTHEthat would have been impossible to obtain otherwise.
And now it led to him being in an unfathomably dangerous position, hunted by multipleTHEentities in a time period where he should not even exist.
The chain of causality was almost absurd in its complexity.

"I am sending you to a relatively safer region of the Infinite Unfurling filled with weaker entities, but not too weak," Tor’s voice explained rapidly. "They will likely search for you in places with extremely weak prey, so I am avoiding those obvious locations."
The authority around Noah began to compress with spatial manipulation.
"Stay hidden and wait for my return. I will find you again once this situation is resolved, no matter how long it takes or how far you travel."
Space began to twist and fold around him.

"And Outsider," Tor’s voice carried genuine concern for the first time since they had met. "Remember that you are still weak by the standards of this place. Do not let your recent victories against weak entities make you forget that fundamental truth."
His words carried weight.
"Survival takes priority over everything else. Get a bit stronger when you can do so safely, but do not take unnecessary risks. Live first, grow second."
The spatial compression reached critical intensity.
"Good luck."
Obsidian-crimson brilliance erupted all around as Noah could only gaze at the continuing impacts from beings he still could not even perceive fighting!

Reality tore and reformed in patterns that hurt to observe. The boundary between Hunger’s domain and Time’s authority fluctuated wildly as the two Sovereignties clashed at scales beyond his comprehension.
And then Noah was forcefully ejected from the battlefield as Tor’s Hunger launched him across vast distances of the Infinite Unfurling toward an unknown destination!
As he traveled through compressed space at impossible speeds, Noah caught one final glimpse of the battle behind him through the distorting spatial layers.

The entire region where they had been standing was being systematically destroyed. Rifts in reality spread like spiderwebs across existence, each one large enough to swallow solar systems. The snow had been completely replaced by storms of collapsed hunger and time fighting for dominance over the ruined landscape.
And in that final moment before distance made observation impossible, the eyes of The Living Origin locked onto him with intense focus!
Her white-gold gaze burned through the spatial distortions as if they were not even there, tracking his departure with analytical precision.
As such recognition occurred, he managed to hear the roar ofTHE Time Surferas this being bellowed out commandingly to the entities that she had brought with her!

"Follow any traces of where that thing is being sent!" she shouted with fury and desperation mixing in her voice. "Track it and find it for me! If you succeed in bringing me that anomaly, I promise on My Way of Time itself to help you achieve THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty!"
Her voice became deadly.

"Should any of you attempt to run or hide, I will hunt through your past and your futures to ensure that you collapse completely across all timelines! Bring me that thing! Bring me that temporal anomaly!"
BOOM!
The words were heavy and terrifying as they echoed across dimensions.

Multiple Pre-THE Existences burst with their full Sovereignties being unleashed, each one burning with authority as they attempted to track Noah’s departure trajectory through the spatial compression!
The Living Origin moved with particular purpose, her Way of Origin allowing her to trace beginnings and endings with frightening accuracy.
But Tor’s spatial ejection had been executed by a THE entity of terrifying power, and tracking such a departure was nearly impossible for Pre-THE beings!

chapters.title: Chapter 4525: Predator! III
paragraphs: Noah felt the space around him stabilize as the forced transportation neared its conclusion.
The reality that settled in his mind was a heavy one, but his eyes flashed with tyranny as he processed it!
Alone in the Infinite Unfurling, without protection from Tor, without guidance or direction from anyone who understood this place.
But so what?
He was always alone when it truly mattered.

He had awakened alone in a world of dungeons and monsters. He had entered those dungeons alone while others formed parties and sought safety in numbers. He had traveled across worlds alone, making allies when convenient but never depending on them for survival.
This would simply be another time he was alone, another situation where he needed to use everything he held to survive and thrive!
Space distorted and twisted all around him as the final layer of compression broke apart with a sound like shattering glass!
And he materialized in an unknown region, immediately extending his senses outward to catalog his new surroundings while simultaneously suppressing his aura to minimal detectable levels.
He had appeared in a region dominated by vast mountainous landscape that stretched in all directions.

Roiling mist obscured much of the terrain, filtering through impossibly tall trees whose trunks were wider than cities. The mist moved with purpose rather than randomly, as if it possessed some form of awareness.

In the atmosphere above, he could see floating mountains spinning slowly in defiance of gravity. Radiant white mist held them aloft, flowing around their bases like rivers of cloud given structure and purpose.
The entire region felt extremely ancient and old. The very air carried weight that spoke of eons passing.
Noah breathed in deeply, tasting the authority-saturated atmosphere as he thought analytically about how he should proceed from this point.

Tor could find him again in a matter of hours or days depending on the outcome of the battle, but he would not be dependent on that possibility. He needed to make his own moves, forge his own path forward.

One’s Way of existence could not be properly forged by holding the hand of another and being fed everything like a child. Struggle was an integral part of existence, and he would not shy away from it now.

He closed his eyes and felt the absence of the scorching flames that had been burning across his body for so long. In their place, he sensed the faint barrier of Hunger that wrapped all around him like invisible armor.
A moment later, his eyes opened with a light of tyranny and sharpness as everything was decided in his mind.

He was effectively being hunted by multiple Pre-THE Existences who possessed terrifying power. There was also an entity proficient in Time, someone who was uniquely not THE Living Temporal, actively hunting him due to his impossible appearance here.
She had said how he was an impossibility, how he should not be able to exist in this time period.
But who the hell was she to decide where he could and could not appear?

If anyone sat down and looked at the situation objectively to ask how Noah was able to traverse to a time before The Earliest Folds even solidified, they would also deem it an absolute impossibility. And yet his Early Atlas of the Folds had made it a possibility through its unique features.
HisTHE Organ of Civilizationhad taken things even further, powering a journey that should have been beyond the realm of feasibility.

Since these were his tools of impossibility, he had to continue forging them and pushing their capabilities even further. His aim now was clear: continue hunting entities that were trying to forge their Sovereignties, just like him.

All the while, he would protect himself to ensure that if he came across someone significantly stronger, he would not be collapsed. Nor would he give up the usage of the barrier of Hunger wrapping around him too quickly or wastefully.
With all of this crystallized in his mind, Noah looked down at himself as he considered his first course of action.
To throw off those hunting him if they ever came close to finding his location, he needed to change what they had already seen and would be searching for.
"Mana burns behind countless Sovereignties as the foundation," he said with certainty. "Since I have devoured the Sovereignties of Poison, Fire, and Mass, I could easily depict them if I chose to."
After he spoke these words, his body began to change with purposeful transformation.

He became more sizable, his frame expanding as he took on the form of a massive Early Creature. His skin shifted and changed texture as it became surrounded by transforming blue-gold rivers of Primus Mana.
Those brilliant rivers quickly morphed into virulent green rivers of concentrated poison that flowed across his body like living tattoos!
The brilliant allure of his Way of Mana and Hunger rapidly transformed across his entire existence. In a short period of time, his appearance changed completely.

His body now stood massive and imposing, easily three times his normal height. He was adorned in an archaic verdant chiton that looked like it had been woven from toxic plants that pulsed with lethal authority.

His hair became wild and flowing, pulsing with poisonous green light that cast shadows across his transformed features. His eyes burned with the same toxic luminescence, appearing like pools of concentrated venom.

His entire form became completely surrounded by virulent green rivers of poison that flowed and coiled around him like serpents. He emanated nothing else but the Way of Poison in every aspect of his being!
This was his Way! His Civilization! As the foundation of countless things, he could transform it to become anything he needed it to be!
Prompts flashed before his vision with confirmation.
|Your understanding of Mana as foundational authority has deepened significantly.|
|You can now convincingly mimic any Sovereignty you have fully consumed and integrated.|
|Current Available Mimicry: Poison, Fire, Mass, Living Existential Authorities(Limited)...|
|Mimicry Quality: Indistinguishable from genuine Sovereignty to entities belowTHEscale.|
|This capability demonstrates profound understanding of your Way’s versatility.|
After this transformation was complete, Noah stretched his new form experimentally and went even further with his preparations.

"Mana is synonymous with the surrounding environment," he said with cold calculation. "Ambient Mana covers everything in existence. When I move, my aura and brilliance will be no different from the surrounding environment itself."
His eyes flashed with tyranny.
"As if I am simply seas of ambient authority flowing from one place to another, completely unremarkable!"
After these words were spoken, a glorious phenomenon began to occur around his transformed body.

Noah began to fade away from observable perception, his figure slowly melding with the atmosphere itself. The poisonous green rivers that wrapped around him became indistinguishable from ambient authority in the air.
His form blurred and became translucent, then transparent, until he entirely became something that was not capable of being perceived as separate from the environment!
He had become invisible not through visual manipulation, but by making himself fundamentally indistinguishable from the background authority that permeated all of existence.
More prompts flashed before him with details of this unique state.
|You have entered a state of environmental synchronization.|
|Detection Difficulty: Entities below Pre-THE existence cannot sense your presence at all.|
|Detection Difficulty: Pre-THE existences must be extremely attuned to environmental authorities AND actively searching the specific region you occupy to sense disturbances.|
|Detection Difficulty:THEentities can still perceive you if they focus their Sovereignty on your location.|
|Duration: Indefinite as long as you maintain focus and do not release overwhelming authority.|
|Warning: Engaging in combat will disrupt this state.|
|This represents masterful control over your Way’s expression.|

After entering a state where he could move without being perceived by the vast majority of entities, where he was basically camouflaged and invisible to all but the most perceptive hunters, Noah nodded with satisfaction at the completion of his preparations.
He looked out at the expanse of brilliance all around him, at the ancient trees and floating mountains and authority-thick mist, and began to move forward with purpose.
Concealment was accomplished. Now it was time to hunt and advance his Way even further.

He had to use all the time available to him in the Infinite Unfurling while grasping and understanding its deepest secrets. Every moment here was an opportunity that entities in his era would kill for.

Because the one thing he truly needed to understand was the fate of all the powerful THE entities and Pre-THE Existences that clearly populated this time period. How was it that onlyTHE CreatureandTHE Living Existenceswere known and prevalent in his era?
Just what had happened in the Infinite Unfurling to reduce this vast population of powers to such a small number?
There were many questions and mysteries swirling in his mind, but this particular enigma demanded answers!
With this goal crystallized in his thoughts, he looked at the endless expanse of mist and ancient landscape all around him as he began to move with predatory grace.
He was no longer the prey being hunted.
He was a predator on the hunt, seeking to devour and grow stronger with each encounter!

|Detection Difficulty:THEentities can still perceive you if they focus their Sovereignty on your location.|
|Duration: Indefinite as long as you maintain focus and do not release overwhelming authority.|
|Warning: Engaging in combat will disrupt this state.|
|This represents masterful control over your Way’s expression.|

After entering a state where he could move without being perceived by the vast majority of entities, where he was basically camouflaged and invisible to all but the most perceptive hunters, Noah nodded with satisfaction at the completion of his preparations.
He looked out at the expanse of brilliance all around him, at the ancient trees and floating mountains and authority-thick mist, and began to move forward with purpose.
Concealment was accomplished.
Now it was time to hunt and advance his Way even further.
He had to use all the time available to him in the Infinite Unfurling while grasping and understanding its deepest secrets.
Every moment here was an opportunity that entities in his era would kill for.
Because the one thing he truly needed to understand was the fate of all the powerful THE entities and Pre-THE Existences that clearly populated this time period.
How was it that onlyTHE CreatureandTHE Living Existenceswere known and prevalent in his era?
Just what had happened in the Infinite Unfurling to reduce this vast population of powers to such a small number?
There were many questions and mysteries swirling in his mind, but this particular enigma demanded answers!
With this goal crystallized in his thoughts, he looked at the endless expanse of mist and ancient landscape all around him as he began to move with predatory grace.
He was no longer the prey being hunted.
He was a predator on the hunt, seeking to devour and grow stronger with each encounter!

chapters.title: Chapter 4526: Predator! IV
paragraphs: The Infinite Unfurling had to be one of the most unique places that Noah had ever been in.
One of the more striking characteristics was how there was nothing weak existing in this place. Truly nothing weak could survive the ambient pressure and dangers that permeated every corner.

An hour passed as he moved through the mountainous landscape that he found himself in, surrounded by rolling mists that obscured vision and created an atmosphere of perpetual twilight. He effectively mapped out the region and cataloged what could be lying within its boundaries.

In the surrounding Gigaparsecs, he was actually able to discover multiple entities ranging from Upper Nonillions to Decillions in Complexity and Purity. Each one followed their own unique Way of existence, carving out territories where they hunted and grew stronger.
He tested his concealment by observing them closely and even entering the perimeter of a few light-years near them.
Gloriously, none of them could sense his presence at all!

If he went too close and his ambient integration wore off from proximity to their concentrated authorities, they might detect the disturbance. But for now, he had left them alone while continuing to scout the region.
Within the surrounding Gigaparsecs, his figure could not be observed by others as he moved with purpose. He traveled rapidly like a flicker that was almost impossible to track.

No, even comparing his movement to light was not accurate enough. It should be more precise to say that he was moving around like a flicker of tachyons, like a set of particles that traveled unfathomably faster than light itself through the fabric of reality.

And after he continued to scour this entire region methodically and confirmed that he could not sense any visible power at the level ofTHE, he felt reasonably secure. Even though if such a being was present and they hid their aura similar to how Tor concealed his presence, Noah would not really be able to sense them anyway.
But after cautiously mapping this entire place with systematic precision, there was no signature of anyTHEentities apart from the creatures that he had marked.
After all of this was confirmed through careful observation, he appeared a few light-years away from one of his first targets.

It was a creature that was chewing on the bones of another entity it had recently killed. Its body was surrounded by crackling arcs of purple lightning that danced across its form in chaotic patterns.

The creature looked like a massive salamander, easily the size of several mountains. Its body was covered with jutting sharp crystals all over its surface that refracted the lightning into prismatic displays.
It was another entity following the Way of Lightning, its power stabilized at 955 Nonillions of Complexity and Purity.
Noah looked at it from his concealed position as his eyes pulsed with calculating tyranny. His method of attacking had to change somewhat from what he had done with Tor’s protection.

He needed the battles to be quick and seamless. The longer he spent in conflict, smashing around the environment and destroying mountains while fighting, the more risks he took. The more chances there were for other entities to be drawn to the commotion.

So he asked himself a critical question: Could he not skip all the booming impacts between his Way and the Way of his enemy? Could he simply settle everything in a single strike, as long as this strike made the outcome of whose Way was stronger absolutely clear?
With this tactical consideration in mind, he breathed out slowly and raised his left hand toward the enemy that he intended to kill.
His Primus Mana could become anything he desired. He had a vast array of offensive capabilities under his belt after devouring multiple Sovereignties.

Utilizing Nonillions of Primordial Fireballs and condensing them into concentrated points of his Way was one method of attack. He had used it frequently because he was most familiar with that approach.
But he had endless variations available because his Primus Mana could accomplish everything he conceived. He could design new Mana Arcana Glyphs at any time to suit any situation.
When he thought about an attack from long range that could potentially snipe an enemy and decimate them in a single strike without giving them time to react or defend...
He smiled with cold satisfaction.

In the next moment, he feltTHE Organ of Civilizationin his brain buzz with activation. AnUnquantifiable Unit of Everythingwas consumed as fuel, and his existence flared up like a newborn star being born!

His outstretched left hand began to buzz with concentrated poisonous verdant light. His Way of Mana and Hunger, currently expressed through the mimicry of the Way of Poison, formed into an incandescent virulent green compound bow!
The weapon materialized with perfect balance and deadly intent, composed entirely of compressed authority.
And with his right hand, he pulled back on the bow strings with smooth motion. A terrifying arrow began to form between his fingers as he filled it with endless seas of his Way of existence.
As he drew the string back further and further, he whispered silently to himself with absolute certainty.

"Mana is the foundation of all change in existence," he said with analytical precision. "For any sparks of lightning to form, they need Mana at their foundation to provide the energy for that manifestation."
His eyes gleamed with tyrannical confidence.
"So if I deem that lightning is unable to stop my Mana, if I declare that my Way supersedes the authority of electrical discharge, then it simply cannot resist!"
The arrow that was forming shone with an even more intense green light as he spoke these words. His Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger was pumped into this single arrow endlessly.
He meant for it to take the life of an extremely powerful enemy by collapsing what their Way stood for. By proving in a single shot that his Way superseded theirs in quality and depth.

And so he endlessly poured even more and more of his infinite waves of authority into the forming projectile. He knew the moment he released it, his ambient integration would be disrupted and fall away.
His invisibility would vanish.
And the very instant that happened, the enemy also needed to be dead before they could react or call for help.
Noah breathed in deeply, gathering his focus to a single point.
And then...
SAA!
He released the arrow with perfect form!

His figure flashed into existence as he lost his invisibility, becoming visible for the first time in over an hour. The distant enemy he was targeting raised its head instinctively to sense what had just appeared in its territory.
But the moment its gaze came up to focus on the disturbance, it saw a virulent green arrow right in front of its face!
All of it happened in the span of an instant that was almost too fast to perceive!

The eyes of the creature pulsing with purple lightning barely registered the terrifying verdant arrow before its Way innately erupted outward. A defensive storm of lightning formed around it automatically, responding to the threat.
But the arrow arrived with inexorable purpose.
BOOM!
A terrifying impact rocked the surrounding space with devastating force! Existence in that area was instantly turned a virulent green color for several light-years in every direction!

One could barely see a flicker of purple lightning seeking to erupt and fight back amidst that explosion of poisonous authority. But the Way of Lightning was drowned out completely by the immense expression of Mana and Hunger!
The seas of concentrated authority made it very clear that this Way was much grander in quality and immensity than the Way of Lightning could ever hope to match.
Lightning never stood a chance against the fundamental nature of Mana asserting dominance.

After the explosion faded, there were no roars of defiance or the eruption of more defensive authorities. Only an apocalyptic scene where existence itself in the nearby area seemed to have been poisoned at a fundamental level.
When one looked at the epicenter, they could see the corpse of the massive salamander. Its body still flickered weakly with residual lightning that was fading rapidly.
Its head had been completely pulverized and melted by the impact. The skull was fizzing out of existence as the authority holding it together collapsed.
Its weavings and Way had actually been collapsed entirely by the single strike!
Noah gazed at such a scene in the distance with eyes shining with analytical satisfaction. He lowered the bow and it disappeared into a flicker of brilliance, dissolving back into formless Mana.
He took a single step through compressed space to appear beside the corpse of the salamander. He waved his hand toward it and the entire massive body disappeared into his storage.
And he disappeared right after as well, reintegrating with the surrounding atmosphere and leaving the scene of a glorious kill behind!

In less than apicosecondof actual combat time, he had decimated a creature seeking to advance toward Pre-THE status. He had stored its body for later consumption and left the scene without leaving traces apart from poison painting the surroundings!

chapters.title: Chapter 4527: Predator! V
paragraphs: In The Infinite Unfurling.

Primordial trees rose far above the landscape, their trunks so massive that they seemed to support the sky itself. Thick mist surrounded them in swirling layers, creating an atmosphere of perpetual twilight between their ancient roots.
In between these towering trees, a massive basilisk-like creature raised its head with predatory focus.

Its serpentine eyes shone with a terrifying green light that seemed to pierce through all concealment. The eyes looked unfathomably far into the distance as if they could observe phenomena occurring light-years away with perfect clarity.
And at this moment, those eyes had locked onto an explosion of poisonous green light erupting in the distance.
The power of that explosion was not insignificant, and its serpentine face twisted into a devilish cruel smile. The creature’s voice echoed out with cold amusement.

"It looks like I have to stop playing with you and eat you and your Sovereignty in a single gulp," it said with casual malice. "Someone else is hunting in my territory, and I need to deal with them quickly."
The creature spoke while looking down at an extremely gory scene spread out before it.

A white fox-like creature could be seen lying in a pool of its own blood. Half of its body had already been eaten, consumed by the basilisk over the course of hours of torture. Its lustrous white coat of fur was painted crimson-gold with blood that still flowed from grievous wounds.
Its gaze was weak but still held defiance as it stared up at the basilisk with hatred burning in its dimming eyes.
But its Way of Light and existence was far too weak compared to the Way of Poison that this basilisk represented. And now, its entire existence was about to be extinguished completely.
The basilisk opened its massive jaws wide to swallow this radiant fox-like creature whole and claim the remnants of its Sovereignty.
And in that exact moment, a verdant green arrow also shining with concentrated Way of Poison appeared directly before the basilisk’s face!

The creature’s eyes opened wide with shock and fury as it seemed to ask a silent question: Who dared to attack it with poison, of all things?! The fucker it just sensed the attack of Gigaparsecs away?!

It tried desperately to erupt with its own Way, to counter poison with poison and assert dominance. But it found its Way of Poison completely suppressed all around its body, unable to manifest properly!

Its existence buzzed with mounting horror as it felt this unfathomable poisonous authority that seemed to hide something else beneath its surface. Something fundamental and overwhelming that completely suppressed its carefully cultivated Sovereignty!
And then that hidden authority collapsed its existence entirely!
BOOM!

The head of the basilisk was torn apart by the impact, exploding into chunks of flesh and bone that disintegrated before they could fall. The creature’s body thrashed once before going still, its Way extinguished.
The heavily injured and half-consumed white fox nearby saw how the explosion contained the destruction in a unique way, preventing the surroundings from being decimated unnecessarily.
A moment later, the fox trembled as the visage of a massive humanoid being shining with green poisonous luster appeared where the arrow had originated!
Of course, this was none other than Noah who had moved with rapid efficiency to claim his second target.
At this moment, Noah waved his hands and the massive corpse of the basilisk disappeared into his storage without ceremony.

Since he had already suppressed and understood the Way of Poison with his first kill, doing so again was even easier this time! After all, it had been confirmed multiple times that his Way of Mana superseded poison-based concepts at the fundamental level.
But now, before he left the scene, he turned his gaze toward the former prey of the basilisk.
A decimated-looking fox lay there, and when Noah’s eyes focused on it, the creature’s body trembled with fear and residual defiance. It whimpered softly, the sound pitiful and weak.
Noah’s terrifying body looked down at the broken creature as he spoke with calm consideration.
"Now what shall I do with you?"
The fox trembled violently at his words as its feminine voice echoed out weakly.

"I... don’t... don’t kill me," she pleaded with desperation coloring every word. "I could... I could act as a mount for sir as soon as I heal! I also know of a place with some good resources a distance from here!"
Her voice grew stronger with desperate hope.
"That basilisk was torturing me for information about it! My Light was telling me that even if I revealed the location, it would still devour me anyway. But it feels different with you..."
She looked up at Noah with eyes that held both fear and strange trust.
"My Way of Light says sir will keep his word if you make a promise. So please, I can be useful! I can guide you! I can serve! Just...please don’t kill me!"
Her voice broke at the end, and fresh blood dripped from her wounds. Her remaining fur was matted and filthy, and half her body was simply gone, consumed by the basilisk’s cruel feeding.
She looked utterly pitiful, a broken creature clinging to the last thread of existence.
Oh?
Noah’s eyes lit up with interest at the words of the fox as a thought occurred to him with sudden clarity.

How...would it be if he spread his Civilization in the Infinite Unfurling? Would he be able to understand exactly what happened in the coming future if he had subordinates present during these ancient times?
He looked at the fox and her pitiful appearance analytically. Since he had to move quickly and could not afford to linger, he made his decision with rapid calculation.
His vision pulsed as information flooded his perception.
|Name: Lumivara, The Radiant Wanderer|
|Classification: Light-Path Entity (Not yet Pre-THE)|
|Complexity: 19 Decillion|
|Purity: 19 Decillion|
|Grand Principles: Illumination Genesis, Photon Propagation, Radiance Manifestation, Light Dominion, Luminous Convergence, Brilliance Authority, Reflection Mastery, Refraction Supremacy|
|Current Sovereignty Progress: Attempting to establish claim over Light (0.11% toward Pre-THE status)|
|Status: Critically injured, half-consumed, near collapse|
|Temperament: Desperate for survival, willing to submit|
|Special Trait: Possesses knowledge of resource-rich locations|

His eyes shone brightly as he gauged the positives and negatives of accepting this creature into his service. After a moment of consideration, he waved his hands to reveal a spark of blue-gold brilliance that floated between them.

"The Way of Light," he said with commanding authority, "can be exemplified even more after it accepts its true nature as an expression of Mana. Light is electromagnetic radiation, and electromagnetic forces are powered by Mana at their foundation."
He looked at her with tyrannical certainty.
"Take this spark and accept it into your existence. We can then see about your future and whether you have value beyond this moment."
The spark floated closer to the fox, pulsing with the fundamental authority of his Civilization.
The fox hesitantly looked at the brilliant spark, her eyes wide with a mixture of hope and fear. This could be salvation or it could be another form of enslavement worse than death.
But she had no real choice, and her Way of Light was telling her that this being would keep his word.
She opened her mouth with trembling jaws and swallowed the spark whole!
The moment it entered her body, her eyes blazed with blue-gold light! The Spark of Mana flooded through her decimated form, and her Way of Light began to transform and elevate!

Her wounds started to close as Noah’s Mana-infused regeneration kicked in, his body shining with light that flowed into her. Her missing half began to slowly regrow, flesh and bone reforming with agonizing slowness.
She gasped as she felt her Sovereignty deepening, her understanding of Light expanding to encompass its fundamental relationship with Mana!
Oh!
An irreversible event stemming from an equally impossible entity.
And who knew just what effects it could have for the future when this creature who should have died was instead elevated and bound to Noah’s Civilization?

The moment it entered her body, her eyes blazed with blue-gold light!
The Spark of Mana flooded through her decimated form, and her Way of Light began to transform and elevate!
Her wounds started to close as Noah’s Mana-infused regeneration kicked in, his body shining with light that flowed into her.
Her missing half began to slowly regrow, flesh and bone reforming with agonizing slowness.
She gasped as she felt her Sovereignty deepening, her understanding of Light expanding to encompass its fundamental relationship with Mana!
Oh!
An irreversible event stemming from an equally impossible entity.
And who knew just what effects it could have for the future when this creature who should have died was instead elevated and bound to Noah’s Civilization?

chapters.title: Chapter 4528: Lumivara! I
paragraphs: Possibilities.

In existence, there were many beings who spent obscenely long periods of time wondering what could have been. What of this possibility or that possibility? If only things had happened this way instead of that way.
If only I was born rich. If only I was not poor. If only I was talented instead of mediocre. What could have been if I was born a genius with natural gifts?

There were countless what-ifs and what-could-have-beens that plagued the minds of entities across all of reality. But a concerning pattern emerged when one examined these contemplations closely: most of them focused on the past, on things that nobody had control over anymore.

There were many who were born talentless and poor, seemingly cursed by fate to remain at the bottom. And yet after some time and tremendous effort, some of them turned what little they had and transformed themselves completely.
After years of hard work and relentless focus, the supposedly talentless and poor suddenly became known as geniuses with extremely high levels of wealth and influence.
And those who were born geniuses or rich? Well, reality more often than not dictated that they remained geniuses and rich, building upon the advantages they were given.
But that was just how existence operated.

One should never remain bound by what-ifs and what-could-have-beens. They could change the trajectory of their lives and choose exactly what possibility their existence would take through action and will.
Focus on the now. Focus on what is, not on what could have been.
The past was immutable, but the future remained unwritten.
In the Infinite Unfurling.

In a distant region high in the skies, there was a floating mountain that spun slowly while roiling white mist churned below it in hypnotic patterns. On the peak of this mountain, Noah stood looking at the figure of the now fully healed Lumivara, The Radiant Wanderer.

The fox-like creature was magnificent in her restored state. She possessed a single lush tail that curved gracefully behind her, easily as long as her entire body. Her coat of radiant white fur shone with stellar luminescence, each strand seeming to emit its own soft light.
Her eyes were large and expressive, colored a brilliant gold that pulsed with her Way of Light. She stood on four legs with digitigrade paws.
Lumivara approached Noah with nervous energy, her movements both graceful and hesitant.

"I am Lumivara, The Radiant Wanderer," she said with a voice that trembled slightly. "I follow the Way of Light, seeking to understand illumination in all its forms. I... I also really enjoy watching singularities of light bloom...."
She shuffled her paws with adorable nervousness.

"I have traveled across many different regions in my existence, always moving because I was never quite strong enough to claim territory. I once tried to befriend a lightning elemental, but it tried to eat me. I do not like the taste of meat very much, preferring to sustain myself purely on light itself..."
Noah blinked at this creature with an unfathomable gaze as...why the hell was she saying all this?
Her tail swished with nervous energy.

"My dream is to one day establish a sanctuary where light can exist in its purest form, untainted by darkness or shadow. A place where all who seek illumination can come and learn. Though... I suppose that is a rather presumptuous dream for someone as weak as me."
She looked down with embarrassment at her own admission.
Noah looked at her and shook his head with a calm smile, finding her earnest nervousness somewhat endearing.
Though she did ramble.
"You mentioned an area that has something good?" he asked, bringing the conversation back to practical matters.
Lumivara’s ears perked up as she nodded eagerly.

"Yes! I came across a region filled with blinding light that would even blind Pre-THE Existences if they approached carelessly, of course, not me since I walk The Way of Light..." she explained with growing confidence as she spoke about her discovery.
"The entire domain is protected by layers of luminescence so intense that they function as barriers."
Her eyes shone with the memory.

"It cannot even be accessed through normal spatial travel. One must pass through a small invisible wormhole that is almost impossible to detect. The wormhole takes one an extremely far distance across the Infinite Unfurling, far beyond where most would ever venture."
She gestured with her paw as if drawing a map in the air.

"And even after passing through the wormhole, one has to be perceptive to a very unique frequency of light to find and move through a doorway that leads into the actual domain. I can perceive that frequency because of my Way, but most entities would never find it."
Her voice dropped to something almost reverent.
"I personally call this region the Sanctuary of Perpetual Dawn, because the light there feels like an eternal sunrise that never fully arrives."

Noah’s eyes radiated brilliant light as he listened to this powerful entity who actually possessed more Complexity and Purity than him. And yet she was nervously talking as if he might devour her at any moment, which was an accurate assessment of their power dynamic despite the numerical difference.
He reflected on this region that she described before asking another critical question.
"Why did you consider this place so good?" he asked with interest. "What value did you find there?"
Lumivara’s expression became more serious as she replied.

"Even I could not venture very far into that domain," she admitted with slight shame. "An immense pressure of concentrated light burned all around, becoming more intense the deeper one traveled. The weight of illumination itself became oppressive."
She paused before continuing.

"But in the periphery, in the outer edges of the domain where I could survive, I managed to swallow something that I could only identify as... as an Expressionless Sovereignty. Something that existed without will or consciousness behind it."
Her eyes widened with the memory.

"Whatever I consumed allowed my Way of existence, my own Sovereignty of Light, to advance rapidly! In just a few hours of absorbing materials from the periphery, I made progress that would have taken years elsewhere!"
Noah’s eyes became sharp and focused as they locked onto this being, causing her to tremble with even more nervous energy under his scrutiny.
"Why did you leave such a place then?" he asked with quiet intensity. "If advancement was so rapid, why abandon it?"
Lumivara’s ears drooped as she gave her reply with embarrassed honesty.

"I... I got scared," she admitted while looking down. "I did not sense the aura of a Pre-THE Existence or even anyTHEEntities within the domain. The place felt completely barren and devoid of signatures from conscious beings."
Her tail curled protectively around her body.

"But I did feel a type of natural power emanating from deep within. Not an entity exactly, but something that could potentially rival or even exceed an entity at the level ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty."
She looked up at Noah with wide eyes.
"So I fled before whatever that power was could notice me and decide I was an intruder."
Noah looked closely at this powerful creature that had actually been scared away from a potentially treasure-rich domain. He sighed quietly and shook his head with mixed feelings.
She claimed that she did not sense an entity with the power ofTHE, but what she felt seemed to be exactly at that level of potency.
What could it be if not aTHEentity?

One possibility was that she was simply wrong, and there was indeed a powerful being residing there who was concealing their presence. In which case, venturing into that domain would be effectively delivering himself to a predator.

But in the case that her words were accurate and there truly was no conscious entity in such a domain, then the outer periphery alone held resources that could allow one to rapidly progress in their Sovereignty.

This could be a unique opportunity that had landed directly in Noah’s lap through fortunate circumstances. He simply needed to be certain enough about the risks involved before attempting to obtain the potential boons of this unknown place.
His eyes flashed with decision as he spoke with commanding certainty.
"Okay. For now, I need to continue hunting a few more things to strengthen myself further. You said you would serve as my mount, yes? Let us go."
Lumivara’s body trembled before she nodded with nervous acceptance. Her form began to enlarge, growing until her figure became almost twice as large as Noah’s current transformed state.
He floated up smoothly and landed on her back, feeling her extremely soft fur beneath him. The texture was like resting on clouds made solid.
He nodded while calmly saying with measured approval, "Adequate."
The body of Lumivara trembled at the simple word of acceptance. Her existence experienced a sudden surge of Mana flowing through their connection, and her Way of Light felt even grander than before!
It was as if she had just become connected to a source of infinite light, a wellspring that would never run dry!
She was utterly astonished by the sensation!
Noah tapped on her body and applied the capability of Ambient Integration to both of them. Their figures began to meld with the surrounding space, becoming invisible to standard perception.
He tapped on her flank again and said simply, "Let us go."
The newly formed partnership of the impossible anomaly and the radiant wanderer began to move through the Infinite Unfurling with purpose!
